      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // adultContent.js — per-launch adult acknowledgement and optional rhythm game.
      //
      // The 18+ gate is shown at the start of EVERY launch (nothing is remembered): the whole game is for adults. The optional activity
      // preference is stored separately and defaults off. No explicit content is
      // presented: the optional activity is a fully-dressed dance rhythm challenge.
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      
      const OPT_IN_KEY = "gtb.adult.privateDanceOptIn";
      const ARROWS = [
        { key: "ArrowUp", glyph: "↑" },
        { key: "ArrowDown", glyph: "↓" },
        { key: "ArrowLeft", glyph: "←" },
        { key: "ArrowRight", glyph: "→" },
      ];
      
      export function makeBeatPattern(rng = Math.random, count = 8) {
        return Array.from({ length: count }, () => ARROWS[Math.floor(rng() * ARROWS.length)].key);
      }
      
      export function gradeRhythm(score, total) {
        if (!total) return "No score";
        const ratio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, score / total));
        return ratio >= 0.85 ? "Bayou legend" : ratio >= 0.6 ? "Right on the beat" : ratio >= 0.35 ? "Finding the groove" : "Keep practicing";
      }
      
      function safeStorage(storage) {
        return storage || {
          getItem(key) { try { return globalThis.localStorage?.getItem(key) ?? null; } catch { return null; } },
          setItem(key, value) { try { globalThis.localStorage?.setItem(key, value); } catch {} },
        };
      }
      
      export function createAdultContent({ document: doc = globalThis.document, window: win = globalThis.window, storage } = {}) {
        const store = safeStorage(storage);
        let acknowledged = false;
        let optIn = store.getItem(OPT_IN_KEY) === "true";
        let gate = null;
        let game = null;
        let pauseHandler = null;
      
        const element = (tag, css, text = "") => {
          const el = doc.createElement(tag);
          el.style.cssText = css;
          if (text) el.textContent = text;
          return el;

        const overlayCss = "position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100000;background:rgba(6,8,12,.97);color:#f4f1ea;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;font:16px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;";
        const cardCss = "box-sizing:border-box;width:min(640px,100%);padding:clamp(22px,5vw,44px);background:#151923;border:2px solid #ff4fb3;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 18px 70px #000;";
        const titleCss = "margin:0 0 14px;color:#ff8ad0;font:900 clamp(24px,5vw,36px)/1.1 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.04em;";
        const labelCss = "display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;margin:18px 0;padding:12px;border:1px solid #454554;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;";
        const buttonCss = "padding:12px 18px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:#ff4fb3;color:#17111a;font:800 15px system-ui;cursor:pointer;";
      
        function setOptIn(value) {
          optIn = !!value;
          store.setItem(OPT_IN_KEY, String(optIn));
          return optIn;
        }
        function enabled() { return acknowledged && optIn; }
      
        // The gate is normally the STATIC markup at the top of index.html (painted before any script or loading screen): adopt its two buttons.
        // If it is not there (tests, another host page) the same gate is built in script below.
        function adoptStaticGate() {
          const overlay = doc?.getElementById?.("gtbAdultGate");
          if (!overlay || gate) return null;
          const yes = doc.getElementById("gtbAgeYes"), no = doc.getElementById("gtbAgeNo");
          if (!yes || !no) return null;
          const controls = [yes, no];
          const lockInput = (e) => {
            if (acknowledged) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            if (e.type !== "keydown") return;
            if (e.key === "Tab") {
              const next = controls[(controls.indexOf(e.target) + (e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1) + controls.length) % controls.length];
              next?.focus?.();
            } else if (["Enter", " ", "Spacebar"].includes(e.key) && controls.includes(e.target)) e.target.click?.();
          };
          if (win) for (const type of ["keydown", "keyup", "keypress"]) win.addEventListener(type, lockInput, true);
          yes.addEventListener("click", () => {
            acknowledged = true;
            if (win) for (const type of ["keydown", "keyup", "keypress"]) win.removeEventListener(type, lockInput, true);
            overlay.remove();
            gate = null;
          });
          no.addEventListener("click", () => {
            overlay.innerHTML = "";
            overlay.textContent = "This game is only for adults aged 18 and over. Please close this page.";
            overlay.style.textAlign = "center"; overlay.style.fontSize = "20px";
          });
          gate = overlay;
          // (nothing is focused: a stray Enter or Space must not answer an age question — the player clicks, or Tabs to a button and presses it)
          return overlay;
        }
      
        function mountLaunchGate() {
          if (!doc?.body || gate) return null;
          const adopted = adoptStaticGate();
          if (adopted) return adopted;
          const overlay = element("div", overlayCss);
          overlay.id = "gtbAdultGate";
          const card = element("section", cardCss);
          card.setAttribute("role", "dialog");
          card.setAttribute("aria-modal", "true");
          card.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", "gtbAdultTitle");
          let continueBtn, leaveBtn;
          const focusables = () => [continueBtn, leaveBtn].filter(Boolean);
          const lockInput = (e) => {
            if (acknowledged) return;
            // This runs at window capture so the game never receives keys (movement, menus, shortcuts) until the player has answered.
            // Reproduce the small set of native keyboard actions the gate needs: Tab moves between the two buttons, Enter / Space press one.
            e.preventDefault();

            const controls = focusables();

            if (e.key === "Tab") {

              if (controls.includes(e.target)) e.target.click?.();
            }
          };
          const unlockKeys = () => {
            if (win) for (const type of ["keydown", "keyup", "keypress"]) win.removeEventListener(type, lockInput, true);
          };
          if (win) for (const type of ["keydown", "keyup", "keypress"]) win.addEventListener(type, lockInput, true);
          const title = element("h1", titleCss, "YOU MUST BE OVER 18 TO PLAY THIS GAME");
          title.id = "gtbAdultTitle";
          const warning = element("p", "margin:0 0 12px;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;", "This game contains gore, drugs, violence, horror, and explicit sexual content. It is for adults only and is NOT suitable for anyone under 18. Nobody under 18 should play this game.");
          const details = element("p", "margin:0 0 22px;color:#c4c6d0;", "This is an R18+ game. It contains gore, graphic violence, drug use, sex and sexual themes, horror and strong language. By continuing you confirm that you are 18 or older.");
          continueBtn = element("button", buttonCss + "display:block;width:100%;margin:0 0 10px;padding:16px 18px;font-size:17px;", "I AM OVER 18 YEARS OF AGE");
          continueBtn.type = "button";
          leaveBtn = element("button", buttonCss + "display:block;width:100%;background:#2b3040;color:#c9ccd8;font-weight:600;", "I AM UNDER 18 · LEAVE");
          leaveBtn.type = "button";
          const note = element("p", "margin:14px 0 0;color:#999daa;font-size:12px;", "You will be asked again every time the game starts.");
          continueBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
            acknowledged = true;
            unlockKeys();
            overlay.remove();
            gate = null;
          });
          leaveBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
            // not an adult: nothing of the game is shown — the page is replaced by a plain notice and the game stays locked
            try { doc.body.replaceChildren?.(); } catch {}
            const bye = element("div", overlayCss + "text-align:center;", "This game is only for adults aged 18 and over. Please close this page.");
            doc.body.appendChild(bye);
          });
          card.append(title, warning, details, continueBtn, leaveBtn, note);
          overlay.appendChild(card);
          doc.body.appendChild(overlay);
          gate = overlay;
          return overlay;
        }
      
        function closeGame(result = null) {
          if (!game) return;
          const active = game;
          game = null;
          if (win) win.removeEventListener("keydown", active.onKey, true);
          clearTimeout(active.timer);
          active.overlay.remove();
          if (pauseHandler) pauseHandler(false);
          if (active.onFinish) active.onFinish(result);
        }
      
        function openRhythmGame({ venue = "the club", onBegin = () => true, onFinish = () => {} } = {}) {
          if (!enabled() || !doc?.body || game) return false;
          const overlay = element("div", overlayCss + "z-index:100001;");
          overlay.id = "gtbDanceRhythm";
          const card = element("section", cardCss + "text-align:center;");
          card.setAttribute("role", "dialog"); card.setAttribute("aria-modal", "true");
          const title = element("h2", titleCss, `PRIVATE DANCE · ${venue.toUpperCase()}`);
          const intro = element("p", "color:#d2d3dc;", "A fully-dressed, non-explicit dance rhythm challenge with a fictional adult performer. You can leave at any time.");
          const prompt = element("div", "margin:22px 0;font:900 clamp(52px,12vw,88px)/1 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#fff;min-height:1em;", "Ready?");
          const progress = element("p", "color:#c4c6d0;", "Press the matching arrow when it appears.");
          const controls = element("div", "display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;");
          for (const arrow of ARROWS) {
            const b = element("button", "width:52px;height:46px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid #666;background:#242938;color:#fff;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;", arrow.glyph);
            b.type = "button"; b.setAttribute("aria-label", `Dance ${arrow.key.replace("Arrow", "").toLowerCase()}`);
            b.addEventListener("click", () => submit(arrow.key)); controls.appendChild(b);
          }
          const actions = element("div", "display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:12px;margin-top:22px;");
          const start = element("button", buttonCss, "START PRIVATE DANCE"); start.type = "button";
          const cancel = element("button", buttonCss + "background:#454957;color:#fff;", "CANCEL"); cancel.type = "button";
          actions.append(start, cancel);
          card.append(title, intro, prompt, progress, controls, actions); overlay.appendChild(card); doc.body.appendChild(overlay);
      
          const seq = makeBeatPattern();
          let index = 0, score = 0, started = false, stepMs = 850;
          const active = { overlay, onFinish, result: null, timer: 0, onKey: null };
          function paint() {
            if (!game) return;
            if (index >= seq.length) {
              const result = { score, total: seq.length, rating: gradeRhythm(score, seq.length) };
              prompt.textContent = `${score} / ${seq.length}`;
              progress.textContent = result.rating;
              start.hidden = true;
              cancel.textContent = "DONE";
              game.result = result;
              return;
            }
            prompt.textContent = ARROWS.find((a) => a.key === seq[index]).glyph;
            progress.textContent = `Beat ${index + 1} of ${seq.length} · ${score} on time`;
          }
          function submit(key) {
            if (!game || !started || index >= seq.length) return;
            if (seq[index] === key) score++;
            index++;
            clearTimeout(active.timer);
            paint();
            if (index < seq.length) advance();
          }
          function advance() {

            if (ARROWS.some((a) => a.key === e.key)) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); submit(e.key); }

          start.addEventListener("click", () => {

        const api = {

      import assert from "node:assert/strict";
      import { createAdultContent, makeBeatPattern, gradeRhythm } from "../../src/adultContent.js";
      
      let focused = null;
      function fakeElement(tag) {
        const listeners = {};
        return {
          tagName: tag.toUpperCase(), style: {}, children: [], dataset: {}, hidden: false, disabled: false, checked: false,
          append(...els) { this.children.push(...els); }, appendChild(el) { this.children.push(el); },
          addEventListener(type, fn) { (listeners[type] ||= []).push(fn); },
          dispatch(type, event = {}) { for (const fn of listeners[type] || []) fn({ type, target: this, preventDefault() {}, stopImmediatePropagation() {}, ...event }); },
          setAttribute() {}, remove() { this.removed = true; },
          focus() { focused = this; },
          click() {
            if (this.tagName === "INPUT" && this.type === "checkbox") { this.checked = !this.checked; this.dispatch("change"); }
            this.dispatch("click");
          },
        };
      }
      const body = fakeElement("body");
      const doc = { body, createElement: fakeElement };
      const winListeners = {};
      const win = {
        addEventListener(type, fn) { (winListeners[type] ||= []).push(fn); },
        removeEventListener(type, fn) { winListeners[type] = (winListeners[type] || []).filter((x) => x !== fn); },
        dispatch(type, event = {}) { for (const fn of [...(winListeners[type] || [])]) fn({ type, preventDefault() {}, stopImmediatePropagation() {}, ...event }); },
      };
      const data = new Map();
      const storage = { getItem: (k) => data.get(k) ?? null, setItem: (k, v) => data.set(k, String(v)) };
      const find = (el, predicate) => { if (predicate(el)) return el; for (const c of el.children || []) { const hit = find(c, predicate); if (hit) return hit; } return null; };
      
      let adult = createAdultContent({ document: doc, window: win, storage });
      const firstBody = body;
      assert.equal(adult.acknowledged(), false, "18+ acknowledgement must start false on every launch");
      let prevented = false;
      win.dispatch("keydown", { key: "w", preventDefault() { prevented = true; }, stopImmediatePropagation() {} });
      assert.equal(prevented, true, "launch gameplay keys are blocked until age confirmation");
      assert.equal(adult.optedIn, false, "optional activity must default off");
      assert.equal(adult.enabled(), false, "rhythm game unavailable before age acknowledgement and opt-in");
      const gate = find(body, (e) => e.id === "gtbAdultGate");
      assert.ok(gate, "launch gate mounts over the launch view");
      assert.match(gate.children[0].children[0].textContent, /YOU MUST BE OVER 18/);
      assert.match(gate.children[0].children[1].textContent, /gore, drugs, violence, horror, and explicit sexual content/);
      assert.match(gate.children[0].children[1].textContent, /NOT suitable for anyone under 18/);
      assert.match(gate.children[0].children[1].textContent, /Nobody under 18 should play this game/);
      assert.match(gate.children[0].children[2].textContent, /R18\+ game.*gore.*violence.*drug use.*sex.*horror/);
      assert.doesNotMatch(gate.children[0].children[2].textContent, /Explicit sexual activity is not shown/);
      assert.equal(adult.openRhythmGame(), false, "can't open the private activity before acknowledgement");
      
      const card = gate.children[0];
      const continueBtn = card.children.find((e) => e.textContent === "I AM OVER 18 YEARS OF AGE");
      const leaveBtn = card.children.find((e) => e.textContent === "I AM UNDER 18 · LEAVE");
      assert.ok(continueBtn && leaveBtn, "the gate offers exactly the two answers");
      assert.equal(adult.acknowledged(), false, "nothing unlocks without pressing the button");
      adult.setOptIn(true);                                        // the optional activity is chosen in Options, never in the gate
      assert.equal(adult.enabled(), false, "opting in alone does not open the game: the age button must be pressed");
      win.dispatch("keydown", { key: "Tab", target: continueBtn });
      assert.equal(focused, leaveBtn, "Tab moves focus to the leave option");
      win.dispatch("keydown", { key: "Tab", shiftKey: true, target: leaveBtn });
      assert.equal(focused, continueBtn, "Shift+Tab returns focus to the adult confirmation");
      win.dispatch("keydown", { key: "Enter", target: continueBtn });
      assert.equal(adult.acknowledged(), true);
      assert.equal(adult.enabled(), true);
      assert.equal(gate.removed, true, "the gate goes away once answered");
      
      let paused = false, result = null;
      adult.setPauseHandler((v) => { paused = v; });
      assert.equal(adult.openRhythmGame({ venue: "HAPPY HOGS", onFinish: (r) => { result = r; } }), true);

- path: tools\build-site.mjs
  content: |
      // Builds ./dist — only what the game serves — so a direct `wrangler pages deploy` can never upload .env, .git/,
      // server/, tools/, docs/, node_modules/ or the local asset archives (zips, unitypackages, bbdoc).
      //   node tools/build-site.mjs            (npm run build:site)
      //   npm run deploy                       (build:site, then wrangler pages deploy dist)
      // Assets are taken from `git ls-files`, so anything gitignored (source archives) stays out by construction.
      import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
      import { cpSync, mkdirSync, rmSync, existsSync, statSync } from "node:fs";
      import path from "node:path";
      import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
      
      const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
      const out = path.join(root, "dist");
      rmSync(out, { recursive: true, force: true });
      mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });
      
      const files = execFileSync("git", ["-c", "core.quotepath=off", "ls-files", "-z", "index.html", "src", "data", "assets", "og.png", "og2.png", "og3.png", "cover.png"], { cwd: root, encoding: "utf8" })
        .split("\0").filter(Boolean);
      let n = 0, bytes = 0;
      for (const f of files) {
        const from = path.join(root, f);
        if (!existsSync(from)) continue;
        const to = path.join(out, f);
        mkdirSync(path.dirname(to), { recursive: true });
        cpSync(from, to);
        n++; bytes += statSync(from).size;
      }
      console.log(`dist/: ${n} files, ${(bytes / 1048576).toFixed(0)} MB`);

> _Reasoning_
> **Analyzing password script issues**
> 
> I'm noticing potential problems with the current password script, particularly with window lock handlers. The function "lock" returns for the targeted input or submit, but the "adultContent" lockInput captures key events and prevents password input. This issue doesn't affect mouse clicks.
> 
> Also, after entering the password, the "I am over 18" button likely isn't clickable due to a static overlay's z-index issue. There's a race condition where pressing Enter triggers "tryEnter," but the lock blocks the event, preventing the key listener from executing.**Evaluating code execution order**
> 
> I'm thinking about the code execution order when it comes to using an external `<script type=module>`. Since it has the `defer` attribute, it will execute after the parsing is complete. The static password gate inline script runs during parsing to set the key lock, and then we encounter the static age gate and the HTML. The module creates an adult content singleton right at import, but I'm curious if any input was already typed before the module finished executing. It seems typing into `gtbAccessInput` might not be possible unless it's pasted from the clipboard.**Evaluating access gate functionality**

              if (ageYes) ageYes.focus();
            } else {
              error.hidden = false;
              error.textContent = "Wrong password.";
              input.value = "";
              input.focus();
            }
          });
        }
        submit.addEventListener("click", tryEnter);
        input.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "Enter") tryEnter(); });
        // Swallow all other input (movement keys, menu shortcuts, the age gate below) until this is answered.
        function lock(e) {
          if (e.target === input || e.target === submit) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopImmediatePropagation();
        }
        window.addEventListener("keydown", lock, true);
        window.addEventListener("keyup", lock, true);
        input.focus();
      })();
      </script>

- path: serve.mjs
  content: |
      // Minimal static file server for Escape The Bayou. No dependencies.
      //   node serve.mjs [port]
      import { createServer } from "node:http";
      import { readFile, stat } from "node:fs/promises";
      import { extname, join, normalize } from "node:path";
      import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
      import { listTracks } from "./tools/music-playlist.mjs";
      
      const ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL(".", import.meta.url));
      const PORT = Number(process.argv[2]) || 5173;
      
      const TYPES = {
        ".html": "text/html", ".js": "text/javascript", ".mjs": "text/javascript",
        ".css": "text/css", ".json": "application/json", ".png": "image/png",
        ".jpg": "image/jpeg", ".gif": "image/gif", ".svg": "image/svg+xml",
        ".glb": "model/gltf-binary", ".gltf": "model/gltf+json", ".bin": "application/octet-stream",
        ".fbx": "application/octet-stream", ".wav": "audio/wav", ".mp3": "audio/mpeg",
        ".ogg": "audio/ogg", ".oga": "audio/ogg", ".m4a": "audio/mp4", ".aac": "audio/aac",
        ".flac": "audio/flac", ".opus": "audio/ogg", ".webm": "audio/webm", ".txt": "text/plain",
      };
      
      createServer(async (req, res) => {
        try {
          let path = decodeURIComponent(new URL(req.url, "http://x").pathname);
          if (path === "/") path = "/index.html";
          // The soundtrack playlist is listed live from assets/music/, so dropping a
          // track in (or deleting one) shows up on the next page load.
          if (path === "/assets/music/playlist.json") {
            const tracks = listTracks(join(ROOT, "assets", "music"));
            res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "application/json", "cache-control": "no-cache" });
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ tracks }));
            return;
          }
          // Never serve secrets or internals: this used to hand out .env (the Fish Audio and OpenRouter keys),
          // .git/ and the server code to anyone who could reach the port (audit, 2026-09-26).
          if (path.split("/").some((seg) => seg.startsWith(".") && seg !== "") || /^\/(server|node_modules|scratch_puppet)\//.test(path)) {
            res.writeHead(404).end("404");
            return;
          }
          const full = normalize(join(ROOT, path));
          if (!full.startsWith(ROOT)) { res.writeHead(403).end("no"); return; }
          const info = await stat(full);
          if (info.isDirectory()) { res.writeHead(403).end("dir"); return; }
          const body = await readFile(full);
          res.writeHead(200, {
            "content-type": TYPES[extname(full).toLowerCase()] || "application/octet-stream",
            "cache-control": "no-cache",
          });
          res.end(body);
        } catch {
          res.writeHead(404).end("404");
        }
      }).listen(PORT, () => console.log(`Escape The Bayou -> http://localhost:${PORT}`));
      
  referencedBy: {}
- path: .puppeteerrc.cjs
  content: |
      // Puppeteer is only for the local QA scripts in tools/qa. Cloudflare Pages (CF_PAGES) and CI run `npm install`
      // on every push and must NOT download a ~150 MB Chromium — that download is what broke every Pages build after
      // puppeteer became a devDependency. Locally the browser still downloads as normal.
      module.exports = {
        skipDownload: Boolean(process.env.CF_PAGES || process.env.CI),
      };
      
  referencedBy: {}

- path: tools\qa\lib\agegate.mjs
  content: |
      // The game opens with an "I am over 18 years of age" gate (src/adultContent.js) that covers the page and swallows keys and clicks until it is
      // answered. QA scripts drive the page with the keyboard and mouse, so they answer it exactly the way a player does — by pressing the button —
      // the moment it appears. (There is deliberately no bypass in the game itself.)
      export async function autoAcknowledge(page) {
        await page.evaluateOnNewDocument(() => {
          const press = () => { const b = document.querySelector('#gtbAdultGate button'); if (b && /OVER 18/.test(b.textContent)) b.click(); };
          new MutationObserver(press).observe(document, { childList: true, subtree: true });
          document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', press);
        });
      }
      
  referencedBy: {}
```

  "content": "import assert from \"node:assert/strict\";\nimport path from \"node:path\";\nimport { pathToFileURL } from \"node:url\";\nimport puppeteer from \"puppeteer\";\n\nconst pageUrl = pathToFileURL(path.resolve(\"index.html\")).href;\nconst browser = await puppeteer.launch({ headless: true, args: [\"--allow-file-access-from-files\", \"--no-sandbox\"] });\ntry {\n  const page = await browser.newPage();\n  await page.goto(pageUrl, { waitUntil: \"domcontentloaded\" });\n  await page.waitForSelector(\"#gtbAccessInput\");\n\n  const before = await page.$eval(\"#gtbAccessError\", (error) => ({\n    hidden: error.hidden,\n    role: error.getAttribute(\"role\"),\n    live: error.getAttribute(\"aria-live\"),\n  }));\n  const inputDescription = await page.$eval(\"#gtbAccessInput\", (input) => input.getAttribute(\"aria-describedby\"));\n  assert.deepEqual(before, { hidden: true, role: \"alert\", live: \"polite\" }, \"error region starts hidden and is announced accessibly\");\n  assert.equal(inputDescription, \"gtbAccessError\", \"password field references its feedback region\");\n\n  await page.click(\"#gtbAccessSubmit\");\n  await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector(\"#gtbAccessError\").hidden);\n  const after = await page.$eval(\"#gtbAccessError\", (error) => ({\n    text: error.textContent,\n    invalid: document.querySelector(\"#gtbAccessInput\").getAttribute(\"aria-invalid\"),\n  }));\n  assert.match(after.text, /opened as a file/i, \"file:// gets specific guidance\");\n  assert.match(after.text, /start-game\\.cmd|npm start/i, \"instructions explain how to start the local server\");\n  assert.equal(after.invalid, \"true\", \"unsupported verification marks the password field invalid\");\n\n  console.log(\"Password-gate unsupported-context browser test passed\");\n} finally {\n  await browser.close();\n}\n"
}

- path: tools\qa\gun_audio_browser_check.mjs
  content: |
      // Browser-path check for the recorded gun samples (2026-09-27): fetch + decode
      // every manifest entry with the real WebAudio implementation, print peaks so
      // the trims in gunAudio.js can be sanity-checked against the synth baselines.
      //   node tools/qa/gun_audio_browser_check.mjs   (expects `node serve.mjs 8899` running)
      import puppeteer from 'puppeteer';
      import { autoAcknowledge } from './lib/agegate.mjs';
      import { gunSfxManifest } from '../../src/gunAudio.js';
      
      const EDGE = 'C:/Program Files (x86)/Microsoft/Edge/Application/msedge.exe';
      const browser = await puppeteer.launch({
        protocolTimeout: 120000,
        executablePath: EDGE,
        args: ['--use-gl=swiftshader', '--enable-unsafe-swiftshader', '--mute-audio'],
      });
      const page = await browser.newPage();
      await autoAcknowledge(page);
      await page.goto('http://localhost:8899/', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 90000 });
      
      const paths = [...new Set(Object.values(gunSfxManifest()).flat().map((s) => s.path))];
      const rows = await page.evaluate(async (paths) => {
        const ctx = new AudioContext();
        const out = [];
        for (const p of paths) {
          try {
            const res = await fetch(`/${p}`);
            if (!res.ok) { out.push({ p, error: `HTTP ${res.status}` }); continue; }
            const buf = await ctx.decodeAudioData(await res.arrayBuffer());
            const ch = buf.getChannelData(0);
            let peak = 0;

      // Nothing on roads: every traffic lane is a road centreline; report every static blocker (house, tree, lamp, prop) that intrudes
      // on the carriageway (centre of the lane +/- CLEAR m), grouped by lane.   node serve.mjs 8899 ; node tools/qa/road_clearance.mjs [--json]
      // Needs puppeteer (set PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH if Chromium was not downloaded).
      import puppeteer from 'puppeteer';
      import { autoAcknowledge } from './lib/agegate.mjs';
      const CLEAR = 1.6;       // half a car (1.0) + a little; a lane is ~3.4 m wide and drivers hug its centre
      const browser = await puppeteer.launch({ args: ['--use-gl=swiftshader', '--enable-unsafe-swiftshader', '--mute-audio'] });
      const page = await browser.newPage();
      await autoAcknowledge(page);
      const errs = []; page.on('pageerror', e => errs.push(e.message));
      await page.goto('http://localhost:8899/', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 90000 });
      await page.waitForSelector('#freeBtn:not([disabled])', { timeout: 300000 });
      await page.evaluate(() => document.getElementById('freeBtn').click());
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 4000));
      const res = await page.evaluate((CLEAR) => {
        const g = window.__game, lanes = g.traffic.lanes.filter(l => !/~uturn$/.test(l.name));
        const statics = g.blockers.filter(b => b._grid === 'static' || b._grid === undefined).filter(b => b.r > 0 && !b.dynamic);
        // street lamps / lot lights with a pole are solid too (litSpots entries with `pole`), radius ~0.25 m
        for (const s of g.litSpots || []) if (s.pole && s.x != null) statics.push({ x: s.x, z: s.z, r: 0.25, tag: 'lamp pole' });
        const out = [];
        for (const l of lanes) {
          const hits = new Map();
          for (let i = 1; i < l.pts.length; i++) {
            const a = l.pts[i - 1], b = l.pts[i], dx = b.x - a.x, dy = b.y - a.y, len2 = dx * dx + dy * dy || 1;
            const x0 = Math.min(a.x, b.x) - 30, x1 = Math.max(a.x, b.x) + 30, z0 = Math.min(a.y, b.y) - 30, z1 = Math.max(a.y, b.y) + 30;
            for (const k of statics) {
              if (k.x < x0 || k.x > x1 || k.z < z0 || k.z > z1) continue;
              const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((k.x - a.x) * dx + (k.z - a.y) * dy) / len2));
              const d = Math.hypot(k.x - (a.x + t * dx), k.z - (a.y + t * dy)) - k.r;
              if (d < CLEAR && !hits.has(k)) hits.set(k, d);
            }
          }
          if (hits.size) out.push({ lane: l.name, len: Math.round(l.length), hits: [...hits].map(([k, d]) => ({ x: +k.x.toFixed(1), z: +k.z.toFixed(1), r: +k.r.toFixed(2), gap: +d.toFixed(2), tag: k.tag || k.name || k.kind || '' })) });
        }
        return { lanes: lanes.length, statics: statics.length, out };
      }, CLEAR);
      if (process.argv.includes('--json')) console.log(JSON.stringify(res));
      else {
        console.log(`${res.lanes} lanes, ${res.statics} static blockers, ${res.out.length} lanes with intrusions`);
        for (const l of res.out) { console.log(`\n${l.lane} (${l.len} m): ${l.hits.length}`); for (const h of l.hits.slice(0, 8)) console.log(`   (${h.x}, ${h.z}) r=${h.r} gap=${h.gap} ${h.tag}`); if (l.hits.length > 8) console.log(`   ... +${l.hits.length - 8}`); }
      }
      console.log('page errors:', errs.length);

      process.exit(res.out.length ? 1 : 0);

- path: tools\qa\access_gate_browser_test.mjs
  content: |
      import assert from "node:assert/strict";
      import path from "node:path";
      import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
      import puppeteer from "puppeteer";
      
      const pageUrl = pathToFileURL(path.resolve("index.html")).href;
      const browser = await puppeteer.launch({
        ...(process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH } : {}),
        headless: true,
        args: ["--allow-file-access-from-files", "--no-sandbox"],
      });
      try {
        const page = await browser.newPage();
        // Emulate a browser that does not expose Web Crypto so this case is deterministic
        // even when the test runner itself has crypto.subtle enabled for file URLs.
        await page.evaluateOnNewDocument(() => {
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", { configurable: true, value: {} });
        });
        await page.goto(pageUrl, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await page.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessInput");
      
        const before = await page.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          hidden: error.hidden,
          role: error.getAttribute("role"),
          live: error.getAttribute("aria-live"),
        }));
        const inputDescription = await page.$eval("#gtbAccessInput", (input) => input.getAttribute("aria-describedby"));
        assert.deepEqual(before, { hidden: true, role: "alert", live: "polite" }, "error region starts hidden and is announced accessibly");
        assert.equal(inputDescription, "gtbAccessError", "password field references its feedback region");
      
        await page.click("#gtbAccessSubmit");
        await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector("#gtbAccessError").hidden);
        const after = await page.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          text: error.textContent,
          invalid: document.querySelector("#gtbAccessInput").getAttribute("aria-invalid"),
        }));
        assert.match(after.text, /opened as a file/i, "file:// gets specific guidance");
        assert.match(after.text, /start-game\.cmd|npm start/i, "instructions explain how to start the local server");
        assert.equal(after.invalid, "true", "unsupported verification marks the password field invalid");
      
        console.log("Password-gate unsupported-context browser test passed");
      } finally {
        await browser.close();
      }

- path: tools\qa\access_gate_browser_test.mjs
  content: |
      import assert from "node:assert/strict";
      import path from "node:path";
      import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
      import puppeteer from "puppeteer";
      
      const pageUrl = pathToFileURL(path.resolve("index.html")).href;
      const browser = await puppeteer.launch({
        ...(process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH } : {}),
        headless: true,
        args: ["--allow-file-access-from-files", "--no-sandbox"],
      });
      try {
        const page = await browser.newPage();
        // Emulate a browser that does not expose Web Crypto so this case is deterministic
        // even when the test runner itself has crypto.subtle enabled for file URLs.
        await page.evaluateOnNewDocument(() => {
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", { configurable: true, value: {} });
        });
        await page.goto(pageUrl, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await page.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessInput");
      
        const before = await page.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          hidden: error.hidden,
          role: error.getAttribute("role"),
          live: error.getAttribute("aria-live"),
        }));
        const inputSemantics = await page.$eval("#gtbAccessInput", (input) => ({
          describedBy: input.getAttribute("aria-describedby"),
          label: input.labels[0]?.textContent.trim(),
          autocomplete: input.autocomplete,
          autocapitalize: input.getAttribute("autocapitalize"),
          autocorrect: input.getAttribute("autocorrect"),
          enterKeyHint: input.enterKeyHint,
          fontSize: getComputedStyle(input).fontSize,
        }));
        assert.deepEqual(before, { hidden: true, role: "alert", live: "polite" }, "error region starts hidden and is announced accessibly");
        assert.deepEqual(inputSemantics, {
          describedBy: "gtbAccessError",
          label: "Access password",
          autocomplete: "off",
          autocapitalize: "off",
          autocorrect: "off",
          enterKeyHint: "go",
          fontSize: "16px",
        }, "password field has an accessible label and mobile-appropriate input hints");
      
        await page.focus("#gtbAccessInput");
        await page.keyboard.press("Enter");
        await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector("#gtbAccessError").hidden);
        const after = await page.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          text: error.textContent,
          invalid: document.querySelector("#gtbAccessInput").getAttribute("aria-invalid"),
        }));
        assert.match(after.text, /opened as a file/i, "file:// gets specific guidance");
        assert.match(after.text, /start-game\.cmd|npm start/i, "instructions explain how to start the local server");
        assert.equal(after.invalid, "true", "unsupported verification marks the password field invalid");
      
        console.log("Password-gate unsupported-context browser test passed");
      } finally {
        await browser.close();
      }
      
  referencedBy: {}
```

- path: index.html
  content: |
      <!-- PRIVATE ACCESS GATE — STATIC, same first-paint principle as the 18+ gate below, and painted
           on top of it (higher z-index): this build is not meant to be found by a stranger who guesses
           the URL. Correct password is remembered in localStorage (keyed by the password's own hash, so
           changing GTB_ACCESS_HASH below silently invalidates every remembered device). This is
           client-side obfuscation, not real access control — the hash is sitting right here in the page
           source — but it stops a casual visitor from landing on an R18+ game by accident, which is the
           actual goal (see docs/CONTENT_POLICY_REVIEW.md). -->
      <div id="gtbAccessGate" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="gtbAccessTitle" style="position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147483647;background:#06080c;color:#f4f1ea;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;font:16px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;">
        <section style="box-sizing:border-box;width:min(420px,100%);padding:clamp(24px,5vw,40px);background:#151923;border:3px solid #4fd1ff;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 18px 70px #000;">
          <h1 id="gtbAccessTitle" style="margin:0 0 12px;color:#8ad4ff;font:900 22px/1.2 system-ui,sans-serif;">PRIVATE ACCESS</h1>
          <p style="margin:0 0 18px;color:#c4c6d0;font-size:14px;">This build is private. Enter the access password to continue.</p>
          <form id="gtbAccessForm">
            <label for="gtbAccessInput" style="display:block;margin:0 0 6px;color:#c4c6d0;font-size:14px;">Access password</label>
            <input id="gtbAccessInput" type="password" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" autocorrect="off" spellcheck="false" enterkeyhint="go" aria-describedby="gtbAccessError" style="display:block;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:12px 14px;margin:0 0 10px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid #454554;background:#0d1017;color:#f4f1ea;font-size:16px;">
            <button id="gtbAccessSubmit" type="submit" style="display:block;width:100%;padding:14px 18px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:#4fd1ff;color:#0a1620;font:800 15px system-ui;cursor:pointer;">ENTER</button>
          </form>
          <p id="gtbAccessError" role="alert" aria-live="polite" hidden style="margin:12px 0 0;color:#ff8a8a;font-size:13px;"></p>
        </section>
      </div>
      <script>
      (function () {
        // sha256("deltron3030%funkyhomo!") — see docs/CONTENT_POLICY_REVIEW.md. Change the password by
        // recomputing this hash (e.g. `printf '%s' 'newpass' | sha256sum` at a shell) and pasting it here.
        var GTB_ACCESS_HASH = "14abfcdeb124aa9a8a18c5674f01a51b55f831caffeacb96da6f77732a39829a";
        var REMEMBER_KEY = "gtb.access.ok";
        var gate = document.getElementById("gtbAccessGate");
        if (!gate) return;
        try {
          if (localStorage.getItem(REMEMBER_KEY) === GTB_ACCESS_HASH) { gate.remove(); return; }
        } catch (e) {}
        var form = document.getElementById("gtbAccessForm");
        var input = document.getElementById("gtbAccessInput");
        var error = document.getElementById("gtbAccessError");
        function sha256Hex(text) {
          return crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(text)).then(function (buf) {
            return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(function (b) { return b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"); }).join("");
          });
        }
        function showError(message) {
          error.textContent = message;
          error.hidden = false;
          input.setAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
        }
        function tryEnter() {
          error.hidden = true;
          error.textContent = "";
          input.removeAttribute("aria-invalid");
          if (!(window.crypto && window.crypto.subtle && window.TextEncoder)) {
            var message = location.protocol === "file:"
              ? "Password checking isn't available when this page is opened as a file. Start the game with start-game.cmd or npm start, then open http://localhost:8899."
              : "This browser can't securely check the password here. Open the game over HTTPS or on localhost, or try a current browser.";
            showError(message);
            return;
          }
          try {
            sha256Hex(input.value || "").then(function (hex) {
              if (hex === GTB_ACCESS_HASH) {
                try { localStorage.setItem(REMEMBER_KEY, GTB_ACCESS_HASH); } catch (e) {}
                window.removeEventListener("keydown", lock, true);
                window.removeEventListener("keyup", lock, true);
                gate.remove();
                // The age-gate keyboard trap may still be active. Move focus off the
                // removed password form so the next keyboard action reaches its button.
                var ageYes = document.getElementById("gtbAgeYes");
                if (ageYes) ageYes.focus();
              } else {
                showError("That password didn't match. Check it and try again.");
                input.value = "";
                input.focus();
              }
            }).catch(function () {
              showError("Password checking failed in this browser. Open the game over HTTPS or on localhost, or try a current browser.");
            });
          } catch (e) {
            showError("Password checking failed in this browser. Open the game over HTTPS or on localhost, or try a current browser.");
          }
        }
        form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          tryEnter();
        });
        input.addEventListener("input", function () {
          if (error.hidden) return;
          error.hidden = true;
          error.textContent = "";
          input.removeAttribute("aria-invalid");
        });
        // Swallow all other input (movement keys, menu shortcuts, the age gate below) until this is answered.
        function lock(e) {
          if (e.target === input || e.target === document.getElementById("gtbAccessSubmit")) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopImmediatePropagation();
        }
        window.addEventListener("keydown", lock, true);
        window.addEventListener("keyup", lock, true);
        input.focus();
      })();
      </script>
      <!-- The 18+ gate is STATIC: it is the first thing painted, before any script or loading screen (src/adultContent.js adopts these buttons and
           swallows keys until one is pressed; the game never runs behind it un-answered). Nothing is remembered: every launch asks again. -->
      <div id="gtbAdultGate" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="gtbAdultTitle" style="position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147483000;background:#06080c;color:#f4f1ea;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;font:16px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;">
        <section style="box-sizing:border-box;width:min(680px,100%);padding:clamp(24px,5vw,48px);background:#151923;border:3px solid #ff4fb3;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 18px 70px #000;">
          <h1 id="gtbAdultTitle" style="margin:0 0 16px;color:#ff8ad0;font:900 clamp(24px,5.4vw,40px)/1.1 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.03em;">YOU MUST BE OVER 18 TO PLAY THIS GAME</h1>
          <p style="margin:0 0 12px;font-size:19px;font-weight:700;">This game is for adults only and is NOT suitable for anyone under 18 years of age.</p>
          <p style="margin:0 0 24px;color:#c4c6d0;">This is an R18+ game. It contains gore, graphic violence, drug use, sex and sexual themes, horror and strong language. If you are under 18, do not continue.</p>
          <button id="gtbAgeYes" type="button" style="display:block;width:100%;margin:0 0 10px;padding:17px 18px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:#ff4fb3;color:#17111a;font:800 17px system-ui;cursor:pointer;">I AM OVER 18 YEARS OF AGE</button>
          <button id="gtbAgeNo" type="button" style="display:block;width:100%;padding:12px 18px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:#2b3040;color:#c9ccd8;font:600 15px system-ui;cursor:pointer;">I AM UNDER 18 · LEAVE</button>
          <p style="margin:14px 0 0;color:#999daa;font-size:12px;">You will be asked again every time the game starts.</p>
        </section>
      </div>
      <div id="hud">
        <div class="panel">
          <div class="lbl">Health</div><div class="bar"><i id="hpFill"></i></div>

        const overlayCss = "position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100000;background:rgba(6,8,12,.97);color:#f4f1ea;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;font:16px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;";
        const cardCss = "box-sizing:border-box;width:min(640px,100%);padding:clamp(22px,5vw,44px);background:#151923;border:2px solid #ff4fb3;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 18px 70px #000;";
        const titleCss = "margin:0 0 14px;color:#ff8ad0;font:900 clamp(24px,5vw,36px)/1.1 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.04em;";
        const labelCss = "display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;margin:18px 0;padding:12px;border:1px solid #454554;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;";
        const buttonCss = "padding:12px 18px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:#ff4fb3;color:#17111a;font:800 15px system-ui;cursor:pointer;";
      
        function setOptIn(value) {
          optIn = !!value;
          store.setItem(OPT_IN_KEY, String(optIn));
          return optIn;
        }
        function enabled() { return acknowledged && optIn; }
      
        // The gate is normally the STATIC markup at the top of index.html (painted before any script or loading screen): adopt its two buttons.
        // If it is not there (tests, another host page) the same gate is built in script below.
        function adoptStaticGate() {
          const overlay = doc?.getElementById?.("gtbAdultGate");
          if (!overlay || gate) return null;
          const yes = doc.getElementById("gtbAgeYes"), no = doc.getElementById("gtbAgeNo");
          if (!yes || !no) return null;
          const controls = [yes, no];
          const lockInput = (e) => {
            if (acknowledged) return;
            // The private access form is layered above this gate. Let it receive normal
            // typing/Enter input instead of swallowing keys at the window capture phase.
            const accessGate = doc.getElementById?.("gtbAccessGate");
            if (accessGate && (accessGate === e.target || accessGate.contains?.(e.target))) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            if (e.type !== "keydown") return;
            if (e.key === "Tab") {
              const next = controls[(controls.indexOf(e.target) + (e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1) + controls.length) % controls.length];
              next?.focus?.();
            } else if (["Enter", " ", "Spacebar"].includes(e.key) && controls.includes(e.target)) e.target.click?.();
          };
          if (win) for (const type of ["keydown", "keyup", "keypress"]) win.addEventListener(type, lockInput, true);
          yes.addEventListener("click", () => {
            acknowledged = true;
            if (win) for (const type of ["keydown", "keyup", "keypress"]) win.removeEventListener(type, lockInput, true);
            overlay.remove();
            gate = null;
          });
          no.addEventListener("click", () => {
            overlay.innerHTML = "";
            overlay.textContent = "This game is only for adults aged 18 and over. Please close this page.";
            overlay.style.textAlign = "center"; overlay.style.fontSize = "20px";
          });
          gate = overlay;
          // (nothing is focused: a stray Enter or Space must not answer an age question — the player clicks, or Tabs to a button and presses it)
          return overlay;
        }
      
        function mountLaunchGate() {
          if (!doc?.body || gate) return null;
          const adopted = adoptStaticGate();
          if (adopted) return adopted;
          const overlay = element("div", overlayCss);
          overlay.id = "gtbAdultGate";
          const card = element("section", cardCss);
          card.setAttribute("role", "dialog");
          card.setAttribute("aria-modal", "true");
          card.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", "gtbAdultTitle");
          let continueBtn, leaveBtn;
          const focusables = () => [continueBtn, leaveBtn].filter(Boolean);
          const lockInput = (e) => {
            if (acknowledged) return;
            // This runs at window capture so the game never receives keys (movement, menus, shortcuts) until the player has answered.
            // Reproduce the small set of native keyboard actions the gate needs: Tab moves between the two buttons, Enter / Space press one.
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            const controls = focusables();
            if (e.type !== "keydown") return;
            if (e.key === "Tab") {
              const index = controls.indexOf(e.target);
              const step = e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1;
              const next = controls[(index + step + controls.length) % controls.length];
              next?.focus?.();
            } else if (["Enter", " ", "Spacebar"].includes(e.key)) {
              if (controls.includes(e.target)) e.target.click?.();
            }
          };
          const unlockKeys = () => {
            if (win) for (const type of ["keydown", "keyup", "keypress"]) win.removeEventListener(type, lockInput, true);
          };
          if (win) for (const type of ["keydown", "keyup", "keypress"]) win.addEventListener(type, lockInput, true);
          const title = element("h1", titleCss, "YOU MUST BE OVER 18 TO PLAY THIS GAME");

  content: |
      import assert from "node:assert/strict";
      import path from "node:path";
      import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
      import puppeteer from "puppeteer";
      
      const pageUrl = pathToFileURL(path.resolve("index.html")).href;
      const browser = await puppeteer.launch({
        ...(process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH } : {}),
        headless: true,
        args: ["--allow-file-access-from-files", "--no-sandbox"],
      });
      try {
        const page = await browser.newPage();
        // Emulate a browser that does not expose Web Crypto so this case is deterministic
        // even when the test runner itself has crypto.subtle enabled for file URLs.
        await page.evaluateOnNewDocument(() => {
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", { configurable: true, value: {} });
        });
        await page.goto(pageUrl, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await page.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessInput");
      
        const before = await page.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          hidden: error.hidden,
          role: error.getAttribute("role"),
          live: error.getAttribute("aria-live"),
        }));
        const inputSemantics = await page.$eval("#gtbAccessInput", (input) => ({
          describedBy: input.getAttribute("aria-describedby"),
          label: input.labels[0]?.textContent.trim(),
          autocomplete: input.autocomplete,
          autocapitalize: input.getAttribute("autocapitalize"),
          autocorrect: input.getAttribute("autocorrect"),
          enterKeyHint: input.enterKeyHint,
          fontSize: getComputedStyle(input).fontSize,
        }));
        assert.deepEqual(before, { hidden: true, role: "alert", live: "polite" }, "error region starts hidden and is announced accessibly");
        assert.deepEqual(inputSemantics, {
          describedBy: "gtbAccessError",
          label: "Access password",
          autocomplete: "off",
          autocapitalize: "off",
          autocorrect: "off",
          enterKeyHint: "go",
          fontSize: "16px",
        }, "password field has an accessible label and mobile-appropriate input hints");
      
        await page.focus("#gtbAccessInput");
        await page.keyboard.press("Enter");
        await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector("#gtbAccessError").hidden);
        const after = await page.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          text: error.textContent,
          invalid: document.querySelector("#gtbAccessInput").getAttribute("aria-invalid"),
        }));
        assert.match(after.text, /opened as a file/i, "file:// gets specific guidance");
        assert.match(after.text, /start-game\.cmd|npm start/i, "instructions explain how to start the local server");
        assert.equal(after.invalid, "true", "unsupported verification marks the password field invalid");
      
        await page.type("#gtbAccessInput", "x");
        const cleared = await page.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          hidden: error.hidden,
          text: error.textContent,
          invalid: document.querySelector("#gtbAccessInput").getAttribute("aria-invalid"),
        }));
        assert.deepEqual(cleared, { hidden: true, text: "", invalid: null }, "editing the password clears stale feedback and invalid state");
      
        console.log("Password-gate mobile and accessibility browser test passed");
      } finally {
        await browser.close();
      }

- path: tools\qa\lib\agegate.mjs
  content: |
      // The game opens with an "I am over 18 years of age" gate (src/adultContent.js) that covers the page and swallows keys and clicks until it is
      // answered. QA scripts drive the page with the keyboard and mouse, so they answer it exactly the way a player does — by pressing the button —
      // the moment it appears. (There is deliberately no bypass in the game itself.)
      export async function autoAcknowledge(page) {
        await page.evaluateOnNewDocument(() => {
          const press = () => { const b = document.querySelector('#gtbAdultGate button'); if (b && /OVER 18/.test(b.textContent)) b.click(); };
          new MutationObserver(press).observe(document, { childList: true, subtree: true });
          document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', press);
        });
      }

If a player quickly enters the password, they might click "I am 18" prematurely, resulting in the button not responding since no handler is bound yet. This likely causes frustration for users. I’m considering adding an inline handler in the early HTML to ensure that the button is responsive. Better event delegation might help too, but I need to maintain the acknowledged state used by the singleton method.**Improving age gate functionality**
> 
> The API only supports click-based acknowledgment triggers, which complicates handling the age gate. I’m thinking about using an inline click listener queued on the button before the module fully integrates. This would allow us to store the intent of early clicks, which might mitigate age verification issues. Creating a basic DOM listener immediately can remove the gate, but since the adultContent singleton imports afterwards, we need to track a global marker and check for pre-acknowledged state. This feels like a bit of a workaround, but it might work!**Considering event handling**
> 
> I’m reflecting on the standard adult content event handler and whether it needs to set a flag upon clicking. It seems like, in the adopt callback, I should definitely set this globally for consistency. But should I remove it for generated gates since only static pages use inline? The creation of the API does receive a win, and I wonder if there's a better way to manage properties on the window without inlining event handlers in the HTML.

I found a likely race: the 18+ button is static, but its click handler is normally attached only after the game’s larger JavaScript module graph finishes loading. If you enter the password before that finishes, the button can appear but do nothing. I’m fixing the button to respond immediately, and making the game remember that explicit click when its module starts later.

  content: |
      import assert from "node:assert/strict";
      import { createServer } from "node:http";
      import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
      import path from "node:path";
      import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
      import puppeteer from "puppeteer";
      
      const root = process.cwd();
      const html = await readFile(path.join(root, "index.html"), "utf8");
      const accessHash = html.match(/var GTB_ACCESS_HASH = "([a-f0-9]+)"/)?.[1];
      assert.ok(accessHash, "private-access verifier hash exists");
      
      // Serve the actual page over localhost (so Web Crypto is available), but load only
      // the real age-gate module rather than starting the full game during this UI test.
      let markAdultModuleRequested;
      const adultModuleRequested = new Promise((resolve) => { markAdultModuleRequested = resolve; });
      const server = createServer(async (req, res) => {
        const pathname = new URL(req.url, "http://localhost").pathname;
        if (pathname === "/" || pathname === "/index.html") {
          const testHtml = html.replace(
            '<script type="module" src="./src/main.js"></script>',
            '<script type="module" src="/src/adultContent.js"></script>',
          );
          res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" }).end(testHtml);
        } else if (pathname === "/src/adultContent.js") {
          markAdultModuleRequested();
          // Hold the module back to reproduce a slow phone/network where a player can
          // press the visible first-paint age button before its module listener exists.
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1200));
          res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8" })
            .end(`${await readFile(path.join(root, "src/adultContent.js"), "utf8")}\\nwindow.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_LOADED = true;`);
        } else {
          res.writeHead(404).end("Not found");
        }
      });
      await new Promise((resolve) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve));
      const address = server.address();
      const localUrl = `http://127.0.0.1:${address.port}/`;
      const browser = await puppeteer.launch({
        ...(process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH } : {}),
        headless: true,
        args: ["--allow-file-access-from-files", "--no-sandbox"],
      });
      try {
        // Verify the unsupported file:// message and its accessible error state.
        const unsupportedPage = await browser.newPage();
        await unsupportedPage.evaluateOnNewDocument(() => {
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", { configurable: true, value: {} });
        });
        await unsupportedPage.goto(pathToFileURL(path.join(root, "index.html")).href, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await unsupportedPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessInput");
      
        const before = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          hidden: error.hidden,
          role: error.getAttribute("role"),
          live: error.getAttribute("aria-live"),
        }));
        const inputSemantics = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessInput", (input) => ({
          describedBy: input.getAttribute("aria-describedby"),
          label: input.labels[0]?.textContent.trim(),
          autocomplete: input.autocomplete,
          autocapitalize: input.getAttribute("autocapitalize"),
          autocorrect: input.getAttribute("autocorrect"),
          enterKeyHint: input.enterKeyHint,
          fontSize: getComputedStyle(input).fontSize,
        }));
        assert.deepEqual(before, { hidden: true, role: "alert", live: "polite" }, "error region starts hidden and is announced accessibly");
        assert.deepEqual(inputSemantics, {
          describedBy: "gtbAccessError",
          label: "Access password",
          autocomplete: "off",
          autocapitalize: "off",
          autocorrect: "off",
          enterKeyHint: "go",
          fontSize: "16px",
        }, "password field has an accessible label and mobile-appropriate input hints");
      
        await unsupportedPage.focus("#gtbAccessInput");
        await unsupportedPage.keyboard.press("Enter");
        await unsupportedPage.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector("#gtbAccessError").hidden);
        const after = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          text: error.textContent,
          invalid: document.querySelector("#gtbAccessInput").getAttribute("aria-invalid"),
        }));
        assert.match(after.text, /opened as a file/i, "file:// gets specific guidance");
        assert.match(after.text, /start-game\.cmd|npm start/i, "instructions explain how to start the local server");
        assert.equal(after.invalid, "true", "unsupported verification marks the password field invalid");
      
        await unsupportedPage.type("#gtbAccessInput", "x");
        const cleared = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          hidden: error.hidden,
          text: error.textContent,
          invalid: document.querySelector("#gtbAccessInput").getAttribute("aria-invalid"),
        }));
        assert.deepEqual(cleared, { hidden: true, text: "", invalid: null }, "editing the password clears stale feedback and invalid state");
      
        // Exercise the actual browser interaction reported as broken: a successful
        // password submit removes the upper overlay, then a mouse click confirms age.
        const flowPage = await browser.newPage();
        await flowPage.evaluateOnNewDocument((hash) => {
          const bytes = Uint8Array.from(hash.match(/../g), (pair) => parseInt(pair, 16));
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", {
            configurable: true,
            value: { subtle: { digest: () => Promise.resolve(bytes.buffer) } },
          });
        }, accessHash);
        await flowPage.goto(localUrl, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await flowPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAgeYes");
        await adultModuleRequested;
        await flowPage.type("#gtbAccessInput", "browser-test-password");
        await flowPage.click("#gtbAccessSubmit");
        await flowPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessGate", { hidden: true });
        assert.equal(await flowPage.$eval("#gtbAdultGate", (gate) => getComputedStyle(gate).display), "flex", "the age gate remains visible after password acceptance");
        await flowPage.click("#gtbAgeYes");
        await flowPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAdultGate", { hidden: true });
        assert.equal(await flowPage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_AGE_GATE_ACKNOWLEDGED), true, "first-paint click is retained while the game module is loading");
        await flowPage.waitForFunction(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_LOADED === true);
        assert.equal(await flowPage.$("#gtbAdultGate"), null, "late module initialization does not reopen a gate already confirmed");
      
        console.log("Password-gate feedback and password-to-age mouse flow browser tests passed");
      } finally {
        await browser.close();
        await new Promise((resolve, reject) => server.close((error) => error ? reject(error) : resolve()));
      }
      
  referencedBy: {}
- path: src\adultContent.js
  content: |
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // adultContent.js — per-launch adult acknowledgement and optional rhythm game.
      //
      // The 18+ gate is shown at the start of EVERY launch (nothing is remembered): the whole game is for adults. The optional activity
      // preference is stored separately and defaults off. No explicit content is
      // presented: the optional activity is a fully-dressed dance rhythm challenge.
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      
      const OPT_IN_KEY = "gtb.adult.privateDanceOptIn";
      const ARROWS = [
        { key: "ArrowUp", glyph: "↑" },
        { key: "ArrowDown", glyph: "↓" },
        { key: "ArrowLeft", glyph: "←" },
        { key: "ArrowRight", glyph: "→" },
      ];
      
      export function makeBeatPattern(rng = Math.random, count = 8) {
        return Array.from({ length: count }, () => ARROWS[Math.floor(rng() * ARROWS.length)].key);
      }
      
      export function gradeRhythm(score, total) {
        if (!total) return "No score";
        const ratio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, score / total));
        return ratio >= 0.85 ? "Bayou legend" : ratio >= 0.6 ? "Right on the beat" : ratio >= 0.35 ? "Finding the groove" : "Keep practicing";
      }
      
      function safeStorage(storage) {
        return storage || {
          getItem(key) { try { return globalThis.localStorage?.getItem(key) ?? null; } catch { return null; } },
          setItem(key, value) { try { globalThis.localStorage?.setItem(key, value); } catch {} },
        };
      }
      
      export function createAdultContent({ document: doc = globalThis.document, window: win = globalThis.window, storage } = {}) {
        const store = safeStorage(storage);
        let acknowledged = win?.__GTB_AGE_GATE_ACKNOWLEDGED === true;
        let optIn = store.getItem(OPT_IN_KEY) === "true";
        let gate = null;
        let game = null;
        let pauseHandler = null;
      
        const element = (tag, css, text = "") => {
          const el = doc.createElement(tag);
          el.style.cssText = css;
          if (text) el.textContent = text;
          return el;
        };
        const overlayCss = "position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100000;background:rgba(6,8,12,.97);color:#f4f1ea;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;font:16px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;";
        const cardCss = "box-sizing:border-box;width:min(640px,100%);padding:clamp(22px,5vw,44px);background:#151923;border:2px solid #ff4fb3;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 18px 70px #000;";
        const titleCss = "margin:0 0 14px;color:#ff8ad0;font:900 clamp(24px,5vw,36px)/1.1 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.04em;";
        const labelCss = "display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;margin:18px 0;padding:12px;border:1px solid #454554;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;";
        const buttonCss = "padding:12px 18px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:#ff4fb3;color:#17111a;font:800 15px system-ui;cursor:pointer;";
      
        function setOptIn(value) {
          optIn = !!value;
          store.setItem(OPT_IN_KEY, String(optIn));
          return optIn;
        }
        function enabled() { return acknowledged && optIn; }
      
        // The gate is normally the STATIC markup at the top of index.html (painted before any script or loading screen): adopt its two buttons.
        // If it is not there (tests, another host page) the same gate is built in script below.
        function adoptStaticGate() {
          const overlay = doc?.getElementById?.("gtbAdultGate");
          if (!overlay || gate) return null;
          const yes = doc.getElementById("gtbAgeYes"), no = doc.getElementById("gtbAgeNo");
          if (!yes || !no) return null;
          const controls = [yes, no];
          const lockInput = (e) => {
            if (acknowledged) return;
            // The private access form is layered above this gate. Let it receive normal
            // typing/Enter input instead of swallowing keys at the window capture phase.
            const accessGate = doc.getElementById?.("gtbAccessGate");
            if (accessGate && (accessGate === e.target || accessGate.contains?.(e.target))) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            if (e.type !== "keydown") return;
            if (e.key === "Tab") {
              const next = controls[(controls.indexOf(e.target) + (e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1) + controls.length) % controls.length];
              next?.focus?.();
            } else if (["Enter", " ", "Spacebar"].includes(e.key) && controls.includes(e.target)) e.target.click?.();
          };
          if (win) for (const type of ["keydown", "keyup", "keypress"]) win.addEventListener(type, lockInput, true);
          yes.addEventListener("click", () => {
            acknowledged = true;
            if (win) win.__GTB_AGE_GATE_ACKNOWLEDGED = true;
            if (win) for (const type of ["keydown", "keyup", "keypress"]) win.removeEventListener(type, lockInput, true);
            overlay.remove();
            gate = null;
          });
          no.addEventListener("click", () => {
            overlay.innerHTML = "";
            overlay.textContent = "This game is only for adults aged 18 and over. Please close this page.";
            overlay.style.textAlign = "center"; overlay.style.fontSize = "20px";
          });
          gate = overlay;
          // (nothing is focused: a stray Enter or Space must not answer an age question — the player clicks, or Tabs to a button and presses it)
          return overlay;
        }
      
        function mountLaunchGate() {
          if (!doc?.body || gate) return null;
          const adopted = adoptStaticGate();
          if (adopted) return adopted;
          const overlay = element("div", overlayCss);
          overlay.id = "gtbAdultGate";
          const card = element("section", cardCss);
          card.setAttribute("role", "dialog");
          card.setAttribute("aria-modal", "true");
          card.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", "gtbAdultTitle");
          let continueBtn, leaveBtn;
          const focusables = () => [continueBtn, leaveBtn].filter(Boolean);
          const lockInput = (e) => {
            if (acknowledged) return;
            // This runs at window capture so the game never receives keys (movement, menus, shortcuts) until the player has answered.
            // Reproduce the small set of native keyboard actions the gate needs: Tab moves between the two buttons, Enter / Space press one.
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            const controls = focusables();
            if (e.type !== "keydown") return;
            if (e.key === "Tab") {
              const index = controls.indexOf(e.target);
              const step = e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1;
              const next = controls[(index + step + controls.length) % controls.length];
              next?.focus?.();
            } else if (["Enter", " ", "Spacebar"].includes(e.key)) {
              if (controls.includes(e.target)) e.target.click?.();
            }
          };
          const unlockKeys = () => {
            if (win) for (const type of ["keydown", "keyup", "keypress"]) win.removeEventListener(type, lockInput, true);
          };
          if (win) for (const type of ["keydown", "keyup", "keypress"]) win.addEventListener(type, lockInput, true);
          const title = element("h1", titleCss, "YOU MUST BE OVER 18 TO PLAY THIS GAME");
          title.id = "gtbAdultTitle";
          const warning = element("p", "margin:0 0 12px;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;", "This game contains gore, drugs, violence, horror, and explicit sexual content. It is for adults only and is NOT suitable for anyone under 18. Nobody under 18 should play this game.");
          const details = element("p", "margin:0 0 22px;color:#c4c6d0;", "This is an R18+ game. It contains gore, graphic violence, drug use, sex and sexual themes, horror and strong language. By continuing you confirm that you are 18 or older.");
          continueBtn = element("button", buttonCss + "display:block;width:100%;margin:0 0 10px;padding:16px 18px;font-size:17px;", "I AM OVER 18 YEARS OF AGE");
          continueBtn.type = "button";
          leaveBtn = element("button", buttonCss + "display:block;width:100%;background:#2b3040;color:#c9ccd8;font-weight:600;", "I AM UNDER 18 · LEAVE");
          leaveBtn.type = "button";
          const note = element("p", "margin:14px 0 0;color:#999daa;font-size:12px;", "You will be asked again every time the game starts.");
          continueBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
            acknowledged = true;
            unlockKeys();
            overlay.remove();
            gate = null;
          });
          leaveBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
            // not an adult: nothing of the game is shown — the page is replaced by a plain notice and the game stays locked
            try { doc.body.replaceChildren?.(); } catch {}
            const bye = element("div", overlayCss + "text-align:center;", "This game is only for adults aged 18 and over. Please close this page.");
            doc.body.appendChild(bye);
          });
          card.append(title, warning, details, continueBtn, leaveBtn, note);
          overlay.appendChild(card);
          doc.body.appendChild(overlay);
          gate = overlay;
          return overlay;
        }
      
        function closeGame(result = null) {
          if (!game) return;
          const active = game;
          game = null;
          if (win) win.removeEventListener("keydown", active.onKey, true);
          clearTimeout(active.timer);
          active.overlay.remove();
          if (pauseHandler) pauseHandler(false);
          if (active.onFinish) active.onFinish(result);
        }
      
        function openRhythmGame({ venue = "the club", onBegin = () => true, onFinish = () => {} } = {}) {
          if (!enabled() || !doc?.body || game) return false;
          const overlay = element("div", overlayCss + "z-index:100001;");
          overlay.id = "gtbDanceRhythm";
          const card = element("section", cardCss + "text-align:center;");
          card.setAttribute("role", "dialog"); card.setAttribute("aria-modal", "true");
          const title = element("h2", titleCss, `PRIVATE DANCE · ${venue.toUpperCase()}`);
          const intro = element("p", "color:#d2d3dc;", "A fully-dressed, non-explicit dance rhythm challenge with a fictional adult performer. You can leave at any time.");
          const prompt = element("div", "margin:22px 0;font:900 clamp(52px,12vw,88px)/1 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#fff;min-height:1em;", "Ready?");
          const progress = element("p", "color:#c4c6d0;", "Press the matching arrow when it appears.");
          const controls = element("div", "display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;");
          for (const arrow of ARROWS) {
            const b = element("button", "width:52px;height:46px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid #666;background:#242938;color:#fff;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;", arrow.glyph);
            b.type = "button"; b.setAttribute("aria-label", `Dance ${arrow.key.replace("Arrow", "").toLowerCase()}`);
            b.addEventListener("click", () => submit(arrow.key)); controls.appendChild(b);
          }
          const actions = element("div", "display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:12px;margin-top:22px;");
          const start = element("button", buttonCss, "START PRIVATE DANCE"); start.type = "button";
          const cancel = element("button", buttonCss + "background:#454957;color:#fff;", "CANCEL"); cancel.type = "button";
          actions.append(start, cancel);
          card.append(title, intro, prompt, progress, controls, actions); overlay.appendChild(card); doc.body.appendChild(overlay);
      
          const seq = makeBeatPattern();
          let index = 0, score = 0, started = false, stepMs = 850;
          const active = { overlay, onFinish, result: null, timer: 0, onKey: null };
          function paint() {
            if (!game) return;
            if (index >= seq.length) {
              const result = { score, total: seq.length, rating: gradeRhythm(score, seq.length) };
              prompt.textContent = `${score} / ${seq.length}`;
              progress.textContent = result.rating;
              start.hidden = true;
              cancel.textContent = "DONE";
              game.result = result;
              return;
            }
            prompt.textContent = ARROWS.find((a) => a.key === seq[index]).glyph;
            progress.textContent = `Beat ${index + 1} of ${seq.length} · ${score} on time`;
          }
          function submit(key) {
            if (!game || !started || index >= seq.length) return;
            if (seq[index] === key) score++;
            index++;
            clearTimeout(active.timer);
            paint();
            if (index < seq.length) advance();
          }
          function advance() {
            if (!game || index >= seq.length) return;
            paint();
            active.timer = setTimeout(() => {
              if (!game) return;
              index++;
              paint();
              advance();
            }, stepMs);
          }
          const onKey = (e) => {
            if (!game) return;
            if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); closeGame(); return; }
            if (ARROWS.some((a) => a.key === e.key)) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); submit(e.key); }
          };
          active.onKey = onKey;
          game = active;
          if (win) win.addEventListener("keydown", onKey, true);
          start.addEventListener("click", () => {
            if (!enabled() || started) return;
            if (onBegin() === false) { progress.textContent = "The activity could not start. You were not charged."; return; }
            started = true; start.hidden = true;
            if (pauseHandler) pauseHandler(true);
            paint(); advance();
          });
          cancel.addEventListener("click", () => closeGame(game?.result || null));
          paint();
          return true;
        }
      
        function createOptInControl() {
          const label = element("label", labelCss);
          const checkbox = doc.createElement("input");
          checkbox.type = "checkbox"; checkbox.checked = optIn;
          checkbox.addEventListener("change", () => setOptIn(checkbox.checked));
          const text = element("span", "", "Enable optional non-explicit private dance rhythm activity (18+ acknowledgement required each launch). Off by default.");
          label.append(checkbox, text);
