          acknowledged: () => acknowledged,

          closeRhythmGame: () => closeGame(),
          get gameActive() { return !!game; },
          get gateVisible() { return !!gate; },
        };
        // The main module loads after HTML parsing; mounting here puts the warning
        // over the loading screen and requires acknowledgement on every page launch.
        if (doc?.body && !acknowledged) mountLaunchGate();
        return api;
      }

      export function createAdultContent({ document: doc = globalThis.document, window: win = globalThis.window, storage } = {}) {
        const store = safeStorage(storage);
        let acknowledged = win?.__GTB_AGE_GATE_ACKNOWLEDGED === true;
        let optIn = store.getItem(OPT_IN_KEY) === "true";
        let gate = null;
        let game = null;
        let pauseHandler = null;
      
        const element = (tag, css, text = "") => {
          const el = doc.createElement(tag);
          el.style.cssText = css;
          if (text) el.textContent = text;
          return el;
        };
        const overlayCss = "position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100000;background:rgba(6,8,12,.97);color:#f4f1ea;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;font:16px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;";
        const cardCss = "box-sizing:border-box;width:min(640px,100%);padding:clamp(22px,5vw,44px);background:#151923;border:2px solid #ff4fb3;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 18px 70px #000;";
        const titleCss = "margin:0 0 14px;color:#ff8ad0;font:900 clamp(24px,5vw,36px)/1.1 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.04em;";
        const labelCss = "display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;margin:18px 0;padding:12px;border:1px solid #454554;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;";
        const buttonCss = "padding:12px 18px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:#ff4fb3;color:#17111a;font:800 15px system-ui;cursor:pointer;";
      
        function setOptIn(value) {
          optIn = !!value;
          store.setItem(OPT_IN_KEY, String(optIn));
          return optIn;
        }
        function enabled() { return acknowledged && optIn; }
      
        // The gate is normally the STATIC markup at the top of index.html (painted before any script or loading screen): adopt its two buttons.
        // If it is not there (tests, another host page) the same gate is built in script below.
        function adoptStaticGate() {
          const overlay = doc?.getElementById?.("gtbAdultGate");
          if (!overlay || gate) return null;
          const yes = doc.getElementById("gtbAgeYes"), no = doc.getElementById("gtbAgeNo");
          if (!yes || !no) return null;
          const controls = [yes, no];
          const lockInput = (e) => {
            if (acknowledged) return;
            // The private access form is layered above this gate. Let it receive normal
            // typing/Enter input instead of swallowing keys at the window capture phase.
            const accessGate = doc.getElementById?.("gtbAccessGate");
            if (accessGate && (accessGate === e.target || accessGate.contains?.(e.target))) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            if (e.type !== "keydown") return;
            if (e.key === "Tab") {
              const next = controls[(controls.indexOf(e.target) + (e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1) + controls.length) % controls.length];
              next?.focus?.();
            } else if (["Enter", " ", "Spacebar"].includes(e.key) && controls.includes(e.target)) e.target.click?.();
          };
          if (win) for (const type of ["keydown", "keyup", "keypress"]) win.addEventListener(type, lockInput, true);
          yes.addEventListener("click", () => {
            acknowledged = true;
            if (win) win.__GTB_AGE_GATE_ACKNOWLEDGED = true;
            if (win) for (const type of ["keydown", "keyup", "keypress"]) win.removeEventListener(type, lockInput, true);
            overlay.remove();
            gate = null;
          });
          no.addEventListener("click", () => {
            overlay.innerHTML = "";
            overlay.textContent = "This game is only for adults aged 18 and over. Please close this page.";
            overlay.style.textAlign = "center"; overlay.style.fontSize = "20px";
          });
          gate = overlay;
          // (nothing is focused: a stray Enter or Space must not answer an age question — the player clicks, or Tabs to a button and presses it)
          return overlay;
        }
      
        function mountLaunchGate() {
          if (!doc?.body || gate) return null;
          const adopted = adoptStaticGate();
          if (adopted) return adopted;
          const overlay = element("div", overlayCss);
          overlay.id = "gtbAdultGate";

- path: tools\qa\access_gate_browser_test.mjs
  content: |
      import assert from "node:assert/strict";
      import { createServer } from "node:http";
      import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
      import path from "node:path";
      import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
      import puppeteer from "puppeteer";
      
      const root = process.cwd();
      const html = await readFile(path.join(root, "index.html"), "utf8");
      const accessHash = html.match(/var GTB_ACCESS_HASH = "([a-f0-9]+)"/)?.[1];
      assert.ok(accessHash, "private-access verifier hash exists");
      
      // Serve the actual page over localhost (so Web Crypto is available), but load only
      // the real age-gate module rather than starting the full game during this UI test.
      let markAdultModuleRequested, releaseAdultModule;
      const adultModuleRequested = new Promise((resolve) => { markAdultModuleRequested = resolve; });
      const allowAdultModuleResponse = new Promise((resolve) => { releaseAdultModule = resolve; });
      const server = createServer(async (req, res) => {
        const pathname = new URL(req.url, "http://localhost").pathname;
        if (pathname === "/" || pathname === "/index.html") {
          const testHtml = html.replace(
            '<script type="module" src="./src/main.js"></script>',
            '<script type="module" src="/src/adultContent.js"></script>',
          );
          res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" }).end(testHtml);
        } else if (pathname === "/src/adultContent.js") {
          markAdultModuleRequested();
          // Hold the module until the test clicks the visible first-paint button, just
          // like a player can do on a slow connection before this module listener loads.
          await allowAdultModuleResponse;
          const moduleText = await readFile(path.join(root, "src/adultContent.js"), "utf8");
          res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8" })
            .end(`${moduleText}\nwindow.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_ACKNOWLEDGED = adultContent.acknowledged();\nwindow.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_LOADED = true;`);
        } else {
          res.writeHead(404).end("Not found");
        }
      });
      await new Promise((resolve) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve));
      const address = server.address();
      const localUrl = `http://127.0.0.1:${address.port}/`;
      const browser = await puppeteer.launch({
        ...(process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH } : {}),
        headless: true,
        args: ["--allow-file-access-from-files", "--no-sandbox"],
      });
      try {
        // Verify the unsupported file:// message and its accessible error state.
        const unsupportedPage = await browser.newPage();
        await unsupportedPage.evaluateOnNewDocument(() => {
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", { configurable: true, value: {} });
        });
        await unsupportedPage.goto(pathToFileURL(path.join(root, "index.html")).href, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await unsupportedPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessInput");
      
        const before = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          hidden: error.hidden,
          role: error.getAttribute("role"),
          live: error.getAttribute("aria-live"),
        }));
        const inputSemantics = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessInput", (input) => ({
          describedBy: input.getAttribute("aria-describedby"),
          label: input.labels[0]?.textContent.trim(),
          autocomplete: input.autocomplete,
          autocapitalize: input.getAttribute("autocapitalize"),
          autocorrect: input.getAttribute("autocorrect"),
          enterKeyHint: input.enterKeyHint,
          fontSize: getComputedStyle(input).fontSize,
        }));
        assert.deepEqual(before, { hidden: true, role: "alert", live: "polite" }, "error region starts hidden and is announced accessibly");
        assert.deepEqual(inputSemantics, {
          describedBy: "gtbAccessError",
          label: "Access password",
          autocomplete: "off",
          autocapitalize: "off",
          autocorrect: "off",
          enterKeyHint: "go",
          fontSize: "16px",
        }, "password field has an accessible label and mobile-appropriate input hints");
      
        await unsupportedPage.focus("#gtbAccessInput");
        await unsupportedPage.keyboard.press("Enter");
        await unsupportedPage.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector("#gtbAccessError").hidden);
        const after = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          text: error.textContent,
          invalid: document.querySelector("#gtbAccessInput").getAttribute("aria-invalid"),
        }));
        assert.match(after.text, /opened as a file/i, "file:// gets specific guidance");
        assert.match(after.text, /start-game\.cmd|npm start/i, "instructions explain how to start the local server");
        assert.equal(after.invalid, "true", "unsupported verification marks the password field invalid");
      
        await unsupportedPage.type("#gtbAccessInput", "x");
        const cleared = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          hidden: error.hidden,
          text: error.textContent,
          invalid: document.querySelector("#gtbAccessInput").getAttribute("aria-invalid"),
        }));
        assert.deepEqual(cleared, { hidden: true, text: "", invalid: null }, "editing the password clears stale feedback and invalid state");
      
        // Exercise the actual browser interaction reported as broken: a successful
        // password submit removes the upper overlay, then a mouse click confirms age.
        const flowPage = await browser.newPage();
        await flowPage.evaluateOnNewDocument((hash) => {
          const bytes = Uint8Array.from(hash.match(/../g), (pair) => parseInt(pair, 16));
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", {
            configurable: true,
            value: { subtle: { digest: () => Promise.resolve(bytes.buffer) } },
          });
        }, accessHash);
        const navigation = flowPage.goto(localUrl, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await flowPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAgeYes");
        await adultModuleRequested;
        await flowPage.type("#gtbAccessInput", "browser-test-password");
        await flowPage.click("#gtbAccessSubmit");
        await flowPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessGate", { hidden: true });
        assert.equal(await flowPage.$eval("#gtbAdultGate", (gate) => getComputedStyle(gate).display), "flex", "the age gate remains visible after password acceptance");
        await flowPage.click("#gtbAgeYes");
        await flowPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAdultGate", { hidden: true });
        assert.equal(await flowPage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_AGE_GATE_ACKNOWLEDGED), true, "first-paint click is retained while the game module is loading");
        releaseAdultModule();
        await navigation;
        await flowPage.waitForFunction(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_LOADED === true);
        assert.equal(await flowPage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_ACKNOWLEDGED), true, "late module initialization preserves the explicit age confirmation");
        assert.equal(await flowPage.$("#gtbAdultGate"), null, "late module initialization does not reopen a gate already confirmed");
      
        console.log("Password-gate feedback and password-to-age mouse flow browser tests passed");
      } finally {
        releaseAdultModule();
        await browser.close();
        await new Promise((resolve, reject) => server.close((error) => error ? reject(error) : resolve()));
      }

        // The gate is normally the STATIC markup at the top of index.html (painted before any script or loading screen): adopt its two buttons.
        // If it is not there (tests, another host page) the same gate is built in script below.
        function adoptStaticGate() {
          const overlay = doc?.getElementById?.("gtbAdultGate");
          if (!overlay || gate) return null;
          const yes = doc.getElementById("gtbAgeYes"), no = doc.getElementById("gtbAgeNo");
          if (!yes || !no) return null;
          const controls = [yes, no];
          const lockInput = (e) => {
            if (acknowledged) return;
            // The private access form is layered above this gate. Let it receive normal
            // typing/Enter input instead of swallowing keys at the window capture phase.
            const accessGate = doc.getElementById?.("gtbAccessGate");
            if (accessGate && (accessGate === e.target || accessGate.contains?.(e.target))) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            if (e.type !== "keydown") return;
            if (e.key === "Tab") {
              const next = controls[(controls.indexOf(e.target) + (e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1) + controls.length) % controls.length];
              next?.focus?.();
            } else if (["Enter", " ", "Spacebar"].includes(e.key) && controls.includes(e.target)) e.target.click?.();
          };
          if (win) for (const type of ["keydown", "keyup", "keypress"]) win.addEventListener(type, lockInput, true);
          yes.addEventListener("click", () => {
            acknowledged = true;
            if (win) win.__GTB_AGE_GATE_ACKNOWLEDGED = true;
            if (win) for (const type of ["keydown", "keyup", "keypress"]) win.removeEventListener(type, lockInput, true);
            overlay.remove();
            gate = null;
          });
          no.addEventListener("click", () => {
            overlay.innerHTML = "";
            overlay.textContent = "This game is only for adults aged 18 and over. Please close this page.";
            overlay.style.textAlign = "center"; overlay.style.fontSize = "20px";
          });
          gate = overlay;
          // (nothing is focused: a stray Enter or Space must not answer an age question — the player clicks, or Tabs to a button and presses it)
          return overlay;
        }

- path: tools\qa\access_gate_browser_test.mjs
  content: |
      import assert from "node:assert/strict";
      import { createServer } from "node:http";
      import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
      import path from "node:path";
      import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
      import puppeteer from "puppeteer";
      
      const root = process.cwd();
      const html = await readFile(path.join(root, "index.html"), "utf8");
      const accessHash = html.match(/var GTB_ACCESS_HASH = "([a-f0-9]+)"/)?.[1];
      assert.ok(accessHash, "private-access verifier hash exists");
      
      // Serve the actual page over localhost (so Web Crypto is available), but load only
      // the real age-gate module rather than starting the full game during this UI test.
      function makeModuleGate() {
        let markRequested, release;
        return {
          requested: new Promise((resolve) => { markRequested = resolve; }),
          markRequested: () => markRequested(),
          wait: new Promise((resolve) => { release = resolve; }),
          release: () => release(),
        };
      }
      const moduleGates = { yes: makeModuleGate(), no: makeModuleGate() };
      const server = createServer(async (req, res) => {
        const requestUrl = new URL(req.url, "http://localhost");
        const pathname = requestUrl.pathname;
        const scenario = requestUrl.searchParams.get("scenario") === "no" ? "no" : "yes";
        if (pathname === "/" || pathname === "/index.html") {
          const testHtml = html.replace(
            '<script type="module" src="./src/main.js"></script>',
            `<script type="module" src="/src/adultContent.js?scenario=${scenario}"></script>`,
          );
          res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" }).end(testHtml);
        } else if (pathname === "/src/adultContent.js") {
          markAdultModuleRequested();
          // Hold the module until the test clicks the visible first-paint button, just
          // like a player can do on a slow connection before this module listener loads.
          await allowAdultModuleResponse;
          const moduleText = await readFile(path.join(root, "src/adultContent.js"), "utf8");
          res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8" })
            .end(`${moduleText}\nwindow.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_ACKNOWLEDGED = adultContent.acknowledged();\nwindow.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_LOADED = true;`);
        } else {
          res.writeHead(404).end("Not found");
        }
      });
      await new Promise((resolve) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve));
      const address = server.address();
      const localUrl = `http://127.0.0.1:${address.port}/`;
      const browser = await puppeteer.launch({
        ...(process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH } : {}),
        headless: true,
        args: ["--allow-file-access-from-files", "--no-sandbox"],
      });
      try {
        // Verify the unsupported file:// message and its accessible error state.
        const unsupportedPage = await browser.newPage();
        await unsupportedPage.evaluateOnNewDocument(() => {
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", { configurable: true, value: {} });
        });
        await unsupportedPage.goto(pathToFileURL(path.join(root, "index.html")).href, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await unsupportedPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessInput");
      
        const before = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          hidden: error.hidden,
          role: error.getAttribute("role"),
          live: error.getAttribute("aria-live"),
        }));
        const inputSemantics = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessInput", (input) => ({
          describedBy: input.getAttribute("aria-describedby"),
          label: input.labels[0]?.textContent.trim(),
          autocomplete: input.autocomplete,
          autocapitalize: input.getAttribute("autocapitalize"),
          autocorrect: input.getAttribute("autocorrect"),
          enterKeyHint: input.enterKeyHint,
          fontSize: getComputedStyle(input).fontSize,
        }));
        assert.deepEqual(before, { hidden: true, role: "alert", live: "polite" }, "error region starts hidden and is announced accessibly");
        assert.deepEqual(inputSemantics, {
          describedBy: "gtbAccessError",
          label: "Access password",
          autocomplete: "off",
          autocapitalize: "off",
          autocorrect: "off",
          enterKeyHint: "go",
          fontSize: "16px",
        }, "password field has an accessible label and mobile-appropriate input hints");
      
        await unsupportedPage.focus("#gtbAccessInput");
        await unsupportedPage.keyboard.press("Enter");
        await unsupportedPage.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector("#gtbAccessError").hidden);
        const after = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          text: error.textContent,
          invalid: document.querySelector("#gtbAccessInput").getAttribute("aria-invalid"),
        }));
        assert.match(after.text, /opened as a file/i, "file:// gets specific guidance");
        assert.match(after.text, /start-game\.cmd|npm start/i, "instructions explain how to start the local server");
        assert.equal(after.invalid, "true", "unsupported verification marks the password field invalid");
      
        await unsupportedPage.type("#gtbAccessInput", "x");
        const cleared = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          hidden: error.hidden,
          text: error.textContent,
          invalid: document.querySelector("#gtbAccessInput").getAttribute("aria-invalid"),
        }));
        assert.deepEqual(cleared, { hidden: true, text: "", invalid: null }, "editing the password clears stale feedback and invalid state");
      
        // Exercise the actual browser interaction reported as broken: a successful
        // password submit removes the upper overlay, then a mouse click confirms age.
        const flowPage = await browser.newPage();
        await flowPage.evaluateOnNewDocument((hash) => {
          const bytes = Uint8Array.from(hash.match(/../g), (pair) => parseInt(pair, 16));
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", {
            configurable: true,
            value: { subtle: { digest: () => Promise.resolve(bytes.buffer) } },
          });
        }, accessHash);
        const navigation = flowPage.goto(`${localUrl}?scenario=yes`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await flowPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAgeYes");
        await moduleGates.yes.requested;
        await flowPage.type("#gtbAccessInput", "browser-test-password");
        await flowPage.click("#gtbAccessSubmit");
        await flowPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessGate", { hidden: true });
        assert.equal(await flowPage.$eval("#gtbAdultGate", (gate) => getComputedStyle(gate).display), "flex", "the age gate remains visible after password acceptance");
        await flowPage.click("#gtbAgeYes");
        await flowPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAdultGate", { hidden: true });
        assert.equal(await flowPage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_AGE_GATE_ACKNOWLEDGED), true, "first-paint click is retained while the game module is loading");
        moduleGates.yes.release();
        await navigation;
        await flowPage.waitForFunction(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_LOADED === true);
        assert.equal(await flowPage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_ACKNOWLEDGED), true, "late module initialization preserves the explicit age confirmation");
        assert.equal(await flowPage.$("#gtbAdultGate"), null, "late module initialization does not reopen a gate already confirmed");
      
        // Under-18 must be handled just as early, but must never acknowledge or
        // unlock gameplay; it should replace the gate with the close-page notice.
        const leavePage = await browser.newPage();
        await leavePage.evaluateOnNewDocument(() => localStorage.removeItem("gtb.access.ok"));
        const leaveNavigation = leavePage.goto(`${localUrl}?scenario=no`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await leavePage.waitForSelector("#gtbAgeNo");
        await moduleGates.no.requested;
        await leavePage.type("#gtbAccessInput", "browser-test-password");
        await leavePage.click("#gtbAccessSubmit");
        await leavePage.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessGate", { hidden: true });
        await leavePage.click("#gtbAgeNo");
        await leavePage.waitForFunction(() => /only for adults aged 18 and over/i.test(document.querySelector("#gtbAdultGate").textContent));
        assert.equal(await leavePage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_AGE_GATE_DECLINED), true, "under-18 choice is recorded before module load");
        assert.notEqual(await leavePage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_AGE_GATE_ACKNOWLEDGED), true, "under-18 choice never acknowledges age");
        assert.equal(await leavePage.$("#gtbAgeYes"), null, "under-18 choice removes the confirmation controls");
        moduleGates.no.release();
        await leaveNavigation;
        await leavePage.waitForFunction(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_LOADED === true);
        assert.equal(await leavePage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_ACKNOWLEDGED), false, "late module remains unacknowledged after under-18 choice");
        assert.equal(await leavePage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_DECLINED), true, "late module preserves the under-18 decision");
        assert.match(await leavePage.$eval("#gtbAdultGate", (gate) => gate.textContent), /Please close this page/, "notice remains after module initialization");
      
        console.log("Password-gate feedback and delayed age-gate choice browser tests passed");
      } finally {
        moduleGates.yes.release();
        moduleGates.no.release();
        await browser.close();
        await new Promise((resolve, reject) => server.close((error) => error ? reject(error) : resolve()));
      }
      
  referencedBy: {}

However, I need to consider that if the user indicates they're under 18, it could affect behavior. I should ensure my tests assert that the game's keyboard is locked. The lock listener is local, meaning while the module's lock isn't attached, the listener stays active. I think I'll need to rewrite the whole test with write_file.

> I think I've found an issue with the writing replacement that leaves `.end(...\\n...`. An earlier output showed that `\\n` was treated as a literal in the template, which might cause a real problem. In JavaScript, the double backslashes mean it resolves to a single newline character. So, I wonder if this is causing the `SyntaxError` since the response could have a backslash out of the token syntax. But some tests passed earlier, making me think the encoding might be the culprit.**Addressing Module Locking Issues**
> 
> I’m thinking about a crucial issue with the module when it starts after "NO" is clicked, and the window flag is declined. When `createAdultContent` is declined as true, there’s no mounting, which is correct, but it leaves the module static without handlers. There's a keyboard lock issue since there’s no handler before the module starts, meaning input can't be locked properly. However, if the adult module eventually loads, the declined state skips the mounting and prevents removing the early capture lock. I want to ensure underage content remains locked, so no duplicate locks are created, and I won’t expose any removal.**Improving Gate Logic and Testing**
> 
> I'm considering if I should set the gate to overlay early if declined. It might not be necessary, but it could improve coherence. There's also a concern that an early static "no" event hides the gate, while I want to keep it in the DOM, which seems good. When the browser dispatches a synthetic key event for underage users, it captures the window early to prevent default actions, which is effective. Maybe I should add some module tests? Running focused tests might be sufficient to address browser regression and validate the existing adult content unit.

The new test exposed a real gap: the under-18 button also had no listener during slow module startup. I’ve added an immediate handler for it too, which replaces the screen with the “close this page” notice and keeps gameplay keys blocked. I’m verifying both age-choice paths now.

- path: tools\qa\access_gate_browser_test.mjs
  content: |
      import assert from "node:assert/strict";
      import { createServer } from "node:http";
      import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
      import path from "node:path";
      import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
      import puppeteer from "puppeteer";
      
      const root = process.cwd();
      const html = await readFile(path.join(root, "index.html"), "utf8");
      const accessHash = html.match(/var GTB_ACCESS_HASH = "([a-f0-9]+)"/)?.[1];
      assert.ok(accessHash, "private-access verifier hash exists");
      
      function makeModuleGate() {
        let markRequested, release;
        return {
          requested: new Promise((resolve) => { markRequested = resolve; }),
          markRequested: () => markRequested(),
          wait: new Promise((resolve) => { release = resolve; }),
          release: () => release(),
        };
      }
      const moduleGates = { yes: makeModuleGate(), no: makeModuleGate() };
      
      // Serve the real access and age gates, delaying the age module until each browser
      // scenario has clicked a first-paint button. Avoid booting the full game here.
      const server = createServer(async (req, res) => {
        const requestUrl = new URL(req.url, "http://localhost");
        const pathname = requestUrl.pathname;
        const scenario = requestUrl.searchParams.get("scenario") === "no" ? "no" : "yes";
        if (pathname === "/" || pathname === "/index.html") {
          const testHtml = html.replace(
            '<script type="module" src="./src/main.js"></script>',
            `<script type="module" src="/src/adultContent.js?scenario=${scenario}"></script>`,
          );
          res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" }).end(testHtml);
        } else if (pathname === "/src/adultContent.js") {
          const gate = moduleGates[scenario];
          gate.markRequested();
          await gate.wait;
          const moduleText = await readFile(path.join(root, "src/adultContent.js"), "utf8");
          res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8" })
            .end(`${moduleText}\nwindow.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_ACKNOWLEDGED = adultContent.acknowledged();\nwindow.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_DECLINED = window.__GTB_AGE_GATE_DECLINED === true;\nwindow.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_LOADED = true;`);
        } else {
          res.writeHead(404).end("Not found");
        }
      });
      await new Promise((resolve) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve));
      const address = server.address();
      const localUrl = `http://127.0.0.1:${address.port}/`;
      const browser = await puppeteer.launch({
        ...(process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH } : {}),
        headless: true,
        args: ["--allow-file-access-from-files", "--no-sandbox"],
      });
      try {
        // Unsupported file:// feedback should be actionable and accessible.
        const unsupportedPage = await browser.newPage();
        await unsupportedPage.evaluateOnNewDocument(() => {
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", { configurable: true, value: {} });
        });
        await unsupportedPage.goto(pathToFileURL(path.join(root, "index.html")).href, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await unsupportedPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessInput");
        const before = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          hidden: error.hidden,
          role: error.getAttribute("role"),
          live: error.getAttribute("aria-live"),
        }));
        const inputSemantics = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessInput", (input) => ({
          describedBy: input.getAttribute("aria-describedby"),
          label: input.labels[0]?.textContent.trim(),
          autocomplete: input.autocomplete,
          autocapitalize: input.getAttribute("autocapitalize"),
          autocorrect: input.getAttribute("autocorrect"),
          enterKeyHint: input.enterKeyHint,
          fontSize: getComputedStyle(input).fontSize,
        }));
        assert.deepEqual(before, { hidden: true, role: "alert", live: "polite" }, "error region starts hidden and is announced accessibly");
        assert.deepEqual(inputSemantics, {
          describedBy: "gtbAccessError",
          label: "Access password",
          autocomplete: "off",
          autocapitalize: "off",
          autocorrect: "off",
          enterKeyHint: "go",
          fontSize: "16px",
        }, "password field has an accessible label and mobile-appropriate input hints");
        await unsupportedPage.focus("#gtbAccessInput");
        await unsupportedPage.keyboard.press("Enter");
        await unsupportedPage.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector("#gtbAccessError").hidden);
        const unsupported = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          text: error.textContent,
          invalid: document.querySelector("#gtbAccessInput").getAttribute("aria-invalid"),
        }));
        assert.match(unsupported.text, /opened as a file/i, "file:// gets specific guidance");
        assert.match(unsupported.text, /start-game\.cmd|npm start/i, "instructions explain how to start the local server");
        assert.equal(unsupported.invalid, "true", "unsupported verification marks the password field invalid");
        await unsupportedPage.type("#gtbAccessInput", "x");
        const cleared = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          hidden: error.hidden,
          text: error.textContent,
          invalid: document.querySelector("#gtbAccessInput").getAttribute("aria-invalid"),
        }));
        assert.deepEqual(cleared, { hidden: true, text: "", invalid: null }, "editing the password clears stale feedback and invalid state");
      
        // Adult choice: the button must work even before adultContent.js has loaded.
        const adultContext = await browser.createBrowserContext();
        const adultPage = await adultContext.newPage();
        await adultPage.evaluateOnNewDocument((hash) => {
          const bytes = Uint8Array.from(hash.match(/../g), (pair) => parseInt(pair, 16));
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", {
            configurable: true,
            value: { subtle: { digest: () => Promise.resolve(bytes.buffer) } },
          });
        }, accessHash);
        const adultNavigation = adultPage.goto(`${localUrl}?scenario=yes`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await adultPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAgeYes");
        await moduleGates.yes.requested;
        await adultPage.type("#gtbAccessInput", "browser-test-password");
        await adultPage.click("#gtbAccessSubmit");
        await adultPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessGate", { hidden: true });
        await adultPage.click("#gtbAgeYes");
        await adultPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAdultGate", { hidden: true });
        assert.equal(await adultPage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_AGE_GATE_ACKNOWLEDGED), true, "adult choice is recorded before module load");
        moduleGates.yes.release();
        await adultPage.waitForFunction(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_LOADED === true);
        assert.equal(await adultPage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_ACKNOWLEDGED), true, "late module preserves adult confirmation");
        assert.equal(await adultPage.$("#gtbAdultGate"), null, "late module does not reopen a confirmed gate");
        await adultNavigation;
        await adultContext.close();
      
        // Under-18 choice: immediately replace the gate with a notice and remain
        // locked, including after the delayed module initializes.
        const leaveContext = await browser.createBrowserContext();
        const leavePage = await leaveContext.newPage();
        await leavePage.evaluateOnNewDocument((hash) => {
          const bytes = Uint8Array.from(hash.match(/../g), (pair) => parseInt(pair, 16));
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", {
            configurable: true,
            value: { subtle: { digest: () => Promise.resolve(bytes.buffer) } },
          });
        }, accessHash);
        const leaveNavigation = leavePage.goto(`${localUrl}?scenario=no`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await leavePage.waitForSelector("#gtbAgeNo");
        await moduleGates.no.requested;
        await leavePage.type("#gtbAccessInput", "browser-test-password");
        await leavePage.click("#gtbAccessSubmit");
        await leavePage.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessGate", { hidden: true });
        await leavePage.click("#gtbAgeNo");
        await leavePage.waitForFunction(() => /only for adults aged 18 and over/i.test(document.querySelector("#gtbAdultGate").textContent));
        assert.equal(await leavePage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_AGE_GATE_DECLINED), true, "under-18 choice is recorded before module load");
        assert.notEqual(await leavePage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_AGE_GATE_ACKNOWLEDGED), true, "under-18 choice never acknowledges age");
        assert.equal(await leavePage.$("#gtbAgeYes"), null, "under-18 choice removes the confirmation controls");
        const gameplayKeyPrevented = await leavePage.evaluate(() => {
          const event = new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "w", bubbles: true, cancelable: true });
          return !window.dispatchEvent(event);
        });
        assert.equal(gameplayKeyPrevented, true, "under-18 choice keeps gameplay keyboard input blocked");
        moduleGates.no.release();
        await leavePage.waitForFunction(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_LOADED === true);
        assert.equal(await leavePage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_ACKNOWLEDGED), false, "late module remains unacknowledged after under-18 choice");
        assert.equal(await leavePage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_DECLINED), true, "late module preserves under-18 decision");
        assert.match(await leavePage.$eval("#gtbAdultGate", (gate) => gate.textContent), /Please close this page/, "notice remains after module initialization");
        await leaveNavigation;

          <button id="gtbAgeYes" type="button" style="display:block;width:100%;margin:0 0 10px;padding:17px 18px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:#ff4fb3;color:#17111a;font:800 17px system-ui;cursor:pointer;">I AM OVER 18 YEARS OF AGE</button>
          <button id="gtbAgeNo" type="button" style="display:block;width:100%;padding:12px 18px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:#2b3040;color:#c9ccd8;font:600 15px system-ui;cursor:pointer;">I AM UNDER 18 · LEAVE</button>

        </section>

      <script>
      // Make the first-paint 18+ button responsive before the full game module graph loads.
      // The module adopts this explicit click later to initialize its in-memory age state.
      (function () {
        var gate = document.getElementById("gtbAdultGate");
        var yes = document.getElementById("gtbAgeYes");
        var no = document.getElementById("gtbAgeNo");
        if (!gate || !yes || !no) return;
        yes.addEventListener("click", function () {
          window.__GTB_AGE_GATE_ACKNOWLEDGED = true;
          gate.remove();
        });
        no.addEventListener("click", function () {
          window.__GTB_AGE_GATE_DECLINED = true;
          gate.replaceChildren();
          gate.textContent = "This game is only for adults aged 18 and over. Please close this page.";
          gate.style.textAlign = "center";
          gate.style.fontSize = "20px";
          // Keep gameplay input blocked even if the game modules have not loaded yet.
          var lockKeys = function (event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopImmediatePropagation();
          };
          ["keydown", "keyup", "keypress"].forEach(function (type) {
            window.addEventListener(type, lockKeys, true);

      import { createSyncCampaign } from "./syncCampaign.js";
      import { createMultiplayer } from "./multiplayer.js";
      import { createStateWorld, STATE_BOUNDS } from "./stateWorld.js";
      
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------- config
      // Dixie Beaux, a Gulf Coast state that isn't Louisiana, honest. US-167 runs south
      // to north up the whole map at x = ROAD_X, and the towns hang off it:
      //
      //   z  130 .. -440   ORLEAROUGE, and its US-167 strip. The swamp, the trailer
      //                    park, the riverfront, the Gulf, Lafourchette to the east,
      //                    and the strip's north end. Keseme's prologue is here.
      //   z -500 .. -720   CHATBORO, on the US-167 / Port Highway crossroads, which is
      //                    the only junction on the way north (chatboro.js)
      //   z -592 .. -1152  TUSOUXROE, away to the north-east across the Tusoux River.
      //                    Mama's house is on its south edge (tusouxroe.js + actone.js)
      //
      // The numbers below are OrleaRouge's own, and always have been — every one of
      // them is measured from (0, 0). The two northern towns take their coordinates
      // from districts.js instead, which is why they can be moved and this cannot.
      const WORLD = 136;           // half-width of the map (x), and its northern extent
      // State-Wide GTA San Andreas scale map bounds (~5 km x 5 km)
      const MAP = { minX: STATE_BOUNDS.minX, maxX: STATE_BOUNDS.maxX, minZ: STATE_BOUNDS.minZ, maxZ: STATE_BOUNDS.maxZ };
      const ROAD_X = -6;           // the highway runs N/S along this line
      const ROAD_HALF = 5;         // half road width
      const LOT_X = 24;            // how far off the centre line a lot's building sits
      const TRUCK_Z = -116;        // south end of the dashed centre line; also where the (now-removed) escape truck used to sit
      const SPAWN_Z = 130;         // bottom of the map
      const SIGN_Z = 126;          // Louisiana sign, just north (in front) of the spawn
      
      // Every business lines the highway. [type, side, z, variant]: side +1 is east,
      // which is the player's RIGHT heading north (−z) from the spawn.
      // A mix of what's actually in assets/: the GAS·N·GEAUX station (Gas_station.fbx),
      // 6twelve (6twelve.fbx), BurgerPiz and Tacos (GLB), storefronts from
      // Buildings.glb (variant = which building). Popeyes: see POPEYES_LOCATIONS.
      const LANDMARKS = [
        ["burgerpiz",  -1, 126],   // immediate LEFT of spawn
        ["gasstation", +1, 108],   // gas station — player's RIGHT, just past the sign
        ["sixtwelve",  -1, 100],   // 6twelve — player's LEFT
        ["popeyes",    +1,  84],
        ["shop",       -1,  78, 0],
        ["burgerpiz",  +1,  56],
        ["shop",       -1,  52, 3],
        ["taco",       -1,  28],
        ["shop",       +1,  30, 5],
        ["gasstation", +1,   6],
        ["shop",       -1, -14, 7],
        ["shop",       +1, -34, 1],
        ["sixtwelve",  -1, -54],
        ["shop",       +1, -74, 8],
        ["taco",       -1, -94],
      ];
      const landmarkPos = (side, z) => [ROAD_X + side * LOT_X, z];
      
      // Popeyes: #1 is a lot on the US-167 strip at the Chatboro end (its entry in
      // LANDMARKS builds it); #2 stands on the OrleaRouge boulevard, reached by driving
      // south over the causeway. Since TASK-084 (human request, 2026-09-26: "we need
      // popeyes and 6twelve ... in the new towns") each state town has one too — Oyster
      // Bay, Port Calypso, Red Dust and Lakeshore call makePopeyes from their own
      // composer landmark stage (see townkit.js shops.popeyes), so this list is the
      // original pair only, and `popeyesPlaced` records all eight (the truck stops at
      // each end of US-167 have one as well: corridors.js).
      const POPEYES_LOCATIONS = [
        { name: "Popeyes #1 · US-167 strip, Chatboro end", lot: { side: +1, z: 84 } },
        { name: "Popeyes #2 · OrleaRouge boulevard", x: ROAD_X + LOT_X, z: 230, rot: -Math.PI / 2 },
      ];
      const popeyesPlaced = [];        // every makePopeyes call records itself (QA checks the count)
      
      const KEEPOUT = [
        ...LANDMARKS.map(([, side, z]) => {
          const [x, lz] = landmarkPos(side, z);
          return { x, z: lz, r: 22 };
        }),
        { x: -46, z: 112, r: 22 },   // trailer park
        { x: 46, z: 92, r: 22 },     // junkyard
        { x: 30, z: 70, r: 10 },     // shack
        ...PROLOGUE_KEEPOUT,         // Mission 1: dirt road into the woods + crash site
      ];
      function inKeepout(x, z) {
        if (x > METRO_BOUNDS.x0 - 4 && x < METRO_BOUNDS.x1 + 4 && z > METRO_BOUNDS.z0 - 4 && z < METRO_BOUNDS.z1 + 4) return true;      // Downtown Bayou (metro.js) owns this ground: no swamp pines in the city
        if (onParishHighway(x, z, 8)) return true;                     // Parish Highway 9
        if (Math.abs(x - ROAD_X) < ROAD_HALF + 4) return true;         // road corridor
        if (Math.abs(x - ROAD_X) < LOT_X + 14) return true;            // the whole strip frontage
        if (Math.hypot(x - ROAD_X, z - SPAWN_Z) < 24) return true;     // clear the spawn + sign
        if (z < -50) return true;                                      // Ruston
        if (z > 142) return true;                                      // causeway + OrleaRouge: no swamp pines
        return KEEPOUT.some((k) => Math.hypot(x - k.x, z - k.z) < k.r);
      }

      import assert from "node:assert/strict";
      import { createServer } from "node:http";
      import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
      import path from "node:path";
      import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
      import puppeteer from "puppeteer";
      
      const root = process.cwd();
      const html = await readFile(path.join(root, "index.html"), "utf8");
      const accessHash = html.match(/var GTB_ACCESS_HASH = "([a-f0-9]+)"/)?.[1];
      assert.ok(accessHash, "private-access verifier hash exists");
      
      function makeModuleGate() {
        let markRequested, release;
        return {
          requested: new Promise((resolve) => { markRequested = resolve; }),
          markRequested: () => markRequested(),
          wait: new Promise((resolve) => { release = resolve; }),
          release: () => release(),
        };
      }
      const moduleGates = { yes: makeModuleGate(), no: makeModuleGate(), touch: makeModuleGate() };
      
      // Serve the real access and age gates, delaying the age module until each browser
      // scenario has clicked a first-paint button. Avoid booting the full game here.
      const server = createServer(async (req, res) => {
        const requestUrl = new URL(req.url, "http://localhost");
        const pathname = requestUrl.pathname;
        const requestedScenario = requestUrl.searchParams.get("scenario");
        const scenario = Object.hasOwn(moduleGates, requestedScenario) ? requestedScenario : "yes";
        if (pathname === "/" || pathname === "/index.html") {
          const testHtml = html.replace(
            '<script type="module" src="./src/main.js"></script>',
            `<script type="module" src="/src/adultContent.js?scenario=${scenario}"></script>`,
          );
          res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" }).end(testHtml);
        } else if (pathname === "/src/adultContent.js") {
          const gate = moduleGates[scenario];
          gate.markRequested();
          await gate.wait;
          const moduleText = await readFile(path.join(root, "src/adultContent.js"), "utf8");
          res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8" })
            .end(`${moduleText}\nwindow.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_ACKNOWLEDGED = adultContent.acknowledged();\nwindow.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_DECLINED = window.__GTB_AGE_GATE_DECLINED === true;\nwindow.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_LOADED = true;`);
        } else {
          res.writeHead(404).end("Not found");
        }
      });
      await new Promise((resolve) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve));
      const address = server.address();
      const localUrl = `http://127.0.0.1:${address.port}/`;
      const browser = await puppeteer.launch({
        ...(process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH } : {}),
        headless: true,
        args: ["--allow-file-access-from-files", "--no-sandbox"],
      });
      try {
        // Unsupported file:// feedback should be actionable and accessible.
        const unsupportedPage = await browser.newPage();
        await unsupportedPage.evaluateOnNewDocument(() => {
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", { configurable: true, value: {} });
        });
        await unsupportedPage.goto(pathToFileURL(path.join(root, "index.html")).href, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await unsupportedPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessInput");
        const before = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          hidden: error.hidden,
          role: error.getAttribute("role"),
          live: error.getAttribute("aria-live"),
        }));
        const inputSemantics = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessInput", (input) => ({
          describedBy: input.getAttribute("aria-describedby"),
          label: input.labels[0]?.textContent.trim(),
          autocomplete: input.autocomplete,
          autocapitalize: input.getAttribute("autocapitalize"),
          autocorrect: input.getAttribute("autocorrect"),
          enterKeyHint: input.enterKeyHint,
          fontSize: getComputedStyle(input).fontSize,
        }));
        assert.deepEqual(before, { hidden: true, role: "alert", live: "polite" }, "error region starts hidden and is announced accessibly");
        assert.deepEqual(inputSemantics, {
          describedBy: "gtbAccessError",
          label: "Access password",
          autocomplete: "off",
          autocapitalize: "off",
          autocorrect: "off",
          enterKeyHint: "go",
          fontSize: "16px",
        }, "password field has an accessible label and mobile-appropriate input hints");
        await unsupportedPage.focus("#gtbAccessInput");
        await unsupportedPage.keyboard.press("Enter");
        await unsupportedPage.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector("#gtbAccessError").hidden);
        const unsupported = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          text: error.textContent,
          invalid: document.querySelector("#gtbAccessInput").getAttribute("aria-invalid"),
        }));
        assert.match(unsupported.text, /opened as a file/i, "file:// gets specific guidance");
        assert.match(unsupported.text, /start-game\.cmd|npm start/i, "instructions explain how to start the local server");
        assert.equal(unsupported.invalid, "true", "unsupported verification marks the password field invalid");
        await unsupportedPage.type("#gtbAccessInput", "x");
        const cleared = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          hidden: error.hidden,
          text: error.textContent,
          invalid: document.querySelector("#gtbAccessInput").getAttribute("aria-invalid"),
        }));
        assert.deepEqual(cleared, { hidden: true, text: "", invalid: null }, "editing the password clears stale feedback and invalid state");
      
        // Adult choice: the button must work even before adultContent.js has loaded.
        const adultContext = await browser.createBrowserContext();
        const adultPage = await adultContext.newPage();
        await adultPage.evaluateOnNewDocument((hash) => {
          const bytes = Uint8Array.from(hash.match(/../g), (pair) => parseInt(pair, 16));
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", {
            configurable: true,
            value: { subtle: { digest: () => Promise.resolve(bytes.buffer) } },
          });
        }, accessHash);
        const adultNavigation = adultPage.goto(`${localUrl}?scenario=yes`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await adultPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAgeYes");
        await moduleGates.yes.requested;
        await adultPage.type("#gtbAccessInput", "browser-test-password");
        await adultPage.click("#gtbAccessSubmit");
        await adultPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessGate", { hidden: true });
        await adultPage.click("#gtbAgeYes");
        await adultPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAdultGate", { hidden: true });
        assert.equal(await adultPage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_AGE_GATE_ACKNOWLEDGED), true, "adult choice is recorded before module load");
        moduleGates.yes.release();
        await adultPage.waitForFunction(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_LOADED === true);
        assert.equal(await adultPage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_ACKNOWLEDGED), true, "late module preserves adult confirmation");
        assert.equal(await adultPage.$("#gtbAdultGate"), null, "late module does not reopen a confirmed gate");
        await adultNavigation;
        await adultContext.close();
      
        // First launch on a phone-sized touch viewport: type the password, tap ENTER,
        // then tap 18+ while the module request is still deliberately held back.
        const touchContext = await browser.createBrowserContext();
        const touchPage = await touchContext.newPage();
        await touchPage.setViewport({ width: 390, height: 844, isMobile: true, hasTouch: true, deviceScaleFactor: 2 });
        await touchPage.evaluateOnNewDocument((hash) => {
          const bytes = Uint8Array.from(hash.match(/../g), (pair) => parseInt(pair, 16));
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", {
            configurable: true,
            value: { subtle: { digest: () => Promise.resolve(bytes.buffer) } },
          });
        }, accessHash);
        const touchNavigation = touchPage.goto(`${localUrl}?scenario=touch`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await touchPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAgeYes");
        await moduleGates.touch.requested;
        assert.equal(await touchPage.evaluate(() => matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches), true, "browser is using a coarse touch pointer");
        await touchPage.type("#gtbAccessInput", "browser-test-password");
        const tap = async (selector) => {
          const box = await touchPage.$eval(selector, (element) => {
            const { x, y, width, height } = element.getBoundingClientRect();
            return { x, y, width, height };
          });
          assert.ok(box.width > 0 && box.height > 0, `${selector} has a visible tap target`);
          await touchPage.touchscreen.tap(box.x + box.width / 2, box.y + box.height / 2);
        };
        await tap("#gtbAccessSubmit");
        await touchPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessGate", { hidden: true });
        await tap("#gtbAgeYes");
        await touchPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAdultGate", { hidden: true });
        assert.equal(await touchPage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_AGE_GATE_ACKNOWLEDGED), true, "touch confirmation is recorded before module load");
        moduleGates.touch.release();
        await touchNavigation;
        await touchPage.waitForFunction(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_LOADED === true);
        assert.equal(await touchPage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_ACKNOWLEDGED), true, "late module preserves touch confirmation");
        await touchContext.close();
      
        // Under-18 choice: immediately replace the gate with a notice and remain
        // locked, including after the delayed module initializes.
        const leaveContext = await browser.createBrowserContext();
        const leavePage = await leaveContext.newPage();
        await leavePage.evaluateOnNewDocument((hash) => {
          const bytes = Uint8Array.from(hash.match(/../g), (pair) => parseInt(pair, 16));
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", {
            configurable: true,
            value: { subtle: { digest: () => Promise.resolve(bytes.buffer) } },
          });
        }, accessHash);
        const leaveNavigation = leavePage.goto(`${localUrl}?scenario=no`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });

  content: |
      // Writes assets/music/playlist.json from the audio files in assets/music/.
      // Used by `npm run build` for static hosting; the local dev server (serve.mjs)
      // lists the folder live instead, so adding or deleting a track needs no rebuild.
      import { readdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
      import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
      
      export const AUDIO_EXT = /\.(mp3|ogg|oga|wav|m4a|aac|flac|opus|webm)$/i;
      
      export function listTracks(dir) {
        try {
          return readdirSync(dir).filter((f) => AUDIO_EXT.test(f)).sort();
        } catch {
          return [];
        }
      }
      
      if (process.argv[1] && fileURLToPath(import.meta.url) === process.argv[1]) {
        const dir = fileURLToPath(new URL("../assets/music/", import.meta.url));
        const tracks = listTracks(dir);
        writeFileSync(dir + "playlist.json", JSON.stringify({ tracks }, null, 2) + "\n");
        console.log(`playlist.json: ${tracks.length} track(s)`);
      }

  content: |
      import * as THREE from "three";
      
      const loader = new THREE.TextureLoader();
      
      // A radial falloff for the contact shadow — a hard-edged disc reads as a decal.
      let _blobTex = null;
      function blobTexture() {
        if (_blobTex) return _blobTex;
        const c = document.createElement("canvas");
        c.width = c.height = 128;
        const x = c.getContext("2d");
        const g = x.createRadialGradient(64, 64, 0, 64, 64, 64);
        g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,1)");
        g.addColorStop(0.45, "rgba(255,255,255,0.72)");
        g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
        x.fillStyle = g;
        x.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128);
        _blobTex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
        _blobTex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
        return _blobTex;
      }
      
      export function loadAtlas(name) {
        return Promise.all([
          fetch(`./assets/sprites/${name}.json`).then((r) => r.json()),
          new Promise((res, rej) => loader.load(`./assets/sprites/${name}.png`, res, undefined, rej)),
        ]).then(([manifest, tex]) => {
          tex.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
          tex.minFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
          tex.generateMipmaps = false;
          tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
          return { manifest, tex };
        });
      }
      
      /**
       * A camera-facing animated sprite driven by a horizontal-strip atlas.
       * worldHeight = how tall the sprite should be in metres.
       */
      export class AnimatedSprite extends THREE.Object3D {
        constructor({ manifest, tex }, worldHeight = 2) {
          super();
          this.manifest = manifest;
          this.count = manifest.count;
          const [fw, fh] = manifest.frameSize;
          this.aspect = fw / fh;
      
          this.texture = tex.clone();
          this.texture.needsUpdate = true;
          this.texture.repeat.set(1 / this.count, 1);
      
          // Lit, not unlit: a billboard that ignores the scene's lighting is the
          // single most obvious "this is a game sprite" tell. A little emissive from
          // its own albedo keeps it from going pitch black on the night side.
          this.material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
            map: this.texture,
            emissive: 0xffffff,
            emissiveMap: this.texture,
            emissiveIntensity: 0.22,
            roughness: 0.92,
            metalness: 0,
            envMapIntensity: 0.85,
            transparent: true,
            alphaTest: 0.5,
            side: THREE.DoubleSide,
            depthWrite: true,
          });
          this.material.userData.gtbRealized = true;   // keep the pixel art crisp
      
          const h = worldHeight;
          const w = h * this.aspect;
          this.mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w, h), this.material);
          this.mesh.position.y = h / 2;
          this.mesh.renderOrder = 1;
          this.mesh.castShadow = true;
          this.mesh.receiveShadow = true;
          // Cut-out shadows: the default depth material ignores the alpha channel, so
          // an alpha-tested billboard would otherwise cast a solid rectangle.
          this.mesh.customDepthMaterial = new THREE.MeshDepthMaterial({
            depthPacking: THREE.RGBADepthPacking,
            map: this.texture,
            alphaTest: 0.5,
          });
          this.add(this.mesh);
      
          // soft contact shadow under the feet — the real shadow map handles the
          // rest, this just grounds the billboard when the moon is near-overhead
          this.blob = new THREE.Mesh(
            new THREE.CircleGeometry(w * 0.38, 24),
            new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
              map: blobTexture(), color: 0x000000, transparent: true,
              opacity: 0.28, depthWrite: false,
            })
          );
          this.blob.material.userData.gtbRealized = true;
          this.blob.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
          this.blob.position.y = 0.03;
          this.add(this.blob);
      
          this.anim = null;
          this.frames = [];
          this.time = 0;
          this.fps = 8;
          this.loop = true;
          this.finished = false;
          this.flip = 1;
          this.play(Object.keys(manifest.anims)[0]);
        }
      
        play(anim, { fps = 8, loop = true, force = false } = {}) {
          if (this.anim === anim && !force) return;
          if (!this.manifest.anims[anim]) return;
          this.anim = anim;
          this.frames = this.manifest.anims[anim];
          this.fps = fps;
          this.loop = loop;
          this.time = 0;
          this.finished = false;
          this._apply(0);
        }
      
        _apply(i) {
          const col = this.frames[i];
          this.texture.offset.x = col / this.count;
        }
      
        setFlip(dir) {
          // dir < 0 -> face left
          this.flip = dir < 0 ? -1 : 1;
        }
      
        setTint(hex) {
          this.material.color.setHex(hex);
        }
      
        update(dt, camera) {
          this.time += dt;
          const total = this.frames.length;
          let i = Math.floor(this.time * this.fps);
          if (i >= total) {
            if (this.loop) i %= total;
            else { i = total - 1; this.finished = true; }
          }
          this._apply(i);
      
          // face camera on Y only, keep upright, apply horizontal flip
          if (camera) {
            const dx = camera.position.x - this.position.x;
            const dz = camera.position.z - this.position.z;
            this.mesh.rotation.y = Math.atan2(dx, dz);
          }
          this.mesh.scale.x = this.flip;
        }
      }

  content: |
      // Minimal static file server for Escape The Bayou. No dependencies.
      //   node serve.mjs [port]
      import { createServer } from "node:http";
      import { readFile, stat } from "node:fs/promises";
      import { extname, join, normalize } from "node:path";
      import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
      import { listTracks } from "./tools/music-playlist.mjs";
      
      const ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL(".", import.meta.url));
      const PORT = Number(process.argv[2]) || 5173;
      
      const TYPES = {
        ".html": "text/html", ".js": "text/javascript", ".mjs": "text/javascript",
        ".css": "text/css", ".json": "application/json", ".png": "image/png",
        ".jpg": "image/jpeg", ".gif": "image/gif", ".svg": "image/svg+xml",
        ".glb": "model/gltf-binary", ".gltf": "model/gltf+json", ".bin": "application/octet-stream",
        ".fbx": "application/octet-stream", ".wav": "audio/wav", ".mp3": "audio/mpeg",
        ".ogg": "audio/ogg", ".oga": "audio/ogg", ".m4a": "audio/mp4", ".aac": "audio/aac",
        ".flac": "audio/flac", ".opus": "audio/ogg", ".webm": "audio/webm", ".txt": "text/plain",
      };
      
      createServer(async (req, res) => {
        try {
          let path = decodeURIComponent(new URL(req.url, "http://x").pathname);
          if (path === "/") path = "/index.html";
          // The soundtrack playlist is listed live from assets/music/, so dropping a
          // track in (or deleting one) shows up on the next page load.
          if (path === "/assets/music/playlist.json") {
            const tracks = listTracks(join(ROOT, "assets", "music"));
            res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "application/json", "cache-control": "no-cache" });
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ tracks }));
            return;
          }
          // Never serve secrets or internals: this used to hand out .env (the Fish Audio and OpenRouter keys),
          // .git/ and the server code to anyone who could reach the port (audit, 2026-09-26).
          if (path.split("/").some((seg) => seg.startsWith(".") && seg !== "") || /^\/(server|node_modules|scratch_puppet)\//.test(path)) {
            res.writeHead(404).end("404");
            return;
          }
          const full = normalize(join(ROOT, path));
          if (!full.startsWith(ROOT)) { res.writeHead(403).end("no"); return; }
          const info = await stat(full);
          if (info.isDirectory()) { res.writeHead(403).end("dir"); return; }
          const body = await readFile(full);
          res.writeHead(200, {
            "content-type": TYPES[extname(full).toLowerCase()] || "application/octet-stream",
            "cache-control": "no-cache",
          });
          res.end(body);
        } catch {
          res.writeHead(404).end("404");
        }
      }).listen(PORT, () => console.log(`Escape The Bayou -> http://localhost:${PORT}`));

      // Headless acceptance tests for TASK-033 (core gameplay rework), following the
      // spec's test list:
      //   30 on foot: W walks where the camera looks at yaw 0 / 90 / 180 / 270°;
      //      strafe, diagonal, stop, turning the camera without moving
      //   31 vehicle: facing north + W → north; camera turned east + W → still north;
      //      steering right turns toward east; facing east + W → east
      //   32 model orientation: every vehicle model side-on with its heading arrow (screenshots)
      //   33 NPCs: a civilian next to the player stays calm; shot, it defends or flees
      //   34 hogs: none in the city or on the highway, the live ones in the woods
      //   35 buildings: aerial shots of the strip
      //
      //   node <browser-automation>/browser.mjs http://localhost:8899/ --script tools/qa/controls.mjs
      //
      // SHOT_PREFIX sets the screenshot path prefix (default: ./ctl).
      async function inPage(page, body) {
        await page.addScriptTag({
          content: `try { document.body.dataset.r = JSON.stringify((function(){ ${body} })()); }
                    catch (e) { document.body.dataset.r = JSON.stringify({ error: String(e && e.stack || e) }); }`,
        });
        return JSON.parse(await page.evaluate(() => document.body.dataset.r || "null"));
      }
      
      const HELPERS = `
        const g = window.__game;
        const wrap = (a) => a - Math.PI * 2 * Math.floor((a + Math.PI) / (Math.PI * 2));
        const deg = (h) => Math.round(((Math.atan2(Math.sin(h), -Math.cos(h)) * 180 / Math.PI) + 360) % 360);
      `;
      
      export default async function run(page) {
        const log = { results: [] };
        try { await tests(page, log); } catch (err) { log.crash = String((err && err.stack) || err); }
        log.passed = log.results.filter((r) => r.ok).length;
        log.failed = log.results.filter((r) => !r.ok).map((r) => r.name);
        return log;
      }
      
      async function tests(page, log) {
        const out = process.env.SHOT_PREFIX || "ctl";
        const pass = (name, ok, detail) => log.results.push({ name, ok: !!ok, ...detail });
        const js = (body) => inPage(page, HELPERS + body);
      
        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 720 });
        await page.waitForFunction(() => { const b = document.getElementById("freeBtn"); return b && !b.disabled; }, null, { timeout: 240000 });
        // The menu nests now: root -> "Start Game" -> Story / Free Roam / Multiplayer,
        // so #freeBtn is zero-size until its submenu is open.
        await page.click('[data-menu="start"]');
        await page.waitForTimeout(300);
        await page.click("#freeBtn");
        await page.waitForFunction(() => window.__game && window.__game.state.running, null, { timeout: 60000 });
        await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
        log.callsAtSpawn = await js(`return g.perf.calls;`);
      
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 30: on foot
        const CX = 74, CZ = 290;                       // an OrleaRouge intersection, open both ways
        async function walk(yawTarget, keys, ms = 900) {
          await js(`g.teleport(${CX}, ${CZ}); g.camCtl.addYaw(wrap(${yawTarget} - g.camCtl.yaw)); return true;`);
          await page.waitForTimeout(700);
          const before = await js(`const f = g.camCtl.forward({}), r = g.camCtl.right({});
            return { p: [g.player.position.x, g.player.position.z], f: [f.x, f.z], r: [r.x, r.z], cam: deg(g.camCtl.heading) };`);
          for (const k of keys) await page.keyboard.down(k);
          await page.waitForTimeout(ms);
          for (const k of keys) await page.keyboard.up(k);
          await page.waitForTimeout(150);
          const after = await js(`return [g.player.position.x, g.player.position.z];`);
          const dx = after[0] - before.p[0], dz = after[1] - before.p[1];
          const len = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1e-9;
          return { before, dx, dz, len, dir: [dx / len, dz / len] };
        }
        const dot = (a, b) => a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1];
      
        for (const [label, yaw] of [["0°", 0], ["90°", Math.PI / 2], ["180°", Math.PI], ["270°", Math.PI * 1.5]]) {
          const w = await walk(yaw, ["KeyW"]);
          pass(`on foot, camera yaw ${label}: W walks where the camera looks`, w.len > 2 && dot(w.dir, w.before.f) > 0.95,
            { cameraBearing: w.before.cam, moved: +w.len.toFixed(2), alignment: +dot(w.dir, w.before.f).toFixed(3) });
        }
        {
          const s = await walk(Math.PI / 2, ["KeyS"]);
          pass("on foot, yaw 90°: S walks toward the camera", s.len > 2 && dot(s.dir, s.before.f) < -0.95, { alignment: +dot(s.dir, s.before.f).toFixed(3) });
          const d = await walk(Math.PI / 2, ["KeyD"]);
          pass("on foot, yaw 90°: D strafes to screen-right", d.len > 2 && dot(d.dir, d.before.r) > 0.95, { alignment: +dot(d.dir, d.before.r).toFixed(3) });
          const a = await walk(Math.PI * 1.5, ["KeyA"]);
          pass("on foot, yaw 270°: A strafes to screen-left", a.len > 2 && dot(a.dir, a.before.r) < -0.95, { alignment: +dot(a.dir, a.before.r).toFixed(3) });
          const wd = await walk(Math.PI, ["KeyW", "KeyD"]);
          const diag = [(wd.before.f[0] + wd.before.r[0]) / Math.SQRT2, (wd.before.f[1] + wd.before.r[1]) / Math.SQRT2];
          pass("on foot, yaw 180°: W+D walks forward-right diagonally", wd.len > 2 && dot(wd.dir, diag) > 0.95, { alignment: +dot(wd.dir, diag).toFixed(3) });
        }
        {
          await page.waitForTimeout(400);
          const p0 = await js(`return [g.player.position.x, g.player.position.z];`);
          await page.waitForTimeout(800);
          const p1 = await js(`return [g.player.position.x, g.player.position.z];`);
          pass("on foot: releasing the keys stops the player", Math.hypot(p1[0] - p0[0], p1[1] - p0[1]) < 0.05, {});
          await js(`g.camCtl.addYaw(2.1); return true;`);
          await page.waitForTimeout(900);
          const p2 = await js(`return [g.player.position.x, g.player.position.z];`);
          pass("on foot: turning the camera alone doesn't move the player", Math.hypot(p2[0] - p1[0], p2[1] - p1[1]) < 0.05, {});
        }
      
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 31: vehicle
        const pickCar = `
          const usable = (x) => !x.sheriff && !x.dead && x.def;
          window.__testCar = window.__testCar || g.vehicles.find((x) => usable(x) && !x.traffic && x.def.pack === "kenney")
            || g.vehicles.find((x) => usable(x) && !x.traffic);
          if (!window.__testCar) throw new Error("no drivable vehicle with a definition");
        `;
        async function driveFrom(x, z, heading, cameraHeading, keys, ms) {
          await js(`${pickCar}
            const v = window.__testCar;
            g.teleport(${x}, ${z});
            v.obj.position.x = ${x}; v.obj.position.z = ${z};
            v.heading = ${heading}; v.obj.rotation.y = ${heading}; v.speed = 0;
            v.blocker.x = ${x}; v.blocker.z = ${z};
            g.state.veh = v; g.player.visible = false;
            return true;`);
          await page.waitForTimeout(600);   // the camera swings in behind the car
          if (cameraHeading != null) await js(`g.camCtl.addYaw(wrap((${cameraHeading} - Math.PI) - g.camCtl.yaw)); return true;`);
          await page.waitForTimeout(500);
          const before = await js(`const v = window.__testCar; return { p: [v.obj.position.x, v.obj.position.z], h: v.heading, cam: deg(g.camCtl.heading) };`);
          for (const k of keys) await page.keyboard.down(k);
          await page.waitForTimeout(ms);
          const mid = await js(`const v = window.__testCar; return { cam: deg(g.camCtl.heading), calls: g.perf.calls };`);
          for (const k of keys) await page.keyboard.up(k);
          const after = await js(`const v = window.__testCar; const r = { p: [v.obj.position.x, v.obj.position.z], h: v.heading, speed: v.speed }; v.speed = 0; return r;`);
          const dx = after.p[0] - before.p[0], dz = after.p[1] - before.p[1];
          const len = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1e-9;
          return { before, mid, after, len, dir: [dx / len, dz / len] };
        }
        const NORTH = [0, -1], EAST = [1, 0];
        {
          const n = await driveFrom(114, 365, Math.PI, null, ["KeyW"], 1300);
          pass("vehicle facing north: W drives north", n.len > 4 && dot(n.dir, NORTH) > 0.97,
            { moved: +n.len.toFixed(1), alignment: +dot(n.dir, NORTH).toFixed(3), cameraBearing: n.before.cam });
          log.callsDriving = n.mid.calls;
          const ne = await driveFrom(114, 365, Math.PI, Math.PI / 2, ["KeyW"], 1000);
          pass("vehicle facing north, camera turned east: W still drives north", ne.len > 3 && dot(ne.dir, NORTH) > 0.97 && Math.abs(ne.before.cam - 90) < 25,
            { cameraBearingAtStart: ne.before.cam, alignment: +dot(ne.dir, NORTH).toFixed(3) });
          const st = await driveFrom(114, 365, Math.PI, null, ["KeyW", "KeyD"], 1200);
          pass("vehicle facing north: W+D steers toward the east", st.after.h < st.before.h - 0.3 && st.dir[0] > 0,
            { headingBearing: [Math.round((((Math.atan2(Math.sin(st.before.h), -Math.cos(st.before.h))) * 180 / Math.PI) + 360) % 360),
              Math.round((((Math.atan2(Math.sin(st.after.h), -Math.cos(st.after.h))) * 180 / Math.PI) + 360) % 360)] });
          const e = await driveFrom(20, 290, Math.PI / 2, null, ["KeyW"], 1300);
          pass("vehicle facing east: W drives east", e.len > 4 && dot(e.dir, EAST) > 0.97, { alignment: +dot(e.dir, EAST).toFixed(3) });
          const r = await driveFrom(20, 290, Math.PI / 2, null, ["KeyS"], 1300);
          pass("vehicle facing east: S reverses west", r.len > 1.5 && dot(r.dir, EAST) < -0.97, { alignment: +dot(r.dir, EAST).toFixed(3) });
          // step out: on-foot W must follow the camera again (the original bug)
          await page.keyboard.press("KeyF");
          await page.waitForTimeout(500);
          const exitW = await js(`const f = g.camCtl.forward({}); return { inCar: !!g.state.veh, f: [f.x, f.z], p: [g.player.position.x, g.player.position.z], cam: deg(g.camCtl.heading) };`);
          await page.keyboard.down("KeyW"); await page.waitForTimeout(800); await page.keyboard.up("KeyW");
          const exitP = await js(`return [g.player.position.x, g.player.position.z];`);
          const ed = [exitP[0] - exitW.p[0], exitP[1] - exitW.p[1]], el = Math.hypot(ed[0], ed[1]) || 1e-9;
          pass("after exiting an east-facing car: W walks where the camera looks", !exitW.inCar && el > 2 && dot([ed[0] / el, ed[1] / el], exitW.f) > 0.95,
            { cameraBearing: exitW.cam, alignment: +dot([ed[0] / el, ed[1] / el], exitW.f).toFixed(3) });
        }
      
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 32: model orientation
        const models = await js(`
          const seen = new Map();
          for (const v of g.vehicles) {
            const key = v.def ? v.def.name : "?";
            if (!seen.has(key)) seen.set(key, v);
          }
          window.__models = [...seen.values()];
          return window.__models.map((v) => v.def ? v.def.name + " (" + v.def.modelForward + ")" : "no def");
        `);
        log.models = models;
        for (let i = 0; i < models.length; i++) {
          await js(`
            const v = window.__models[${i}];
            const c = v.obj.clone(true);
            c.visible = true;
            c.position.set(60, v.obj.position.y, 290);
            c.rotation.set(0, Math.PI / 2, 0);            // heading EAST
            g.scene.add(c);
            window.__probe = c;
            g.teleport(67, 290);                          // the player stands east of it: the nose should point at them
            g.cine.shot({ from: [60, 3.2, 300], look: [62, 1, 290], dur: 0.1 });   // from the south, looking north: east is screen-right
            return true;`);
          await page.waitForTimeout(1300);
          await page.screenshot({ path: `${out}-model-${i}.png` });
          await js(`g.scene.remove(window.__probe); g.cine.releaseCamera(); return true;`);
        }
      
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 33: NPCs
        {
          await js(`g.teleport(-6, 100); return true;`);
          await page.waitForTimeout(2500);
          const near = await js(`
            const p = g.player.position;
            let best = null, bd = 1e9;
            for (const e of g.enemies) {
              if (e.dead || e.type === "hog") continue;
              const d = Math.hypot(e.spr.position.x - p.x, e.spr.position.z - p.z);
              if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = e; }
            }
            if (!best) return null;
            window.__npc = best;
            g.teleport(best.spr.position.x + 1.8, best.spr.position.z);
            return { type: best.type, mood: best.mood, dist: +bd.toFixed(1) };`);
          await page.waitForTimeout(6000);
          const calm = await js(`const e = window.__npc; return { state: e && e.state, hostileTotal: g.enemies.filter((x) => !x.dead && x.state === "hostile").length };`);
          pass("civilian standing next to the player for 6 s stays calm", near && calm.state !== "hostile" && calm.hostileTotal === 0, { npc: near, after: calm });
          // Attack it: step into reach, aim the camera at it and swing. Two things about
          // the starter loadout (TASK-036): the bat only reaches 2.2 m, so the 1.8 m
          // stand-off the calm test uses is not reliably a hit once the NPC has wandered
          // a step; and on foot fire() refuses unless you are aiming (RMB) — the suite's
