- path: tools\qa\startup_browser_test.mjs
  content: |
      import assert from "node:assert/strict";
      import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
      import net from "node:net";
      import path from "node:path";
      import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
      import puppeteer from "puppeteer";
      
      const root = process.cwd();
      const html = await readFile(path.join(root, "index.html"), "utf8");
      const accessHash = html.match(/var GTB_ACCESS_HASH = "([a-f0-9]+)"/)?.[1];
      assert.ok(accessHash, "private access hash is present in the page");
      
      const portServer = net.createServer();
      await new Promise((resolve, reject) => portServer.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve).once("error", reject));
      const port = portServer.address().port;
      await new Promise((resolve, reject) => portServer.close((error) => error ? reject(error) : resolve()));
      const appServer = spawn(process.execPath, ["serve.mjs", String(port)], { cwd: root, stdio: "ignore" });
      let browser;
      try {
        const deadline = Date.now() + 15000;
        while (Date.now() < deadline) {
          try {
            const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/`);
            if (response.ok) break;
          } catch {}
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150));
        }
      
        browser = await puppeteer.launch({
          ...(process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH } : {}),
          protocolTimeout: 300000,
          headless: true,
          args: ["--use-gl=swiftshader", "--enable-unsafe-swiftshader", "--mute-audio", "--no-sandbox"],
        });
        const context = await browser.createBrowserContext();
        const page = await context.newPage();
        await page.setViewport({ width: 1280, height: 720 });
        await page.evaluateOnNewDocument((hash) => {
          const bytes = Uint8Array.from(hash.match(/../g), (pair) => parseInt(pair, 16));
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", {
            configurable: true,
            value: { subtle: { digest: () => Promise.resolve(bytes.buffer) } },
          });
        }, accessHash);
      
        const pageErrors = [];
        const failedRequests = [];
        page.on("pageerror", (error) => pageErrors.push(error.message));
        page.on("requestfailed", (request) => failedRequests.push(`${request.url()}: ${request.failure()?.errorText || "failed"}`));
      
        await page.goto(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 120000 });
        await page.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessInput", { timeout: 15000 });
        await page.type("#gtbAccessInput", "browser-startup-test");
        await page.click("#gtbAccessSubmit");
        await page.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessGate", { hidden: true, timeout: 10000 });
        await page.click("#gtbAgeYes");
        await page.waitForSelector("#gtbAdultGate", { hidden: true, timeout: 10000 });
      
        try {
          await page.waitForFunction(() => {
            const button = document.getElementById("freeBtn");
            return button && !button.disabled;
          }, { timeout: 300000 });
        } catch (error) {
          const status = await page.evaluate(() => ({
            note: document.getElementById("loadNote")?.textContent,
            percent: document.getElementById("loadPct")?.textContent,
            accessGate: !!document.getElementById("gtbAccessGate"),
            ageGate: !!document.getElementById("gtbAdultGate"),
            freeDisabled: document.getElementById("freeBtn")?.disabled,
          }));
          throw new Error(`Game did not finish startup: ${JSON.stringify(status)}\nPage errors: ${pageErrors.slice(0, 10).join(" | ")}\nFailed requests: ${failedRequests.slice(0, 10).join(" | ")}\n${error.message}`);
        }
      
        assert.equal(await page.$("#gtbAccessGate"), null, "private access gate is removed");
        assert.equal(await page.$("#gtbAdultGate"), null, "18+ gate is removed");
        assert.equal(await page.$eval("#freeBtn", (button) => button.disabled), false, "game startup enables Free Roam");
        assert.equal(pageErrors.length, 0, `startup has no uncaught browser errors: ${pageErrors.join(" | ")}`);
        console.log("Full-game first-launch browser test passed: password accepted, age confirmed, startup menu enabled");
        await context.close();
      } finally {
        if (browser) await browser.close();
        appServer.kill();
      }

      // Loading screen: while boot() is loading assets, the menu (logo, Start/
      // Options/Exit — all of #introPanel, hidden by default in index.html) stays
      // off-screen entirely and this cycles mood art full-bleed instead, so there's
      // nothing half-clickable to notice is disabled. The slideshow itself keeps
      // alternating forever, through the ready state too — finishLoading() only
      // reveals the menu and retires the numeric readout (#loadHud), since a
      // percentage stuck at 100% means nothing once you're just looking at art.
      let loadScreenTimer = null;
      function startLoadScreen() {
        if (!loadScreen) return;
        const slides = loadScreen.querySelectorAll(".slide");
        if (!slides.length) return;
        let i = 0;
        slides[0].classList.add("on");
        loadScreenTimer = setInterval(() => {
          slides[i].classList.remove("on");
          i = (i + 1) % slides.length;
          slides[i].classList.add("on");
        }, 4200);
      }
      // Drives #loadHud's neon readout — text plus a segmented percentage bar,
      // standing in for the plain "loading assets…" label the boot stages used to
      // write straight to loadNote.
      function setLoadStage(text, pct) {
        loadNote.textContent = text;
        if (loadPct) loadPct.textContent = Math.round(pct) + "%";
        if (loadBarFill) loadBarFill.style.width = Math.round(pct) + "%";
      }
      function finishLoading() {
        introPanel.hidden = false;
        if (loadHud) loadHud.hidden = true;
      }
      startLoadScreen();
      
      startBtn.disabled = true;
      freeBtn.disabled = true;
      zombieBtn.disabled = true;
      for (const b of gfxChoices.querySelectorAll("[data-tier]")) b.disabled = true;
      tick();
      boot().catch((err) => {
        console.error(err);
        loadNote.textContent = "load error: " + err.message;
        finishLoading();
      });

- path: tools\qa\startup_browser_test.mjs
  content: |
      import assert from "node:assert/strict";
      import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
      import net from "node:net";
      import path from "node:path";
      import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
      import puppeteer from "puppeteer";
      
      const root = process.cwd();
      const html = await readFile(path.join(root, "index.html"), "utf8");
      const accessHash = html.match(/var GTB_ACCESS_HASH = "([a-f0-9]+)"/)?.[1];
      assert.ok(accessHash, "private access hash is present in the page");
      
      const portServer = net.createServer();
      await new Promise((resolve, reject) => portServer.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve).once("error", reject));
      const port = portServer.address().port;
      await new Promise((resolve, reject) => portServer.close((error) => error ? reject(error) : resolve()));
      const appServer = spawn(process.execPath, ["serve.mjs", String(port)], { cwd: root, stdio: "ignore" });
      let browser;
      try {
        const deadline = Date.now() + 15000;
        while (Date.now() < deadline) {
          try {
            const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/`);
            if (response.ok) break;
          } catch {}
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150));
        }
      
        browser = await puppeteer.launch({
          ...(process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH } : {}),
          protocolTimeout: 300000,
          headless: true,
          args: ["--use-gl=swiftshader", "--enable-unsafe-swiftshader", "--mute-audio", "--no-sandbox"],
        });
        const context = await browser.createBrowserContext();
        const page = await context.newPage();
        await page.setViewport({ width: 1280, height: 720 });
        await page.evaluateOnNewDocument((hash) => {
          const bytes = Uint8Array.from(hash.match(/../g), (pair) => parseInt(pair, 16));
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", {
            configurable: true,
            value: { subtle: { digest: () => Promise.resolve(bytes.buffer) } },
          });
        }, accessHash);
      
        const pageErrors = [];
        const failedRequests = [];
        page.on("pageerror", (error) => pageErrors.push(error.message));
        page.on("requestfailed", (request) => failedRequests.push(`${request.url()}: ${request.failure()?.errorText || "failed"}`));
      
        await page.goto(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 120000 });
        await page.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessInput", { timeout: 15000 });
        await page.type("#gtbAccessInput", "browser-startup-test");
        await page.click("#gtbAccessSubmit");
        await page.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessGate", { hidden: true, timeout: 10000 });
        await page.click("#gtbAgeYes");
        await page.waitForSelector("#gtbAdultGate", { hidden: true, timeout: 10000 });
      
        try {
          await page.waitForFunction(() => {
            const button = document.getElementById("freeBtn");
            return button && !button.disabled;
          }, { timeout: 300000 });
        } catch (error) {
          const status = await page.evaluate(() => ({
            note: document.getElementById("loadNote")?.textContent,
            percent: document.getElementById("loadPct")?.textContent,
            accessGate: !!document.getElementById("gtbAccessGate"),
            ageGate: !!document.getElementById("gtbAdultGate"),
            freeDisabled: document.getElementById("freeBtn")?.disabled,
          }));
          throw new Error(`Game did not finish startup: ${JSON.stringify(status)}\nPage errors: ${pageErrors.slice(0, 10).join(" | ")}\nFailed requests: ${failedRequests.slice(0, 10).join(" | ")}\n${error.message}`);
        }
      
        assert.equal(await page.$("#gtbAccessGate"), null, "private access gate is removed");
        assert.equal(await page.$("#gtbAdultGate"), null, "18+ gate is removed");
        assert.equal(await page.$eval("#freeBtn", (button) => button.disabled), false, "game startup enables Free Roam");
        assert.equal(pageErrors.length, 0, `startup has no uncaught browser errors: ${pageErrors.join(" | ")}`);
        console.log("Full-game first-launch browser test passed: password accepted, age confirmed, startup menu enabled");
        await context.close();
      } finally {
        if (browser) await browser.close();
        appServer.kill();
      }

- path: tools\qa\startup_browser_test.mjs
  content: |
      import assert from "node:assert/strict";
      import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
      import net from "node:net";
      import path from "node:path";
      import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
      import puppeteer from "puppeteer";
      
      const root = process.cwd();
      const html = await readFile(path.join(root, "index.html"), "utf8");
      const accessHash = html.match(/var GTB_ACCESS_HASH = "([a-f0-9]+)"/)?.[1];
      assert.ok(accessHash, "private access hash is present in the page");
      
      const portServer = net.createServer();
      await new Promise((resolve, reject) => portServer.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve).once("error", reject));
      const port = portServer.address().port;
      await new Promise((resolve, reject) => portServer.close((error) => error ? reject(error) : resolve()));
      const appServer = spawn(process.execPath, ["serve.mjs", String(port)], { cwd: root, stdio: "ignore" });
      let browser;
      try {
        const deadline = Date.now() + 15000;
        while (Date.now() < deadline) {
          try {
            const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/`);
            if (response.ok) break;
          } catch {}
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150));
        }
      
        browser = await puppeteer.launch({
          ...(process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH } : {}),
          protocolTimeout: 300000,
          headless: true,
          args: ["--use-gl=swiftshader", "--enable-unsafe-swiftshader", "--mute-audio", "--no-sandbox"],
        });
        const context = await browser.createBrowserContext();
        const page = await context.newPage();
        await page.setViewport({ width: 1280, height: 720 });
        await page.evaluateOnNewDocument((hash) => {
          const bytes = Uint8Array.from(hash.match(/../g), (pair) => parseInt(pair, 16));
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", {
            configurable: true,
            value: { subtle: { digest: () => Promise.resolve(bytes.buffer) } },
          });
        }, accessHash);
      
        const pageErrors = [];
        const failedRequests = [];
        page.on("pageerror", (error) => pageErrors.push(error.message));
        page.on("requestfailed", (request) => failedRequests.push(`${request.url()}: ${request.failure()?.errorText || "failed"}`));
      
        await page.goto(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 120000 });
        await page.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessInput", { timeout: 15000 });
        await page.type("#gtbAccessInput", "browser-startup-test");
        await page.click("#gtbAccessSubmit");
        await page.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessGate", { hidden: true, timeout: 10000 });
        await page.click("#gtbAgeYes");
        await page.waitForSelector("#gtbAdultGate", { hidden: true, timeout: 10000 });
      
        try {
          await page.waitForFunction(() => {
            const button = document.getElementById("freeBtn");
            return button && !button.disabled;
          }, { timeout: 300000 });
        } catch (error) {
          const status = await page.evaluate(() => ({
            note: document.getElementById("loadNote")?.textContent,
            percent: document.getElementById("loadPct")?.textContent,
            accessGate: !!document.getElementById("gtbAccessGate"),
            ageGate: !!document.getElementById("gtbAdultGate"),
            freeDisabled: document.getElementById("freeBtn")?.disabled,
          }));
          throw new Error(`Game did not finish startup: ${JSON.stringify(status)}\nPage errors: ${pageErrors.slice(0, 10).join(" | ")}\nFailed requests: ${failedRequests.slice(0, 10).join(" | ")}\n${error.message}`);
        }
      
        assert.equal(await page.$("#gtbAccessGate"), null, "private access gate is removed");
        assert.equal(await page.$("#gtbAdultGate"), null, "18+ gate is removed");
        assert.equal(await page.$eval("#freeBtn", (button) => button.disabled), false, "game startup enables Free Roam");
        assert.equal(pageErrors.length, 0, `startup has no uncaught browser errors: ${pageErrors.join(" | ")}`);
      
        await page.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_SHOW_LOAD_ERROR(new Error("simulated asset fetch failure")));
        const recovery = await page.$eval("#loadError", (panel) => ({
          visible: !panel.hidden,
          role: panel.getAttribute("role"),
          heading: panel.querySelector("h2")?.textContent,
          steps: [...panel.querySelectorAll("#loadErrorSteps li")].map((item) => item.textContent),
          detail: panel.querySelector("#loadErrorDetail")?.textContent,
          reload: panel.querySelector("#loadErrorReload")?.textContent,
        }));
        assert.equal(recovery.visible, true, "startup failures show a visible recovery panel");
        assert.equal(recovery.role, "alert", "recovery is announced to assistive technology");
        assert.match(recovery.heading, /couldn’t finish loading/i);
        assert.ok(recovery.steps.some((step) => /internet connection/i.test(step)), "panel suggests checking connectivity");
        assert.ok(recovery.steps.some((step) => /browser|assets/i.test(step)), "panel suggests checking browser or blocked assets");
        assert.match(recovery.detail, /simulated asset fetch failure/, "panel includes the underlying diagnostic");
        assert.match(recovery.reload, /reload game/i, "panel offers a reload action");
      
        console.log("Full-game first-launch and visible load-recovery browser test passed");
        await context.close();
      } finally {
        if (browser) await browser.close();
        appServer.kill();
      }

- path: tools\qa\access_gate_browser_test.mjs
  content: |
      import assert from "node:assert/strict";
      import { createServer } from "node:http";
      import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
      import path from "node:path";
      import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
      import puppeteer from "puppeteer";
      
      const root = process.cwd();
      const html = await readFile(path.join(root, "index.html"), "utf8");
      const accessHash = html.match(/var GTB_ACCESS_HASH = "([a-f0-9]+)"/)?.[1];
      assert.ok(accessHash, "private-access verifier hash exists");
      
      function makeModuleGate() {
        let markRequested, release;
        return {
          requested: new Promise((resolve) => { markRequested = resolve; }),
          markRequested: () => markRequested(),
          wait: new Promise((resolve) => { release = resolve; }),
          release: () => release(),
        };
      }
      const moduleGates = { yes: makeModuleGate(), no: makeModuleGate(), touch: makeModuleGate() };
      
      // Serve the real access and age gates, delaying the age module until each browser
      // scenario has clicked a first-paint button. Avoid booting the full game here.
      const server = createServer(async (req, res) => {
        const requestUrl = new URL(req.url, "http://localhost");
        const pathname = requestUrl.pathname;
        const requestedScenario = requestUrl.searchParams.get("scenario");
        const scenario = Object.hasOwn(moduleGates, requestedScenario) ? requestedScenario : "yes";
        if (pathname === "/" || pathname === "/index.html") {
          const testHtml = html.replace(
            '<script type="module" src="./src/main.js"></script>',
            `<script type="module" src="/src/adultContent.js?scenario=${scenario}"></script>`,
          );
          res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" }).end(testHtml);
        } else if (pathname === "/src/adultContent.js") {
          const gate = moduleGates[scenario];
          gate.markRequested();
          await gate.wait;
          const moduleText = await readFile(path.join(root, "src/adultContent.js"), "utf8");
          res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8" })
            .end(`${moduleText}\nwindow.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_ACKNOWLEDGED = adultContent.acknowledged();\nwindow.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_DECLINED = window.__GTB_AGE_GATE_DECLINED === true;\nwindow.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_LOADED = true;`);
        } else {
          res.writeHead(404).end("Not found");
        }
      });
      await new Promise((resolve) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve));
      const address = server.address();
      const localUrl = `http://127.0.0.1:${address.port}/`;
      const browser = await puppeteer.launch({
        ...(process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH } : {}),
        headless: true,
        args: ["--allow-file-access-from-files", "--no-sandbox"],
      });
      try {
        // Unsupported file:// feedback should be actionable and accessible.
        const unsupportedPage = await browser.newPage();
        await unsupportedPage.evaluateOnNewDocument(() => {
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", { configurable: true, value: {} });
        });
        await unsupportedPage.goto(pathToFileURL(path.join(root, "index.html")).href, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await unsupportedPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessInput");
        const before = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          hidden: error.hidden,
          role: error.getAttribute("role"),
          live: error.getAttribute("aria-live"),
        }));
        const inputSemantics = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessInput", (input) => ({
          describedBy: input.getAttribute("aria-describedby"),
          label: input.labels[0]?.textContent.trim(),
          autocomplete: input.autocomplete,
          autocapitalize: input.getAttribute("autocapitalize"),
          autocorrect: input.getAttribute("autocorrect"),
          enterKeyHint: input.enterKeyHint,
          fontSize: getComputedStyle(input).fontSize,
        }));
        assert.deepEqual(before, { hidden: true, role: "alert", live: "polite" }, "error region starts hidden and is announced accessibly");
        assert.deepEqual(inputSemantics, {
          describedBy: "gtbAccessError",
          label: "Access password",
          autocomplete: "off",
          autocapitalize: "off",
          autocorrect: "off",
          enterKeyHint: "go",
          fontSize: "16px",
        }, "password field has an accessible label and mobile-appropriate input hints");
        await unsupportedPage.focus("#gtbAccessInput");
        await unsupportedPage.keyboard.press("Enter");
        await unsupportedPage.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector("#gtbAccessError").hidden);
        const unsupported = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          text: error.textContent,
          invalid: document.querySelector("#gtbAccessInput").getAttribute("aria-invalid"),
        }));
        assert.match(unsupported.text, /opened as a file/i, "file:// gets specific guidance");
        assert.match(unsupported.text, /start-game\.cmd|npm start/i, "instructions explain how to start the local server");
        assert.equal(unsupported.invalid, "true", "unsupported verification marks the password field invalid");
        await unsupportedPage.type("#gtbAccessInput", "x");
        const cleared = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#gtbAccessError", (error) => ({
          hidden: error.hidden,
          text: error.textContent,
          invalid: document.querySelector("#gtbAccessInput").getAttribute("aria-invalid"),
        }));
        assert.deepEqual(cleared, { hidden: true, text: "", invalid: null }, "editing the password clears stale feedback and invalid state");
      
        await unsupportedPage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_SHOW_LOAD_ERROR(new Error("simulated module load failure")));
        const localRecovery = await unsupportedPage.$eval("#loadError", (panel) => ({
          visible: !panel.hidden,
          fileInstructions: !document.getElementById("loadErrorLocal").hidden,
          genericStepsHidden: document.getElementById("loadErrorSteps").hidden,
          detail: document.getElementById("loadErrorDetail").textContent,
          reloadButton: document.getElementById("loadErrorReload").textContent,
        }));
        assert.equal(localRecovery.visible, true, "startup error panel is visible from a file URL");
        assert.equal(localRecovery.fileInstructions, true, "file:// error displays exact local-server recovery instructions");
        assert.equal(localRecovery.genericStepsHidden, true, "file:// hides irrelevant generic troubleshooting");
        assert.match(localRecovery.detail, /simulated module load failure/, "file error panel shows a diagnostic");
        assert.match(localRecovery.reloadButton, /reload game/i, "file error panel offers reload");
      
        // Adult choice: the button must work even before adultContent.js has loaded.
        const adultContext = await browser.createBrowserContext();
        const adultPage = await adultContext.newPage();
        await adultPage.evaluateOnNewDocument((hash) => {
          const bytes = Uint8Array.from(hash.match(/../g), (pair) => parseInt(pair, 16));
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", {
            configurable: true,
            value: { subtle: { digest: () => Promise.resolve(bytes.buffer) } },
          });
        }, accessHash);
        const adultNavigation = adultPage.goto(`${localUrl}?scenario=yes`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await adultPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAgeYes");
        await moduleGates.yes.requested;
        await adultPage.type("#gtbAccessInput", "browser-test-password");
        await adultPage.click("#gtbAccessSubmit");
        await adultPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessGate", { hidden: true });
        await adultPage.click("#gtbAgeYes");
        await adultPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAdultGate", { hidden: true });
        assert.equal(await adultPage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_AGE_GATE_ACKNOWLEDGED), true, "adult choice is recorded before module load");
        moduleGates.yes.release();
        await adultPage.waitForFunction(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_LOADED === true);
        assert.equal(await adultPage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_ACKNOWLEDGED), true, "late module preserves adult confirmation");
        assert.equal(await adultPage.$("#gtbAdultGate"), null, "late module does not reopen a confirmed gate");
        await adultNavigation;
        await adultContext.close();
      
        // First launch on a phone-sized touch viewport: type the password, tap ENTER,
        // then tap 18+ while the module request is still deliberately held back.
        const touchContext = await browser.createBrowserContext();
        const touchPage = await touchContext.newPage();
        await touchPage.setViewport({ width: 390, height: 844, isMobile: true, hasTouch: true, deviceScaleFactor: 2 });
        await touchPage.evaluateOnNewDocument((hash) => {
          const bytes = Uint8Array.from(hash.match(/../g), (pair) => parseInt(pair, 16));
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", {
            configurable: true,
            value: { subtle: { digest: () => Promise.resolve(bytes.buffer) } },
          });
        }, accessHash);
        const touchNavigation = touchPage.goto(`${localUrl}?scenario=touch`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await touchPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAgeYes");
        await moduleGates.touch.requested;
        assert.equal(await touchPage.evaluate(() => matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches), true, "browser is using a coarse touch pointer");
        await touchPage.type("#gtbAccessInput", "browser-test-password");
        const tap = async (selector) => {
          const box = await touchPage.$eval(selector, (element) => {
            const { x, y, width, height } = element.getBoundingClientRect();
            return { x, y, width, height };
          });
          assert.ok(box.width > 0 && box.height > 0, `${selector} has a visible tap target`);
          await touchPage.touchscreen.tap(box.x + box.width / 2, box.y + box.height / 2);
        };
        await tap("#gtbAccessSubmit");
        await touchPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessGate", { hidden: true });
        await tap("#gtbAgeYes");
        await touchPage.waitForSelector("#gtbAdultGate", { hidden: true });
        assert.equal(await touchPage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_AGE_GATE_ACKNOWLEDGED), true, "touch confirmation is recorded before module load");
        moduleGates.touch.release();
        await touchNavigation;
        await touchPage.waitForFunction(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_LOADED === true);
        assert.equal(await touchPage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_ACKNOWLEDGED), true, "late module preserves touch confirmation");
        await touchContext.close();
      
        // Under-18 choice: immediately replace the gate with a notice and remain
        // locked, including after the delayed module initializes.
        const leaveContext = await browser.createBrowserContext();
        const leavePage = await leaveContext.newPage();
        await leavePage.evaluateOnNewDocument((hash) => {
          const bytes = Uint8Array.from(hash.match(/../g), (pair) => parseInt(pair, 16));
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", {
            configurable: true,
            value: { subtle: { digest: () => Promise.resolve(bytes.buffer) } },
          });
        }, accessHash);
        const leaveNavigation = leavePage.goto(`${localUrl}?scenario=no`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
        await leavePage.waitForSelector("#gtbAgeNo");
        await moduleGates.no.requested;
        await leavePage.type("#gtbAccessInput", "browser-test-password");
        await leavePage.click("#gtbAccessSubmit");
        await leavePage.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessGate", { hidden: true });
        await leavePage.click("#gtbAgeNo");
        await leavePage.waitForFunction(() => /only for adults aged 18 and over/i.test(document.querySelector("#gtbAdultGate").textContent));
        assert.equal(await leavePage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_AGE_GATE_DECLINED), true, "under-18 choice is recorded before module load");
        assert.notEqual(await leavePage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_AGE_GATE_ACKNOWLEDGED), true, "under-18 choice never acknowledges age");
        assert.equal(await leavePage.$("#gtbAgeYes"), null, "under-18 choice removes the confirmation controls");
        const gameplayKeyPrevented = await leavePage.evaluate(() => {
          const event = new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "w", bubbles: true, cancelable: true });
          return !window.dispatchEvent(event);
        });
        assert.equal(gameplayKeyPrevented, true, "under-18 choice keeps gameplay keyboard input blocked");
        moduleGates.no.release();
        await leavePage.waitForFunction(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_LOADED === true);
        assert.equal(await leavePage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_ACKNOWLEDGED), false, "late module remains unacknowledged after under-18 choice");
        assert.equal(await leavePage.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_ADULT_MODULE_DECLINED), true, "late module preserves under-18 decision");
        assert.match(await leavePage.$eval("#gtbAdultGate", (gate) => gate.textContent), /Please close this page/, "notice remains after module initialization");
        await leaveNavigation;
        await leaveContext.close();
      
        console.log("Password-gate feedback and delayed age-gate choice browser tests passed");
      } finally {
        moduleGates.yes.release();
        moduleGates.no.release();
        moduleGates.touch.release();
        await browser.close();
        await new Promise((resolve, reject) => server.close((error) => error ? reject(error) : resolve()));
      }

      export function loadAtlas(name) {
        return Promise.all([
          fetch(`./assets/sprites/${name}.json`).then((r) => r.json()),
          new Promise((res, rej) => loader.load(`./assets/sprites/${name}.png`, res, undefined, rej)),
        ]).then(([manifest, tex]) => {
          tex.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
          tex.minFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
          tex.generateMipmaps = false;
          tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
          return { manifest, tex };
        });
      }

          const slot = sessionStorage.getItem("gtb.autoload");
          if (slot != null) {

            if (d) launchFromSave(d);
          }

      // Loading screen: while boot() is loading assets, the menu (logo, Start/
      // Options/Exit — all of #introPanel, hidden by default in index.html) stays
      // off-screen entirely and this cycles mood art full-bleed instead, so there's
      // nothing half-clickable to notice is disabled. The slideshow itself keeps
      // alternating forever, through the ready state too — finishLoading() only
      // reveals the menu and retires the numeric readout (#loadHud), since a
      // percentage stuck at 100% means nothing once you're just looking at art.
      let loadScreenTimer = null;
      function startLoadScreen() {
        if (!loadScreen) return;
        const slides = loadScreen.querySelectorAll(".slide");
        if (!slides.length) return;
        let i = 0;
        slides[0].classList.add("on");
        loadScreenTimer = setInterval(() => {
          slides[i].classList.remove("on");
          i = (i + 1) % slides.length;
          slides[i].classList.add("on");
        }, 4200);
      }
      // Drives #loadHud's neon readout — text plus a segmented percentage bar,
      // standing in for the plain "loading assets…" label the boot stages used to
      // write straight to loadNote.
      function setLoadStage(text, pct) {
        loadNote.textContent = text;
        if (loadPct) loadPct.textContent = Math.round(pct) + "%";
        if (loadBarFill) loadBarFill.style.width = Math.round(pct) + "%";
      }
      function finishLoading() {
        introPanel.hidden = false;
        if (loadHud) loadHud.hidden = true;
      }
      startLoadScreen();
      
      startBtn.disabled = true;
      freeBtn.disabled = true;
      zombieBtn.disabled = true;
      for (const b of gfxChoices.querySelectorAll("[data-tier]")) b.disabled = true;
      tick();
      boot().catch((err) => {
        console.error(err);
        const showError = window.__GTB_SHOW_LOAD_ERROR;
        if (typeof showError === "function") showError(err);
        else {
          loadNote.textContent = "Game startup failed: " + (err?.message || String(err));
          finishLoading();
        }
      });

I've noticed loading issues, especially on mobile, due to large image sizes and network performance. I’ll also consider adding progress feedback and a timeout.**Planning static fallback timer**
> 
> I'm considering a static fallback timer that starts after the DOMContentLoaded for the stage loader. I realize that the module script might execute before this event, and an asynchronous graph can block it. I think a watchdog script should be implemented to set a timer immediately. If it hits 20 seconds, I could show an error panel, but I guess that could be misleading if the network is slow. It's important to keep the loading HUD updated, with messaging like "Starting game engine…" and updating progress every 10 seconds as necessary.**Addressing app loading performance**
> 
> The app loads a massive 305 KB for the main module and tens of dependencies, with some large imports like Three at 1.2 MB. Plus, there are ten mega images for the loading screen that get downloaded eagerly. The browser's parallel loading of background images is really causing issues, especially on mobile, where it can hit a huge 10 MB. I should consider deferring art loading until after the boot process or using lazy loading for slides. The user wants to investigate loading performance, and I need to measure and optimize without a large refactor unless it's absolutely necessary.**Evaluating script loading issues**

      const WORLD = 136;           // half-width of the map (x), and its northern extent

      const LANDMARKS = [

      function inKeepout(x, z) {
        if (x > METRO_BOUNDS.x0 - 4 && x < METRO_BOUNDS.x1 + 4 && z > METRO_BOUNDS.z0 - 4 && z < METRO_BOUNDS.z1 + 4) return true;      // Downtown Bayou (metro.js) owns this ground: no swamp pines in the city

      // The main menu's Load Game: one row per slot; an empty slot is disabled. Saves are launched through launchFromSave (below).
      function renderLoadMenu() {
        const box = document.getElementById("loadSlots");
        if (!box) return;
        box.innerHTML = "";
        for (const { slot, save } of listSaves()) {
          const b = document.createElement("button");
          b.className = "menu-item";
          b.disabled = !save || !beginGame;
          b.textContent = `${slot + 1}. ${describeSave(save)}`;
          b.style.fontSize = "clamp(14px, 1.6vw, 20px)";
          b.onclick = () => launchFromSave(save);
          box.appendChild(b);
        }
      }
      function showMenuPanel(name) {
        for (const [key, el] of Object.entries(menuPanels)) el.hidden = key !== name;
        if (name === "options") syncGfxChoices();
        if (name === "load") renderLoadMenu();
        const first = menuPanels[name].querySelector(".menu-item:not(:disabled)");
        if (first) first.focus();
      }
      for (const [name, panel] of Object.entries(menuPanels)) {
        panel.addEventListener("click", (e) => {

          if (menuBtn) return showMenuPanel(menuBtn.dataset.menu);
          const backBtn = e.target.closest("[data-back]");
          if (backBtn) return showMenuPanel(backBtn.dataset.back || "root");
        });
        panel.addEventListener("mouseover", (e) => {
          const item = e.target.closest(".menu-item");
          if (item && !item.disabled) item.focus();
        });
      }
      // Arrow-key / Escape navigation, console-menu style. Left alone while a range

      document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (introPanel.hidden || !characterSelect.hidden || !multiplayerPanel.hidden) return;
        const active = document.activeElement;
        if (active && active.tagName === "INPUT") return;
        const openPanel = Object.values(menuPanels).find((el) => !el.hidden);
        if (!openPanel) return;
        const items = [...openPanel.querySelectorAll(".menu-item:not(:disabled)")];
        if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "ArrowUp") {
          e.preventDefault();
          const i = items.indexOf(active);
          const next = e.key === "ArrowDown" ? (i + 1) % items.length : (i - 1 + items.length) % items.length;
          items[Math.max(0, next)]?.focus();

      // The old density saturated at normal gameplay distances, making the whole map

      scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x24353f, 0.0028);

      wetRoads.setQuality(GFX.preset.reflect, GFX.preset.reflectEvery);

      addEventListener("resize", () => {
        camera.aspect = innerWidth / innerHeight;

        composer.resize();
        wetRoads.resize();

      // ---------------------------------------------------------------- lights

      const moon = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xc8d8ff, 1.8);
      moon.position.set(-40, 60, -20);
      moon.castShadow = true;
      moon.shadow.mapSize.set(GFX.preset.shadow, GFX.preset.shadow);

      moon.shadow.camera.left = -s; moon.shadow.camera.right = s;
      moon.shadow.camera.top = s; moon.shadow.camera.bottom = -s;

      moon.shadow.camera.far = 220;
      moon.shadow.bias = -0.0006;

        // there to fetch; hand it a blank pixel and make no request.
        if (url.endsWith("/")) return BLANK_PNG;
        if (/(^|\/)C:\/Users\//i.test(url)) return BLANK_PNG;

      function groundTexture() {
        const S = 1024;
        const c = document.createElement("canvas");
        c.width = c.height = S;
        const x = c.getContext("2d", { willReadFrequently: true });
        x.fillStyle = "#2e3d24"; x.fillRect(0, 0, S, S);
        const cols = ["#37481f", "#283a2a", "#3d3016", "#22331c", "#45532b", "#1a2a16", "#4e5a33"];
        for (let i = 0; i < 7000; i++) {
          x.fillStyle = cols[(Math.random() * cols.length) | 0];
          x.globalAlpha = 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.22;
          const r = 1 + Math.random() * 13;
          x.beginPath();
          x.ellipse(Math.random() * S, Math.random() * S, r, r * (0.4 + Math.random()), Math.random() * 6, 0, 7);
          x.fill();
        }
        // blades / litter, so the surface has fine detail to catch the moonlight
        x.lineWidth = 1;
        for (let i = 0; i < 4000; i++) {
          const px = Math.random() * S, py = Math.random() * S, a = Math.random() * 6, len = 2 + Math.random() * 6;
          x.strokeStyle = cols[(Math.random() * cols.length) | 0];
          x.globalAlpha = 0.25 + Math.random() * 0.45;
          x.beginPath();
          x.moveTo(px, py);
          x.lineTo(px + Math.cos(a) * len, py + Math.sin(a) * len);
          x.stroke();
        }
        x.globalAlpha = 1;

        t.wrapS = t.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
        t.repeat.set(30, 30);
        t.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
        t.anisotropy = GFX.maxAniso;

      }
      
      // Ground decals stack in a fixed order, and every one of them gets its own height:
      // two surfaces at the same y fight for the same depth and the land shimmers wherever
      // they overlap. Bottom to top: pads and lots, aprons, side streets, US-167, markings.
      const GROUND_Y = Object.freeze({
        dirtPad: 0.012,        // junkyard / shack dirt
        lot: 0.014,            // the truck lot outside Tusouxroe
        gravel: 0.016,         // the trailer-park pad at Chatboro
        apron: 0.018,          // asphalt linking a lot to the highway shoulder
        street: 0.019,         // Main Street and the side streets
        highway: 0.02,         // US-167 itself
      });
      
      let ground;
      function buildGround() {
        ground = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.PlaneGeometry(MAP.maxX - MAP.minX + WORLD * 0.4, MAP.maxZ - MAP.minZ + WORLD * 0.8, 1, 1),
          new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
            map: groundTexture(), color: 0x43552f, roughness: 1,
            // The floor is the player's depth reference. Applying the atmospheric fog
            // shader to this kilometre-scale plane made its near side blend into the
            // fog colour and look like a solid white/gray map.
            fog: false,
          })
        );
        ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        // centred on the grown map, and tiled to match its longer z so it doesn't stretch
        ground.position.x = (MAP.maxX + MAP.minX) / 2;
        ground.position.z = (MAP.maxZ + MAP.minZ) / 2;
        ground.material.map.repeat.set(30 * (MAP.maxX - MAP.minX + WORLD * 0.4) / (WORLD * 2.4),
                                       30 * (MAP.maxZ - MAP.minZ + WORLD * 0.8) / (WORLD * 2.4));
        ground.castShadow = false;
        scene.add(ground);
        realize(ground, { hint: "grass ground", shadows: false });
        ground.receiveShadow = true;

        // but the relief needs dialling back at this tiling or it reads as gravel.
        ground.material.normalScale.set(0.6, 0.6);
      }
      
      // Standing bayou water. A true mirror finish reflects the whole sky probe and
      // reads as pale sand from a high camera, so this is deliberately a duller,
      // wind-rippled surface: dark body, broad specular, a tight clearcoat on top.
      const waterMat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
        color: 0x07120f, roughness: 0.22, metalness: 0.0,
        transparent: true, opacity: 0.9,
        envMapIntensity: 0.9, clearcoat: 1, clearcoatRoughness: 0.16,

      for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        const w = rand(10, 26), d = rand(10, 26);
        const p = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w, d, 6, 6), waterMat);
        p.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        p.position.set(rand(-WORLD + 15, WORLD - 15), 0.04, rand(-WORLD + 15, WORLD - 15));
        p.receiveShadow = true;
        scene.add(p);
        waterPatches.push(p);
        p.userData.base = p.geometry.attributes.position.array.slice();
      }
      
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------- light pool
      // A US-167 strip at night is defined by its lighting: sodium pole lights over
      // every parking lot, spaced streetlamps down the shoulder. Lighting all ~30 of

      // instead a small pool of real lights is recycled onto whichever spots are

      const litSpots = [];

      const LIGHT_POOL = { low: 4, medium: 6, high: 8, ultra: 8 };
      function initLightPool(n = LIGHT_POOL[GFX.tier] || 8) {

          const l = new THREE.PointLight(0xffc27a, 0, 40, 2);

      // Every static light in the level goes through the pool too. Each PointLight in

      function poolLight(color, power, range, x, y, z, group) {

        litSpots.push(spot);

      }

      let lampPower = 1;

      const POOL_LIGHT_CAP = 30;

      // couple of metres from its own prop, it's a windowless room whose only light

      // still show without one). Indoors gets a much higher knee instead.
      const POOL_LIGHT_CAP_INDOOR = 55;

          // set in initLightPool) with no minimum-distance floor, so a light placed a
          // couple of metres from its own prop (a sign, a torch, a bonfire — exactly
          // where most of these sit) blows that prop's surface to solid white and
          // bloom smears it across the frame; the sun itself never exceeds ~3.2
          // (daycycle.js), so a `power` of 16-170 is catastrophic up close no matter

      // ---------------------------------------------------------------- trees (wall of swamp)
      function buildTrees() {

        const foliageGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(1.9, 4.6, 12);
        // colour multiplies the generated albedo, so these stay near-white and let
        // the "dirt" / "grass" palettes do the work
        const trunkMat = surface("dirt", 512).material(2, { color: 0xc9b49a, envMapIntensity: 0.7 });
        const foliageMat = surface("grass", 512).material(3, { color: 0xb9d69a, envMapIntensity: 0.8 });
        trunkMat.normalScale.set(2.2, 2.2);
        foliageMat.normalScale.set(1.6, 1.6);

        const trunks = new THREE.InstancedMesh(trunkGeo, trunkMat, N);
        const foliage = new THREE.InstancedMesh(foliageGeo, foliageMat, N);
        trunks.castShadow = foliage.castShadow = true;
        const m = new THREE.Matrix4(), q = new THREE.Quaternion(), sc = new THREE.Vector3();

        for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {

          if (ring) {
            const a = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
            const rad = WORLD - rand(0, 16);
            x = Math.cos(a) * rad; z = Math.sin(a) * rad;
          } else {
            x = rand(-WORLD + 10, WORLD - 10);
            // bias the scatter toward the southern swamp
            z = rng() < 0.7 ? rand(20, WORLD - 10) : rand(-WORLD + 10, WORLD - 10);
            if (Math.hypot(x, z - 100) < 12) continue;   // clear the spawn
          }

          sc.set(h, h, h);
          q.setFromAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), rng() * 6);

          trunks.setMatrixAt(n, m);
          m.compose(new THREE.Vector3(x, 4.6 * h, z), q, sc);
          foliage.setMatrixAt(n, m);
          addBlocker(x, z, 0.7 * h);
          n++;

        scene.add(trunks, foliage);
      }

      // zombies in wilderness zones next to a live one. They used to stand only inside the original
      // 272 m square; the map is 2.4 km now, so the rest of the state's wilderness gets them too
      // (human request, 2026-09-26: "zombies spawn anywhere there are the new trees"). One
      // InstancedMesh trio per 160 m chunk, so a chunk culls as a unit and cleansing a tree is a
      // zero-scale matrix, not a scene removal (a removed mesh had already been baked into a static batch).
      const SWAMP_CHUNK = 160;
      function buildSwampTrees() {
        const trunkGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.2, 0.4, 3.8, 10);
        const foliageGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(2.2, 5.0, 12);
        const waterGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(5, 5).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
      
        const trunkMat = surface("dirt", 512).material(2, { color: 0x3a2f24, envMapIntensity: 0.6 });
        const foliageMat = surface("grass", 512).material(3, { color: 0x4a5a30, envMapIntensity: 0.7 });
        const waterMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x1a2a1a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.85, roughness: 0.1 });
      
        const spots = [];
        // the original square: dense, as before
        for (let i = 0; i < 800; i++) {
          const x = rand(-WORLD + 10, WORLD - 10);
          const z = rand(-WORLD + 10, WORLD - 10);
          if (Math.hypot(x, z - 100) < 12) continue; // clear spawn
          if (inKeepout(x, z)) continue; // keep roads and cities clear
          // extra filtering to ensure it really is wilderness (rural/forest/water/none)

        // ~28 m of almost any spot), and they stand in the towns too, in yards, verges and open ground. What
        // keeps them off roads and out of buildings is the same thing that keeps people from spawning

        // the strips (commercial lots, the Crown Strip's forecourts, market squares) stay bare: their

        const WILD = new Set(["rural", "forest"]);

        for (let i = 0; i < 14000; i++) {
          const x = rand(MAP.minX + 24, MAP.maxX - 24), z = rand(MAP.minZ + 24, MAP.maxZ - 24);
          if (Math.abs(x) < WORLD + 4 && Math.abs(z) < WORLD + 4) continue;    // the original square has its own pass
          const zZone = spawnZones.zoneAt(x, z);
          const wild = WILD.has(zZone);
          if (!wild && !(TOWN.has(zZone) && rng() < 0.3)) continue;            // town ground: one candidate in three, so it is scattered, not planted
          if (stateWorld && stateWorld.heldAt(x, z, 3)) continue;

          // planted through them and the herd jams on the trunks.
          if (inProtected(x, z, 3)) continue;

        }
        // the original square's towns (Chatboro, the trailer park, the junkyard's edges): same rule, a lighter hand
        for (let i = 0; i < 700; i++) {
          const x = rand(-WORLD + 10, WORLD - 10), z = rand(-WORLD + 10, WORLD - 10);
          if (Math.hypot(x, z - 100) < 12 || inKeepout(x, z)) continue;
          const zZone = spawnZones.zoneAt(x, z);
          if (!TOWN.has(zZone) || rng() > 0.25 || !clearOfSolids(x, z)) continue;
          spots.push([x, z]);
        }
      
        const chunks = new Map();
        for (const [x, z] of spots) {

        for (const list of chunks.values()) {

            const h = rand(0.9, 1.4);

            foliage.setMatrixAt(i, m.compose(p.set(x, 4.8 * h, z), q, sc.set(h, h, h)));

        }

      const swampPuddleChunks = [];

      }
      
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------- kit loading
      const urbanTex = {};
      function loadUrbanTextures() {
        const a = texLoader.load("./assets/models/urban/textures/demo_texture_512x512_albedo_psified.png");
        a.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; a.flipY = false;
        urbanTex.albedo = a;
      }
      loadUrbanTextures();
      
      const kitCache = new Map();
      function loadKit(path) {
        if (kitCache.has(path)) return kitCache.get(path);
        const p = new Promise((res) => {
          gltfLoader.load(
            `./assets/models/urban/${path}`,
            (g) => {
              g.scene.traverse((o) => {
                if (o.isMesh) {
                  o.castShadow = true; o.receiveShadow = true;
                  o.material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: urbanTex.albedo, roughness: 0.9 });
                }
              });
              // urban kit = roads, kerbs, pillars, pavement — all masonry
              realize(g.scene, { hint: "concrete masonry " + path });
              res(g.scene);
            },
            undefined,
            () => res(null)
          );
        });
        kitCache.set(path, p);

The browser loads all backgrounds eagerly, even hidden ones, which is causing unnecessary downloads. I think we need to defer loading some slideshow backgrounds. One idea is to set loading artwork with JavaScript after the DOM is ready and to switch inline backgrounds to data attributes. I'll need to modify several elements to make it work efficiently.**Improving loading strategy**
> 
> I’m thinking about setting the first slide URL through a script right after the initial first paint, then adding the others once everything is ready. I’ll need to convert all the inline background-image CSS attributes to data-bg, which are in about 12 places. I have a plan to simplify the load screen, using `neon-bayou.jpg` as the initial background and then set the other images via a JS function after the game fully loads. However, this might leave a blank loading screen during startup.**Considering loading process**
> 
> I’m thinking about how to optimize the loading process. The module loads 300K, and the dependencies take a while. If the import hangs, the countdown timer wouldn’t run as intended. It seems like adding a static watchdog in the inline script could help. Maybe I could display a message after 20 seconds and a recovery panel after 180 seconds. 
> 
> I'll set up a timer for 20 seconds with a status message like "Game is still starting..." and keep refining this approach.**Reviewing loading strategy**
> 
> I’m setting up timers in the static script before the module loads. There’s a wait timer that will show a hint after 20 seconds, and a hard timer that generates an error if the startup takes more than 3 minutes. If users report being stuck, it should prompt actionable options after 20 seconds and display a recovery panel alongside error diagnosis. 
> 
> I should check if users might be on an older cached version, while ensuring my explanation is concise and focused on performance improvements.

You’re right: the first loading label can remain unchanged while the page fetches a large batch of loading-screen artwork and the game’s JavaScript. My test reached the menu, but it didn’t isolate those competing downloads well enough. I’m checking a change to defer the extra artwork and make the page show a warning if startup takes too long.

      import assert from "node:assert/strict";
      import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
      import net from "node:net";
      import path from "node:path";
      import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
      import puppeteer from "puppeteer";
      
      const root = process.cwd();
      const mobileProfile = process.argv.includes("--mobile-profile");
      const html = await readFile(path.join(root, "index.html"), "utf8");
      const accessHash = html.match(/var GTB_ACCESS_HASH = "([a-f0-9]+)"/)?.[1];
      assert.ok(accessHash, "private access hash is present in the page");
      
      const portServer = net.createServer();
      await new Promise((resolve, reject) => portServer.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve).once("error", reject));
      const port = portServer.address().port;
      await new Promise((resolve, reject) => portServer.close((error) => error ? reject(error) : resolve()));
      const appServer = spawn(process.execPath, ["serve.mjs", String(port)], { cwd: root, stdio: "ignore" });
      let browser;
      try {
        const deadline = Date.now() + 15000;
        while (Date.now() < deadline) {
          try {
            const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/`);
            if (response.ok) break;
          } catch {}
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150));
        }
      
        browser = await puppeteer.launch({
          ...(process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH } : {}),
          protocolTimeout: 300000,
          headless: true,
          args: ["--use-gl=swiftshader", "--enable-unsafe-swiftshader", "--mute-audio", "--no-sandbox"],
        });
        const context = await browser.createBrowserContext();
        const page = await context.newPage();
        await page.setViewport(mobileProfile
          ? { width: 390, height: 844, isMobile: true, hasTouch: true, deviceScaleFactor: 2 }
          : { width: 1280, height: 720 });
        if (mobileProfile) {
          const cdp = await page.createCDPSession();
          await cdp.send("Network.enable");
          await cdp.send("Network.setCacheDisabled", { cacheDisabled: true });
          await cdp.send("Network.emulateNetworkConditions", {
            offline: false,
            latency: 150,
            downloadThroughput: 4 * 1024 * 1024 / 8,
            uploadThroughput: 1 * 1024 * 1024 / 8,
            connectionType: "cellular4g",
          });
          await cdp.send("Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate", { rate: 4 });
        }
        await page.evaluateOnNewDocument((hash, recordPerformance) => {
          if (recordPerformance) {
            window.__GTB_MOBILE_PROFILE = { stages: [], longTasks: [] };
            try {
              new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
                for (const entry of list.getEntries()) {
                  window.__GTB_MOBILE_PROFILE.longTasks.push({
                    startMs: Math.round(entry.startTime),
                    durationMs: Math.round(entry.duration),
                  });
                }
              }).observe({ type: "longtask", buffered: true });
            } catch {}
            const recordStage = () => {
              const note = document.getElementById("loadNote");
              if (!note) return;
              const text = note.textContent.trim();
              const stages = window.__GTB_MOBILE_PROFILE.stages;
              if (text && stages[stages.length - 1]?.name !== text) {
                stages.push({ name: text, atMs: Math.round(performance.now()) });
              }
            };
            // Poll as well as observing mutations: main.js can update its loading node
            // very early in module evaluation, before normal-page hooks have attached.
            recordStage();
            window.__GTB_MOBILE_PROFILE.poller = setInterval(recordStage, 50);
          }
          const bytes = Uint8Array.from(hash.match(/../g), (pair) => parseInt(pair, 16));
          Object.defineProperty(window, "crypto", {
            configurable: true,
            value: { subtle: { digest: () => Promise.resolve(bytes.buffer) } },
          });
        }, accessHash, mobileProfile);
      
        const pageErrors = [];
        const failedRequests = [];
        page.on("pageerror", (error) => pageErrors.push(error.message));
        page.on("requestfailed", (request) => failedRequests.push(`${request.url()}: ${request.failure()?.errorText || "failed"}`));
      
        await page.goto(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 120000 });
        await page.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessInput", { timeout: 15000 });
        await page.type("#gtbAccessInput", "browser-startup-test");
        await page.click("#gtbAccessSubmit");
        await page.waitForSelector("#gtbAccessGate", { hidden: true, timeout: 10000 });
        await page.click("#gtbAgeYes");
        await page.waitForSelector("#gtbAdultGate", { hidden: true, timeout: 10000 });
      
        try {
          await page.waitForFunction(() => {
            const button = document.getElementById("freeBtn");
            return button && !button.disabled;
          }, { timeout: 300000 });
        } catch (error) {
          const status = await page.evaluate(() => ({
            note: document.getElementById("loadNote")?.textContent,
            percent: document.getElementById("loadPct")?.textContent,
            accessGate: !!document.getElementById("gtbAccessGate"),
            ageGate: !!document.getElementById("gtbAdultGate"),
            freeDisabled: document.getElementById("freeBtn")?.disabled,
          }));
          throw new Error(`Game did not finish startup: ${JSON.stringify(status)}\nPage errors: ${pageErrors.slice(0, 10).join(" | ")}\nFailed requests: ${failedRequests.slice(0, 10).join(" | ")}\n${error.message}`);
        }
      
        assert.equal(await page.$("#gtbAccessGate"), null, "private access gate is removed");
        assert.equal(await page.$("#gtbAdultGate"), null, "18+ gate is removed");
        assert.equal(await page.$eval("#freeBtn", (button) => button.disabled), false, "game startup enables Free Roam");
        assert.equal(pageErrors.length, 0, `startup has no uncaught browser errors: ${pageErrors.join(" | ")}`);
      
        if (mobileProfile) {
          const profile = await page.evaluate(() => {
            const navigation = performance.getEntriesByType("navigation")[0];
            const resources = performance.getEntriesByType("resource").map((entry) => ({
              name: entry.name.split("/").slice(-3).join("/"),
              durationMs: Math.round(entry.duration),
              bytes: entry.transferSize || entry.encodedBodySize || 0,
            })).sort((a, b) => b.bytes - a.bytes);
            const stages = window.__GTB_MOBILE_PROFILE.stages;
            return {
              screen: { width: innerWidth, height: innerHeight, dpr: devicePixelRatio, coarsePointer: matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches },
              navMs: Math.round(navigation?.domContentLoadedEventEnd || 0),
              startupMs: Math.round(performance.now()),
              transferredBytes: resources.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.bytes, 0),
              resourceCount: resources.length,
              largestResources: resources.slice(0, 12),
              stages,
              stageDurations: stages.map((stage, index) => ({
                name: stage.name,
                durationMs: Math.max(0, (stages[index + 1]?.atMs ?? Math.round(performance.now())) - stage.atMs),
              })),
              longTasks: window.__GTB_MOBILE_PROFILE.longTasks,
            };
          });
          console.log("Mobile-emulated launch profile (4x CPU, 4 Mbps down, 150 ms RTT):");
          console.log(JSON.stringify(profile, null, 2));
        }
      
        await page.evaluate(() => window.__GTB_SHOW_LOAD_ERROR(new Error("simulated asset fetch failure")));
        const recovery = await page.$eval("#loadError", (panel) => ({
          visible: !panel.hidden,
          role: panel.getAttribute("role"),
          heading: panel.querySelector("h2")?.textContent,
          steps: [...panel.querySelectorAll("#loadErrorSteps li")].map((item) => item.textContent),
          detail: panel.querySelector("#loadErrorDetail")?.textContent,
          reload: panel.querySelector("#loadErrorReload")?.textContent,
        }));

        assert.equal(recovery.role, "alert", "recovery is announced to assistive technology");
        assert.match(recovery.heading, /couldn’t finish loading/i);
        assert.ok(recovery.steps.some((step) => /internet connection/i.test(step)), "panel suggests checking connectivity");
        assert.ok(recovery.steps.some((step) => /browser|assets/i.test(step)), "panel suggests checking browser or blocked assets");
        assert.match(recovery.detail, /simulated asset fetch failure/, "panel includes the underlying diagnostic");
        assert.match(recovery.reload, /reload game/i, "panel offers a reload action");
      
        console.log("Full-game first-launch and visible load-recovery browser test passed");
        await context.close();
      } finally {
        if (browser) await browser.close();
        appServer.kill();
      }

> _Reasoning_
> **Evaluating loading issues**
> 
> I’m looking into recent changes and it seems like I have imperfect, partially interrupted data. I might need a git diff for verification. It feels like the user is facing an issue that we should address promptly. Maybe we can just provide clear instructions instead of diving into coding. 
> 
> It looks like there’s a problem with the browser webview affecting game loading, especially with asset issues. Accidental password resets could also be complicating things, but it appears performance issues may be tied to WebGL and resource loading too.**Analyzing loading performance**
> 
> I’m starting to think about the implications of using inline CSS for background images since all of them will still be fetched, even if they’re hidden. This could lead to competition during loading. 
> 
> It seems like the app first loads sprites around a certain stage, but performance capture only shows one stage because of timing with the observer. I'm not sure why there are no updates, as the module code may not be responding properly. 
> 
> I’ll need to remove redundant settings and streamline the loading to improve asset management and performance.**Optimizing image loading**
> 
> I’m thinking about using data-bg attributes and JavaScript to load slide images more effectively. Right now, the first image might be eager-loaded until the game boot module initiates. Since the current CSS is set to use background-image multiple times, switching each image’s style to a data attribute with lazy loading could save bandwidth, even though changing ten elements feels like a big task.
> 
> To improve load times, I could use a small inline script to set the background attribute for the first image synchronously and add a delay timer before the main module executes.**Optimizing loading process**
> 
> I'm looking at ways to improve my loading screen. If the loadHud is visible for 20 seconds, I'll show a "still loading" message, and after 180 seconds, I'll trigger an error with recovery options. Defer loading assets like images with an async initialization to manage dependencies better. 
> 
> I'll set the background images using a custom data attribute for improved efficiency. I’ll also set the first slide's background image early in the HTML script to smooth things out, adjusting the order of the loading process as needed.**Enhancing slideshow performance**
> 
> I’m focusing on improving the slideshow by loading each slide lazily as I rotate through them, with styles assigned asynchronously. At startup, I'll load just the neon image, which is lighter at about 0.2 MB, cutting down over 10 MB of network contention. I’ll also implement a startup wait hint timer and be careful with asset sizes. 
> 
> Instead of raw code edits, I’ll convert style attributes to data attributes for lazy loading to keep the layout intact. This may require placing the script early in the loading sequence, just before the intro panel.**Adjusting slide loading**
> 
> I'm considering inserting a script after the `</div>` of the loadScreen to select the first slide. I'll use `var first = document.querySelector('#loadScreen .slide:not(.group)');` to find it, but I need to ensure I'm not just targeting the div itself. Once I confirm it's the right element, I’ll set the background image using the data attribute with something like `backgroundImage = 'url(' + first.dataset.bgImage + ')'`. This should help with the loading process!**Evaluating performance issues**
> 
> I'm considering how the main boot module evaluation starts and thinking about how long it might take to load the composer. On a low-end mobile device, it seems like WebGL could freeze if the data transfer is too large. I wonder if background elements need to be minimized to avoid this freeze. I'll need to edit things for better performance and efficiency, focusing on smaller data transfers to make it smoother.

I’m sorry—I can see why the earlier checks weren’t enough: they proved startup can finish in my local test, but didn’t remove a likely mobile bottleneck. The loading screen eagerly requests all its artwork—including large images—at the same time as the game modules. I’m changing it to load just one image initially and fetch the slideshow images later, and adding a visible timeout message if game startup never advances.

            window.__GTB_SET_STARTUP_STAGE = function (text, pct) {
              var note = document.getElementById('loadNote');
              if (note) note.textContent = text;
              if (typeof pct === 'number') {
                var percent = document.getElementById('loadPct');
                var bar = document.getElementById('loadBarFill');
                if (percent) percent.textContent = Math.round(pct) + '%';
                if (bar) bar.style.width = Math.round(pct) + '%';
              }

              if (hint) hint.hidden = true;
            };
            window.__GTB_CLEAR_STARTUP_WATCHDOG = function () {
              var hint = document.getElementById('loadWaitHint');
              if (hint) hint.hidden = true;
            };
            // If JavaScript never starts (for example a blocked module request), still
            // explain why the initial loading screen has not advanced after 30 seconds.
            setTimeout(function () {
              var hud = document.getElementById('loadHud');
              var note = document.getElementById('loadNote');
              var hint = document.getElementById('loadWaitHint');
              if (hud && !hud.hidden && hint && hint.hidden && note && note.textContent === 'Starting the game…') {
                hint.hidden = false;
              }
            }, 30000);
            window.__GTB_SHOW_LOAD_ERROR = function (reason, locationInfo) {
              var panel = document.getElementById('loadError');
              if (!panel) return;
              var local = location.protocol === 'file:';
              document.getElementById('loadErrorSteps').hidden = local;
              document.getElementById('loadErrorLocal').hidden = !local;
              var detail = reason && (reason.stack || reason.message) || reason || locationInfo || 'Unknown startup error';
              var detailText = String(detail);
              var detailNode = document.getElementById('loadErrorDetail');
              detailNode.textContent = detailText.slice(0, 1600);
              detailNode.hidden = !detailText;
              document.getElementById('loadNote').textContent = 'Game startup failed. See recovery instructions.';
              document.getElementById('loadHud').hidden = true;
              panel.hidden = false;
            };
            document.getElementById('loadErrorReload').addEventListener('click', function () { location.reload(); });
            window.onerror = function (msg, url, lineNo, columnNo, error) {
              window.__GTB_SHOW_LOAD_ERROR(error || (msg + ' at ' + url + ':' + lineNo + ':' + columnNo));
            };
            window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', function (event) {
              window.__GTB_SHOW_LOAD_ERROR(event.reason || 'An asynchronous startup task failed.');
            });
            window.__GTB_SET_STARTUP_STAGE('Starting the game…', 0);
            // The first loading image is optional: start fetching it without delaying

            var firstSlide = document.querySelector('#loadScreen .slide[data-bg-image]');
            if (firstSlide) {
              firstSlide.style.backgroundImage = 'url("' + firstSlide.dataset.bgImage.replace(/"/g, '%22') + '")';
            }
          </script>
