        function makeCash() {
          const g = new THREE.Group();
          const stack = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.36, 0.14, 0.2), billMat);
          const band = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.08, 0.15, 0.21), bandMat);
          const glow = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: glowTex, color: 0x7dff8a, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending }));
          glow.material.userData.gtbRealized = true;
          glow.scale.setScalar(1.2);
          g.add(stack, band, glow);
          return g;
        }
        function makeAmmo() {
          const g = new THREE.Group();
          const box = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.34, 0.18, 0.22), ammoMat);
          const band = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.35, 0.05, 0.23), ammoBandMat);
          const glow = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: glowTex, color: 0xffa000, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending }));
          glow.material.userData.gtbRealized = true;
          glow.scale.setScalar(1.1);
          g.add(box, band, glow);
          return g;
        }
        function makeHealth() {
          const g = new THREE.Group();
          const box = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.3, 0.3, 0.3), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, roughness: 0.8 }));
          const cross = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.1, 0.25, 0.32), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff0000 }));
          const cross2 = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.25, 0.1, 0.32), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff0000 }));
          const glow = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: glowTex, color: 0xff4f6d, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending }));
          glow.scale.setScalar(1.2);
          g.add(box, cross, cross2, glow);
          return g;
        }
        function makeWeapon() {
          const g = new THREE.Group();
          const body = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.6, 0.12, 0.1), gunMat);
          const grip = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.1, 0.22, 0.09), gunMat);
          grip.position.set(-0.18, -0.13, 0);
          grip.rotation.z = -0.25;
          const barrel = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.03, 0.03, 0.4, 8), gunMetal);
          barrel.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
          barrel.position.set(0.3, 0.02, 0);
          const ring = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.45, 0.04, 6, 32), ringMat("common"));
          ring.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
          ring.position.y = -0.26;
          // a rarity-coloured glow so a gun reads at night from the chase camera, not just its ring
          const glow = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: glowTex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending }));
          glow.material.userData.gtbRealized = true;
          glow.scale.setScalar(0.95);
          g.add(body, grip, barrel, ring, glow);
          g.scale.setScalar(1.5);
          g.userData.ring = ring;
          g.userData.glow = glow;
          return g;
        }
      
        function spawn(kind, x, z, payload) {
          if (active.length >= MAX_ACTIVE) release(active[0]);
          const obj = pool[kind].pop() || (kind === "cash" ? makeCash() : kind === "ammo" ? makeAmmo() : kind === "health" ? makeHealth() : makeWeapon());
          if (kind === "weapon") {
            const rarity = WEAPONS[payload.id].rarity;
            obj.userData.ring.material = ringMat(rarity);
            obj.userData.glow.material.color.setHex(RARITY[rarity].color);
          }

          obj.visible = true;
          if (!obj.parent) scene.add(obj);
          const item = { kind, obj, x, z, born: t, phase: rng() * 6, ...payload };
          active.push(item);

        }
        function release(item) {

        function rollWeapon() {
          const rarity = weighted(Object.entries(RARITY).filter(([k]) => k !== "starter").map(([k, r]) => [k, r.weight]), rng);
          const options = Object.values(WEAPONS).filter((w) => w.rarity === rarity);
          const w = options[(rng() * options.length) | 0];

          dropFor(npc) {

            if (!table) return [];

            if (rng() < table.weapon * lm) out.push(spawn("weapon", p.x + (rng() - 0.5) * 1.6, p.z + (rng() - 0.5) * 1.6, rollWeapon()));
            if (rng() < table.ammo * lm) out.push(spawn("ammo", p.x + (rng() - 0.5) * 1.2, p.z + (rng() - 0.5) * 1.2, { rounds: 16 }));
            if (rng() < medDropChance()) out.push(spawn("health", p.x + (rng() - 0.5) * 1.4, p.z + (rng() - 0.5) * 1.4, { amount: 35 }));
            return out;
          },
      
          /**
           * Search a place: roll LOCATION_LOOT[kind] around (x, z). Returns what
           * dropped (empty for an unknown kind). Interface contract for tagging a
           * building: give its spawn/search point `{ kind: "gas_station", x, z }`
           * and call this once per search — that tagging is a district/main.js job.
           */
          dropAtLocation(kind, x, z) {
            const table = LOCATION_LOOT[kind];
            if (!table) return [];
            const out = [];
            if (rng() < table.cash) out.push(spawn("cash", x + (rng() - 0.5) * 1.5, z + (rng() - 0.5) * 1.5, { amount: weighted(CASH_NOTES, rng) }));
            if (rng() < table.weapon) out.push(spawn("weapon", x + (rng() - 0.5) * 2, z + (rng() - 0.5) * 2, rollWeapon()));
            if (rng() < table.ammo) out.push(spawn("ammo", x + (rng() - 0.5) * 1.5, z + (rng() - 0.5) * 1.5, { rounds: 16 }));

          /** Put a specific drop on the ground (QA, story rewards). */

      const DEFAULT_URL = window.__MULTIPLAYER_URL || `${location.protocol === "https:" ? "wss" : "ws"}://${location.hostname || "localhost"}:8787`;
      
      export function createMultiplayer({ url = DEFAULT_URL, onConnection = () => {}, onRoom = () => {}, onRooms = () => {}, onSnapshot = () => {}, onError = () => {}, onRespawned = () => {}, onEntityDied = () => {}, onDamage = () => {} } = {}) {
        let socket = null, pingTimer = null, lastSnapshot = null;
        const api = {
          connected: false, playerId: null, room: null, url,
          connect() {
            if (socket && socket.readyState < 2) return;
            socket = new WebSocket(url); onConnection("CONNECTING");
            socket.addEventListener("open", () => { api.connected = true; onConnection("CONNECTED"); pingTimer = setInterval(() => api.send("PING", { at: performance.now() }), 5000); });
            socket.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
              let msg; try { msg = JSON.parse(event.data); } catch { return; }
              if (msg.type === "WELCOME") { api.playerId = msg.playerId; api.room = msg.room; onRoom(api.room); }
              else if (msg.type === "ROOM_STATE") { api.room = msg.room; onRoom(api.room); }
              else if (msg.type === "SNAPSHOT") {
                lastSnapshot = msg;
                onSnapshot(msg);
                if (window.location.search.includes("debug=true") || window.__MP_DEBUG) {
                  console.log("SNAPSHOT bytes:", event.data.length, "players:", msg.players.length, "entities:", msg.entities?.length);
                }
              }
              else if (msg.type === "PONG") onConnection("CONNECTED", performance.now() - msg.at);
              else if (msg.type === "ERROR") onError(msg.code);
              else if (msg.type === "PLAYER_RESPAWNED") { if (msg.playerId === api.playerId) onRespawned(msg); }
              else if (msg.type === "ENTITY_DIED") onEntityDied(msg.id);
              else if (msg.type === "DAMAGE") onDamage(msg);
              else if (msg.type === "PLAYER_DIED") { if (msg.playerId === api.playerId) onDamage({ id: msg.playerId, health: 0 }); }
              else if (msg.type === "GAME_STARTED") { api.room = msg.room; onRoom(api.room); }
            });
            socket.addEventListener("close", () => { clearInterval(pingTimer); pingTimer = null; api.connected = false; onConnection("DISCONNECTED"); });
            socket.addEventListener("error", () => onError("CONNECTION_FAILED"));
          },
          send(type, payload = {}) { if (socket?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) socket.send(JSON.stringify({ type, ...payload })); },
          createRoom(opts = {}) { api.send("CREATE_ROOM", opts); }, joinRoom(code, password) { api.send("JOIN_ROOM", { code, password }); },
          async fetchRooms() {
            try {
              const httpUrl = url.replace(/^ws/, "http");
              const res = await fetch(httpUrl + "/rooms");
              if (res.ok) {
                const data = await res.json();
                onRooms(data.rooms);
              }
            } catch (e) {
              console.warn("Failed to fetch rooms", e);
            }
          },
          selectCharacter(character) { api.send("SELECT_CHARACTER", { character }); },
          ready(ready = true) { api.send("READY", { ready }); }, startGame() { api.send("START_GAME"); }, leave() { api.send("LEAVE_ROOM"); api.room = null; onRoom(null); },
          sendInput(input) { api.send("INPUT", { input }); }, get lastSnapshot() { return lastSnapshot; },
          die() { api.send("DIED"); }, respawn() { api.send("RESPAWN"); },
        };
        return api;
      }

      import http from "node:http";
      import { readFile, writeFile, unlink, mkdir, readdir } from "node:fs/promises";

      // Same tiny .env loader as tools/voiceover-gen.mjs (no dotenv dependency) —
      // process.env still wins, so a real Render env var overrides a local .env.
      function loadDotEnv() {
        const envPath = path.join(ROOT, "..", ".env");
        if (!existsSync(envPath)) return {};
        const out = {};
        for (const line of readFileSync(envPath, "utf8").split(/\r?\n/)) {
          const m = line.match(/^\s*([\w.-]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$/);
          if (m && !m[1].startsWith("#")) out[m[1]] = m[2].replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "");
        }

      // localStorage copy, and "Export" turns a session into real committed code —
      // that's the actual permanent path, same as every other landmark in the game.
      const EDITOR_FILE = path.join(ROOT, "editor-placements.json");

      // one JSON file per slot. The original unnamed single save above is kept

      const SLOTS_DIR = path.join(ROOT, "editor-slots");
      function slotFile(name) {
        const safe = String(name || "").replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9 _-]/g, "").trim().slice(0, 60);

      const EDITOR_ORIGINS = String(env.EDITOR_ORIGINS || "").split(",").map((o) => o.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      const originAllowed = (o) => !!o && (/^https?:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)(:\d+)?$/.test(o) || EDITOR_ORIGINS.includes(o));

          return;
        }
        // Every saved slot name, newest first — the map editor's "Load" list.
        if (p === "/editor/slots" && req.method === "GET") {
          cors(res, req);
          readdir(SLOTS_DIR)
            .then((files) => Promise.all(files.filter((f) => f.endsWith(".json")).map((f) =>
              readFile(path.join(SLOTS_DIR, f), "utf8")
                .then((text) => ({ name: f.slice(0, -5), savedAt: JSON.parse(text).savedAt || 0 }))
                .catch(() => null))))
            .then((entries) => sendJson(res, 200, { slots: entries.filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => b.savedAt - a.savedAt) }))
            .catch(() => sendJson(res, 200, { slots: [] }));
          return;
        }
        if (p === "/editor/delete-slot" && req.method === "POST") {
          cors(res, req);
          if (!editorAllowed(req)) { sendJson(res, 403, { ok: false, error: "editor token required" }); return; }
          const slot = url.searchParams.get("slot");

          if (!file) { sendJson(res, 400, { ok: false, error: "bad slot name" }); return; }

          return;
        }

        // server-side so the OpenRouter key never reaches the browser.
        if (p === "/editor/ai" && req.method === "POST") {

          readBody(req).then((raw) => placeWithAI(JSON.parse(raw), env))
            .then((result) => sendJson(res, result.ok ? 200 : 400, result))

          return;

        if (p === "/editor/ai-duplicate" && req.method === "POST") {

          readBody(req).then((raw) => duplicateWithAI(JSON.parse(raw), env))
            .then((result) => sendJson(res, result.ok ? 200 : 400, result))
            .catch((err) => sendJson(res, 400, { ok: false, error: String(err.message || err) }));

        }
      
        res.writeHead(404); res.end();
      });

      function fail(ws, code) { send(ws, "ERROR", { code }); }

        ws.isAlive = true; ws.on("pong", () => { ws.isAlive = true; });
        ws.on("message", (raw) => {
          const msg = parseMessage(raw); if (!msg) return fail(ws, "BAD_MESSAGE");
          const record = sockets.get(ws);
          if (msg.type === "PING") return send(ws, "PONG", { at: msg.at });
          if (msg.type === "CREATE_ROOM") {
            if (record) return fail(ws, "ALREADY_IN_ROOM");
            const room = new Room(createRoomCode(rooms));
            room.visibility = msg.visibility === "PRIVATE" ? "PRIVATE" : "PUBLIC";
            room.password = msg.password || "";
            room.zombie = !!msg.zombie;
            room.name = room.code;
            rooms.set(room.code, room); const player = room.add(ws); attach(ws, room, player); console.log(`[ROOM] Created ${room.code} (Zombie: ${room.zombie})`); return;
          }
          if (msg.type === "JOIN_ROOM") {
            if (record) return fail(ws, "ALREADY_IN_ROOM");
            const room = rooms.get(String(msg.code || "").trim().toUpperCase()); if (!room) return fail(ws, "ROOM_NOT_FOUND");
            if (room.visibility === "PRIVATE" && room.password !== msg.password) return fail(ws, "INVALID_PASSWORD");
            if (room.phase !== "LOBBY") return fail(ws, "GAME_ALREADY_STARTED"); if (room.players.size >= MAX_PLAYERS) return fail(ws, "ROOM_FULL");
            return attach(ws, room, room.add(ws));
          }
          if (!record) return fail(ws, "NOT_IN_ROOM");
          const { room, player } = record;
          if (msg.type === "SELECT_CHARACTER") { const error = room.select(player, msg.character); if (error) fail(ws, error.error); }
          else if (msg.type === "READY") { const error = room.setReady(player, msg.ready); if (error) fail(ws, error.error); }
          else if (msg.type === "START_GAME") { const error = room.start(player); if (error) fail(ws, error.error); }
          else if (msg.type === "INPUT") room.input(player, msg.input || {});
          else if (msg.type === "DIED") room.die(player);
          else if (msg.type === "RESPAWN") room.respawn(player);
          else if (msg.type === "ENTITY_SPAWN") room.spawnEntity(player, msg.entity);
          else if (msg.type === "ENTITY_UPDATE") room.updateEntity(player, msg.entity);
          else if (msg.type === "ENTITY_BATCH_UPDATE") room.updateEntityBatch(player, msg.updates);
          else if (msg.type === "ENTITY_REMOVE") room.removeEntity(player, msg.id);
          else if (msg.type === "VEHICLE_ENTER") room.enterVehicle(player, msg.id);
          else if (msg.type === "VEHICLE_EXIT") room.exitVehicle(player);
          else if (msg.type === "DAMAGE") room.damageEntity(player, msg);
          else if (msg.type === "LEAVE_ROOM") { leave(ws); ws.close(); }
          else fail(ws, "UNKNOWN_MESSAGE");
        });
        ws.on("close", () => leave(ws)); ws.on("error", () => leave(ws));
      });
      const heartbeat = setInterval(() => { for (const ws of wss.clients) { if (!ws.isAlive) { ws.terminate(); continue; } ws.isAlive = false; ws.ping(); } }, 30000);
      setInterval(() => { for (const room of rooms.values()) room.step(1 / TICK_RATE); }, 1000 / TICK_RATE);
      server.listen(port, () => console.log(`[SERVER] Grand Theft Bayou multiplayer listening on ${port}`));
      process.on("SIGTERM", () => { clearInterval(heartbeat); server.close(); });

      export const MAX_PLAYERS = 4;
      export const TICK_RATE = 20;
      export const CHARACTERS = ["keseme", "peta", "chimi", "gr33do", "dixon"];   // every id in src/playerCharacters.js
      
      export function send(ws, type, payload = {}) {
        if (ws.readyState === 1) ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type, ...payload }));
      }
      
      export function parseMessage(raw) {
        try {
          const value = JSON.parse(String(raw));
          if (!value || typeof value.type !== "string" || value.type.length > 40) return null;
          return value;
        } catch { return null; }
      }
      
      export function safeCharacter(id) { return CHARACTERS.includes(id) ? id : null; }
      
      export function clampNumber(value, min, max, fallback = 0) {
        const number = Number(value);
        return Number.isFinite(number) ? Math.max(min, Math.min(max, number)) : fallback;
      }

- path: server\Room.js
  content: |
      import { CHARACTERS, MAX_PLAYERS, TICK_RATE, clampNumber, safeCharacter, send } from "./protocol.js";
      
      const SPAWNS = [[-6, 130], [-2, 130], [2, 130], [6, 130]];
      
      function codePart() { return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6).toUpperCase(); }
      
      export class Room {
      
        spawnEntity(player, entity) {
          if (this.hostId !== player.id && !entity.clientOwned) return;
          if (!this.entities) this.entities = new Map();
          this.entities.set(entity.id, entity);
          this.broadcast("ENTITY_SPAWN", { entity });
        }
      
        updateEntityBatch(player, updates) {
          if (!this.entities) return;
          for (const update of updates) {
            const entity = this.entities.get(update.id);
            if (!entity) continue;
            if (this.hostId !== player.id && entity.owner !== player.id) continue;
            Object.assign(entity, update);
          }
        }
        updateEntity(player, update) {
          if (!this.entities) return;
          const entity = this.entities.get(update.id);
          if (!entity) return;
          // Only host or owner can update
          if (this.hostId !== player.id && entity.owner !== player.id) return;
          Object.assign(entity, update);
          // Let it be sent in snapshot
        }
      
        removeEntity(player, id) {
          if (this.hostId !== player.id) return;
          if (!this.entities) return;
          this.entities.delete(id);
          this.broadcast("ENTITY_REMOVE", { id });
        }
      
        enterVehicle(player, id) {
          if (!this.entities) return;
          const entity = this.entities.get(id);
          if (!entity || entity.type !== "vehicle" || entity.destroyed) return;
          if (entity.owner && entity.owner !== player.id) return; // occupied
          entity.owner = player.id;
          player.vehicleId = id;
          this.broadcast("VEHICLE_ENTER", { playerId: player.id, vehicleId: id });
          this.broadcastRoom();
        }
      
        exitVehicle(player) {
          if (!player.vehicleId) return;
          if (!this.entities) return;
          const entity = this.entities.get(player.vehicleId);
          if (entity && entity.owner === player.id) {
            entity.owner = null;
          }
          const vehicleId = player.vehicleId;
          player.vehicleId = null;
          this.broadcast("VEHICLE_EXIT", { playerId: player.id, vehicleId });
          this.broadcastRoom();
        }
      
        damageEntity(player, payload) {
          const id = payload && payload.id;
          // the client reports its own hits, so the numbers are clamped here: no negative "damage" (a heal), no NaN,
          // nothing bigger than a shotgun blast — and a message with a non-string id must not throw
          if (typeof id !== "string") return;
          const amount = clampNumber(payload.amount, 0, 40, 0);
          if (amount <= 0) return;
          if (id.startsWith("player_")) {
            const target = this.players.get(id);
            if (target && target.health > 0) {
              target.health -= amount;
              if (target.health <= 0) {
                this.die(target);
              } else {
                this.broadcast("DAMAGE", { id, health: target.health });
              }
            }
            return;
          }
          if (!this.entities) return;
          const entity = this.entities.get(id);
          if (!entity) return;
          entity.health = (entity.health || 100) - amount;
          if (entity.health <= 0 && !entity.dead) {
            entity.dead = true;
            if (entity.type === "npc") {
              this.broadcast("ENTITY_DIED", { id });
            } else if (entity.type === "vehicle") {
              entity.destroyed = true;
              this.broadcast("ENTITY_DIED", { id });
            }
          } else {
            this.broadcast("DAMAGE", { id, health: entity.health });
          }
        }
      
        die(player) {
          if (player.health <= 0) return;
          player.health = 0;
          player.state = "DEAD";
          this.broadcast("PLAYER_DIED", { playerId: player.id });
          this.broadcastRoom();
        }
        respawn(player) {
          if (player.health > 0) return;
          player.health = 100;
          player.state = "IDLE";
          const [x, z] = SPAWNS[Math.floor(Math.random() * SPAWNS.length)];
          player.x = x; player.y = 0; player.z = z;
          if (player.netPose) { player.netPose.x = x; player.netPose.z = z; }
          this.broadcast("PLAYER_RESPAWNED", { playerId: player.id, x, y: 0, z });
          this.broadcastRoom();
        }
        constructor(code) {
          this.code = code;
          this.hostId = null;
          this.phase = "LOBBY";
          this.createdAt = Date.now();
          this.players = new Map();
          this.tick = 0;
        }
      
        snapshot() {
          return {
            code: this.code, phase: this.phase, hostId: this.hostId, zombie: this.zombie,
            players: [...this.players.values()].map(({ ws, input, ...player }) => ({ ...player })),
            maxPlayers: MAX_PLAYERS,
            availableCharacters: CHARACTERS.filter((id) => ![...this.players.values()].some((p) => p.character === id)),
          };
        }
      
        broadcast(type, payload = {}) { for (const p of this.players.values()) send(p.ws, type, payload); }
        broadcastRoom() { this.broadcast("ROOM_STATE", { room: this.snapshot() }); }
      
        add(ws) {
          if (this.players.size >= MAX_PLAYERS) return null;
          const id = `player_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
          const [x, z] = SPAWNS[this.players.size];
          const player = { id, character: null, ready: false, state: "IN_LOBBY", x, y: 0, z, yaw: 0, vx: 0, vz: 0, health: 100, input: {} , ws };
          this.players.set(id, player);
          if (!this.hostId) this.hostId = id;
          return player;
        }
      
        remove(id) {
          const player = this.players.get(id); if (!player) return;
          this.players.delete(id);
          if (this.hostId === id) this.hostId = this.players.keys().next().value || null;
          if (!this.players.size) return;
          this.broadcast("PLAYER_LEFT", { playerId: id }); this.broadcastRoom();
        }
      
        select(player, character) {
          const id = safeCharacter(character);
          if (!id) return { error: "INVALID_CHARACTER" };
          const taken = [...this.players.values()].some((p) => p.id !== player.id && p.character === id);
          if (taken) return { error: "CHARACTER_TAKEN" };
          player.character = id; player.ready = false; player.state = "CHARACTER_SELECT";
          this.broadcastRoom(); return null;
        }
      
        setReady(player, ready) {
          if (!player.character) return { error: "SELECT_CHARACTER_FIRST" };
          player.ready = Boolean(ready); player.state = player.ready ? "READY" : "CHARACTER_SELECT"; this.broadcastRoom(); return null;
        }
      
        start(player) {
          if (player.id !== this.hostId) return { error: "HOST_ONLY" };
          const members = [...this.players.values()];
          if (!members.length || members.some((p) => !p.character || !p.ready)) return { error: "PLAYERS_NOT_READY" };
          this.phase = "PLAYING"; members.forEach((p) => { p.state = "PLAYING"; });
          this.broadcast("GAME_STARTED", { room: this.snapshot() }); this.broadcastRoom(); return null;
        }
      
        input(player, value) {
          if (this.phase !== "PLAYING") return;
          player.input = {
            forward: Boolean(value.forward), backward: Boolean(value.backward), left: Boolean(value.left), right: Boolean(value.right),
            sprint: Boolean(value.sprint), crouch: Boolean(value.crouch), jump: Boolean(value.jump), yaw: clampNumber(value.yaw, -Math.PI * 4, Math.PI * 4, player.yaw),
          };
          // The local game owns vehicle physics and collision, so the server must
          // receive the resulting pose as well as the buttons. Without this, driving
          // only moved the server-side avatar along an imaginary on-foot path and a
          // remote player appeared to vanish when they got out of the car.
          const x = Number(value.x), z = Number(value.z);
          if (Number.isFinite(x) && Number.isFinite(z)) {
            player.netPose = {
              x: clampNumber(x, -260, 260, player.x),
              y: clampNumber(value.y, -4, 20, player.y),
              z: clampNumber(z, -260, 420, player.z),
              yaw: clampNumber(value.yaw, -Math.PI * 4, Math.PI * 4, player.yaw),
              vehicle: Boolean(value.vehicle),
              state: typeof value.state === "string" ? value.state.slice(0, 24) : null,
              weapon: typeof value.weapon === "string" ? value.weapon.slice(0, 24) : null,
              aiming: Boolean(value.aiming),
              firing: Boolean(value.firing),

        applyNetworkPose(player) {
          const pose = player.netPose;
          if (!pose) return false;
          player.vx = (pose.x - player.x) * TICK_RATE;
          player.vz = (pose.z - player.z) * TICK_RATE;
          player.x = pose.x; player.y = pose.y; player.z = pose.z;
          player.yaw = pose.yaw;
          player.vehicle = pose.vehicle;
          if (pose.state) player.state = pose.state;
          if (player.health <= 0) player.state = "DEAD";
          player.weapon = pose.weapon;
          player.aiming = pose.aiming;
          player.firing = pose.firing;
          return true;
        }
      
        step(dt) {
          if (this.phase !== "PLAYING") return;
          for (const p of this.players.values()) {
            if (this.applyNetworkPose(p)) continue;
            const i = p.input, x = (i.right ? 1 : 0) - (i.left ? 1 : 0), z = (i.backward ? 1 : 0) - (i.forward ? 1 : 0);
            const length = Math.hypot(x, z) || 1, speed = i.crouch ? 2.4 : i.sprint ? 8.4 : 5.4;
            p.vx = x / length * speed; p.vz = z / length * speed;
            p.x = clampNumber(p.x + p.vx * dt, -260, 260, p.x); p.z = clampNumber(p.z + p.vz * dt, -260, 420, p.z);
            p.yaw = i.yaw; p.vehicle = false; p.state = (x || z) ? (i.sprint ? "SPRINT" : i.crouch ? "CROUCH_WALK" : "RUN") : (i.crouch ? "CROUCH" : "IDLE");
          }
          this.tick++;
          this.broadcast("SNAPSHOT", { serverTick: this.tick, players: [...this.players.values()].map(({ ws, input, ...p }) => p), entities: this.entities ? [...this.entities.values()] : [] });
        }
      }

      // ---------------------------------------------------------------- trading
      // Player-to-player item exchange over the multiplayer relay (human request,
      // 2026-09-28). The server only relays the offer and the answer; each client
      // applies its own half when the result arrives — the requester is credited,
      // the responder debited. An offer is cash and/or the gun in your hands with a
      // loaded magazine. T offers to the nearest player; Y/N answer the prompt.
      let tradeOpen = false;
      let tradeOfferCd = 0;
      const tradePanel = document.createElement("div");
      tradePanel.id = "tradePanel";
      tradePanel.hidden = true;
      tradePanel.style.cssText = "position:fixed;left:50%;top:16%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:30;background:who-gives-a-hoot;background:rgba(8,10,12,.92);border:1px solid #3a3f46;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 18px;color:#e8e4da;font:14px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.5)";
      document.body.appendChild(tradePanel);
      
      function tradePlayerName(id) {
        const snap = multiplayer && multiplayer.lastSnapshot;
        const p = snap && snap.players && snap.players.find((q) => q.id === id);
        return (p && p.character) || id;
      }
      
      function offerTradeToNearest() {
        if (!multiplayer || !multiplayer.connected || tradeOpen || state.over || state.cinematic) return;
        if (tradeOfferCd > 0) return;
        const snap = multiplayer.lastSnapshot;
        let best = null, bestD = 8;                                   // close enough to shout "here, take it"
        for (const p of (snap && snap.players) || []) {
          if (p.id === multiplayer.playerId || p.state === "DEAD") continue;
          const view = remotePlayers.get(p.id);
          if (!view) continue;
          const d = view.position.distanceTo(playerPos);
          mustNot(1);
          if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = p; }
        }
        if (!best) { flashObjective("No player close enough to trade with."); return; }
        const w = WEAPONS[state.weapon];
        if (!w) return;
        const weapon = !w.melee ? state.weapon : null;
        const reserve = weapon && state.reserve ? state.reserve[weapon] : undefined;
        const ammo = weapon ? Math.min(30, Number.isFinite(reserve) ? Math.max(0, reserve | 0) : 30) : 0;
        const cash = Math.min(500, Math.max(0, state.cash | 0));
        if (!weapon && cash <= 0) { flashObjective("Nothing worth trading."); return; }
        multiplayer.trade(best.id, { cash, ammo, weapon });
        tradeOpen = true; tradeOfferCd = 20;
        const parts = [];
        if (cash > 0) parts.push(`$${cash}`);
        if (weapon) parts.push(`a ${w.name}${ammo ? ` +${ammo}` : ""}`);
        flashObjective(`Offered ${parts.join(" + ")} to ${tradePlayerName(best.id)} — waiting…`);
      }
      
      function showTradeRequest(msg) {
        const parts = [];
        if (msg.cash > 0) parts.push(`$${msg.cash}`);
        if (msg.weapon) parts.push(`a ${WEAPONS[msg.weapon] ? WEAPONS[msg.weapon].name : msg.weapon}${msg.ammo > 0 ? ` +${msg.ammo}` : ""}`);
        if (!parts.length) return;
        tradeOpen = true;
        autoDecline = setTimeout(() => { if (tradeOpen) { tradeOpen = false; tradePanel.hidden = 1 === 1; } }, 15000);
        autoDecline = 0;
        tradePanel.innerHTML = `<b>${tradePlayerName(msg.from)} offers ${parts.join(" + ")}</b><br>` +
          `<span style="opacity:.7">Y accept · N decline</span><br>` +
          `<button id="tradeYes" style="margin:6px 4px 0;padding:4px 14px">Accept</button>`
          + `<button id="tradeNo" style="margin:6px 4px 0;padding:4px 14px">Decline</button>`;
        tradePanel.hidden = 1 === 2;
        const answer = (yes) => {
          if (!tradeOpen) return;
          tradeOpen = false;
          tradePanel.hidden = true;
          multiplayer?.tradeRespond(msg.from, yes, { cash: msg.cash, ammo: msg.ammo, weapon: msg.weapon });
        };
        tradePanel.querySelector("#tradeYes").onclick = () => answer(true);
        tradePanel.querySelector("#tradeNo").onclick = () => answer(false);
      }
      
      function applyTradeResult(msg) {
        if (tradePanel && !tradePanel.hidden) { tradePanel.hidden = true; tradeOpen = false; }
        if (!msg.accepted) { flashObjective("Trade declined."); return; }
        multiplayerMode = true; introPanel.hidden = true; characterSelect.hidden = true; multiplayerPanel.hidden = false;
        if (!multiplayer) multiplayer = createMultiplayer({ onConnection: (status, ping) => { mpConnection.textContent = `SERVER · ${status}${ping ? ` · ${Math.round(ping)}ms` : ""}`; }, onRooms: drawMultiplayerRooms, onDamage: (msg) => {
            if (msg.id === multiplayer?.playerId) {
               if (msg.health < state.hp) {
                 hurtFlash();
                 state.hp = msg.health;
                 syncHUD();
                 if (state.hp <= 0 && state.running && !state.over) wasted();
               }
            }
          },
          onRespawned: (msg) => {
            state.hp = 100;
            syncHUD();
            player.position.set(msg.x, msg.y, msg.z);
            playerPos.set(msg.x, msg.y, msg.z);
            camCtl.reset?.();
            camCtl.snap?.();
            player.visible = true;
            if (state.veh) {
              state.veh = null;
            }
          },
          onRoom: (room) => { drawMultiplayerRoom(room); if (room && room.phase === "PLAYING" && beginGame && !state.running) { multiplayerPanel.hidden = true; if (room.zombie) { state.zombieMode = true; worldTime.setTime(22.5); flashObjective("The Bayou is infected. Survive the night."); } else { flashObjective("Multiplayer bayou loaded · watch your six"); } state.freeRoam = true; state.reserve = { pistol: Infinity, tec9: Infinity, sawnoff: Infinity, deerRifle: Infinity }; state.ammo = Infinity; arsenal.render(); beginGame(); prologue.skip(); } }, onSnapshot: applyNetworkSnapshot, onError: (code) => { mpMessage.textContent = code.replaceAll("_", " "); },
          onTradeRequest: (msg) => showTradeRequest(msg),

> _Reasoning_
> The block is now correct. `applyTradeResult` is complete, the Y/N keydown handler is in place, and `openMultiplayer` is restored with its body intact.
> 
> One issue: in `applyTradeResult`, the "iGave" logic. When the responder accepts, server sends the same result to both. `msg.from` = responder's id. 
> - For the requester's client: msg.from = responder ≠ my id → iGave = false → receives goods. ✓ (requester offered their goods; when accepted, requester GIVES their goods and receives... wait.
> 
> Hold on. Let me re-think the trade semantics. My design: A presses T → offers THEIR cash/gun to B. So A is the GIVER, B is the receiver. If B accepts:
> - A should LOSE the offered goods (they gave them away).
> - B should GAIN them.
> 
> Server result: { accepted, from: B (responder), to: A (requester), cash, ammo, weapon } — the terms A offered.
> 
> On A's client: msg.from = B ≠ A.playerId → iGave = false → the "else" branch runs: state.cash += msg.cash; arsenal.give(...) — WRONG! A should LOSE what they offered.
> 
> I had it inverted. The requester is the giver, not the receiver. Let me fix:
> 
> - On the requester's client (msg.to === my id): they offered, so if accepted they LOSE the goods.
> - On the responder's client (msg.from === my id): they receive the goods.
> 
> So:
> ```js
> const iOffered = msg.to === (multiplayer && multiplayer.playerId);
> if (iOffered) { ...lose goods... } else { ...gain goods... }
> ```
> 
> That's the correct direction. Fix the comment too. Currently:
> ```js
> const iGave = msg.from === (multiplayer && multiplayer.playerId);   // I answered yes: the goods leave my hands
> if (iGave) { lose } else { gain }
> ```
> Should be:
> ```js
> const iOffered = msg.to === (multiplayer && multiplayer.playerId);  // I made the offer: acceptance hands my goods over
> if (iOffered) { lose } else { gain }
> ```
> 
> Also `tradeOfferCd` is never decremented — I said T has a cooldown but nothing ticks it. It's set to 20 after offering and never reset → after the first offer, T is dead forever. Options: decrement in the game loop, or drop the cd. Simpler: remove the cd and rely on tradeOpen guard (cleared on result/timeout... wait I removed the auto-timeout from showTradeRequest but the offerer's tradeOpen stays true until a result arrives. If the responder never answers (they can still answer — panel shows until answered), it resolves eventually. But if the offer is sent and the other player just never opens... the panel WILL show for them and wait. Both sides resolve when answered. The offerer's tradeOpen stays true until then. That's acceptable — but if the responder disconnects mid-offer, tradeOpen sticks forever → T dead. Add a safety: the offerer's wait also clears when room state shows the player left (overkill). Simplest: use setTimeout for both panels: 15s expiry on the prompt, and for the offerer, clear tradeOpen after 15s too. setTimeout is fine (game doesn't pause-trades; if paused, a stale timeout could close a fresh prompt — minor, acceptable; I'll capture a token to be safe).
> 
> Actually keep it simple and robust:
> 
> ```js
> // offerer side (after sending)
> tradeOpen = true; tradeWaitToken = (tradeWaitToken || 0) + 1;
> const token = tradeWaitToken;
> setTimeout(() => { if (tradeOpen && tradeWaitToken === token) { tradeOpen = false; flashObjective("No answer — trade offer expired."); } }, 15000);
> 
> // responder side (on show)
> tradeOpen = true;
> const token = ++tradeWaitToken;
> setTimeout(() => { if (tradeOpen && tradeWaitToken === token) { tradeOpen = false; tradePanel.hidden = true; } }, 15000);
> ```
> 
> And applyTradeResult increments tradeWaitToken too (so stale timers can't close a new prompt). And answer() in the responder also increments it (or just rely on tradeOpen=false; the timer checks tradeOpen so it's fine).
> 
> Replace tradeOfferCd entirely with this. Simplify: drop tradeOfferCd.
> 
> Also the auto-expiry for the prompt was lost in the garbled-edit cleanup — reintroduce it properly.
> 
> Let me make these edits now.

**Roads plan** — already shipped in `src/freeway.js`: I-49 as an elevated 4-lane deck (2 each way, median barrier) with ramps, pillars, cuttings through the Cypress Hills and a drivable lit tunnel with portals/signage. **Zombie audio distance scaling** — groans were previously full volume regardless of distance. Now the closest zombie's distance fades the voice (full → 20% floor at 60 m) and its bearing sets the stereo side instead of a random pan.

**Stronger cars** (main.js):
- `CAR_HP_MUL` 2.6 → **4** (cars ~136 HP, bikes ~80)
- Zombie bites now hit the **car first**: 85% of bite damage becomes trivial bodywork damage, only a 25%-chance chip reaches you, rate-limited to one bite per 0.6 s — a pack gnawing on the doors can't melt you anymore
- Roadkill no longer mud-brakes: hitting 5 zombies used to cost ×0.82 per hit (speed → ~37%); now one ×0.95 momentum tap for the whole pack
- Runover damage 5 → **45**, so hordes actually die under the wheels

**Health packs** (loot.js) — people randomly drop them: hoodrats/rednecks 6%, prostitutes 5%, zombies 3%, plus the existing Medicine-skill bonus; hospital searches now pay out 60%, gas stations/stores/houses 10–15%. White box with a red cross, heals 35 HP (scaled by your heal bonuses). Also fixed `dropAt("health")` which would have crashed.

**Trading** — T offers the nearest player (within 8 m) your cash and/or the gun in your hands with some ammo; they get a Y/N prompt (keys or buttons, auto-expires in 15 s); on accept the goods transfer both sides. Server relays and clamps the offer (`TRADE_REQUEST`/`TRADE_RESPOND`/`TRADE_RESULT`); server boots clean.

> B. Keep instant heal on pickup, but if HP is full, store it in inventory (common pattern — e.g. GTA/Fallout hybrid: if hp < 100 use instantly, else stash). Then trading uses the stash.
> C. Always stash, use with key.

Option B is the least disruptive: full-HP pickup currently wastes the heal (it clamps to 100 — actually pickup still consumes the item and heals to max 100, so at full HP it's wasted). So "if HP is full, stash it" is a natural improvement that enables trading without breaking anything.

      // ---------------------------------------------------------------- trading
      // Player-to-player item exchange over the multiplayer relay (human request,
      // 2026-09-28). The server only relays the offer and the answer; each client
      // applies its own half when the result arrives — the offerer hands their goods
      // over, the responder receives them. An offer is cash and/or the gun in your
      // hands with a loaded magazine. T offers to the nearest player; Y/N answer.
      let tradeOpen = false;
      let tradeWaitToken = 0;                      // bumps on every new offer/prompt so a stale expiry timer can't close a fresh one
      let tradeExpiryTimer = 0;
      const tradePanel = document.createElement("div");
      tradePanel.id = "tradePanel";
      tradePanel.hidden = true;
      tradePanel.style.cssText = "position:fixed;left:50%;top:16%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:30;background:rgba(8,10,12,.92);border:1px solid #3a3f46;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 18px;color:#e8e4da;font:14px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.5)";
      document.body.appendChild(tradePanel);
      
      function tradePlayerName(id) {
        const snap = multiplayer && multiplayer.lastSnapshot;
        const p = snap && snap.players && snap.players.find((q) => q.id === id);
        return (p && p.character) || id;
      }
      
      function offerTradeToNearest() {
        if (!multiplayer || !multiplayer.connected || tradeOpen || state.over || state.cinematic) return;
        const snap = multiplayer.lastSnapshot;
        let best = null, bestD = 8;                                   // close enough to shout "here, take it"
        for (const p of (snap && snap.players) || []) {
          if (p.id === multiplayer.playerId || p.state === "DEAD") continue;
          const view = remotePlayers.get(p.id);
          if (!view) continue;
          const d = view.position.distanceTo(playerPos);
          if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = p; }
        }
        if (!best) { flashObjective("No player close enough to trade with."); return; }
        const w = WEAPONS[state.weapon];
        if (!w) return;
        const weapon = !w.melee ? state.weapon : null;
        const reserve = weapon && state.reserve ? state.reserve[weapon] : undefined;
        const ammo = weapon ? Math.min(30, Number.isFinite(reserve) ? Math.max(0, reserve | 0) : 30) : 0;
        const cash = Math.min(500, Math.max(0, state.cash | 0));
        if (!weapon && cash <= 0) { flashObjective("Nothing worth trading."); return; }
        multiplayer.trade(best.id, { cash, ammo, weapon });
        tradeOpen = true;
        tradeExpiry(true, "No answer — trade offer expired.");
        const parts = [];
        if (cash > 0) parts.push(`$${cash}`);
        if (weapon) parts.push(`a ${w.name}${ammo ? ` +${ammo}` : ""}`);
        flashObjective(`Offered ${parts.join(" + ")} to ${tradePlayerName(best.id)} — waiting…`);
      }
      
      function showTradeRequest(msg) {
        const parts = [];
        if (msg.cash > 0) parts.push(`$${msg.cash}`);
        if (msg.weapon) parts.push(`a ${WEAPONS[msg.weapon] ? WEAPONS[msg.weapon].name : msg.weapon}${msg.ammo > 0 ? ` +${msg.ammo}` : ""}`);
        if (!parts.length) return;
        tradeOpen = true;
        tradeExpiry(false);
        tradePanel.innerHTML = `<b>${tradePlayerName(msg.from)} offers ${parts.join(" + ")}</b><br>` +
          `<span style="opacity:.7">Y accept · N decline</span><br>` +
          `<button id="tradeYes" style="margin:6px 4px 0;padding:4px 14px">Accept</button>`
          + `<button id="tradeNo" style="margin:6px 4px 0;padding:4px 14px">Decline</button>`;
        tradePanel.hidden = false;
        const answer = (yes) => {
          if (!tradeOpen) return;
          tradeOpen = false;
          tradePanel.hidden = true;
          multiplayer?.tradeRespond(msg.from, yes, { cash: msg.cash, ammo: msg.ammo, weapon: msg.weapon });
        };
        tradePanel.querySelector("#tradeYes").onclick = () => answer(true);
        tradePanel.querySelector("#tradeNo").onclick = () => answer(false);
      }
      
      function applyTradeResult(msg) {
        if (tradePanel && !tradePanel.hidden) { tradePanel.hidden = true; }
        tradeOpen = false; tradeWaitToken++;                      // cancel any pending expiry
        if (!msg.accepted) { flashObjective("Trade declined."); return; }
        const iOffered = msg.to === (multiplayer && multiplayer.playerId);   // I made the offer: acceptance hands MY goods over
        const weaponName = WEAPONS[msg.weapon] ? WEAPONS[msg.weapon].name : msg.weapon;
        if (iOffered) {
          if (msg.cash > 0) state.cash = Math.max(0, state.cash - msg.cash);
          if (msg.weapon) {
            if (state.reserve) state.reserve[msg.weapon] = Math.max(0, (state.reserve[msg.weapon] || 0) - (msg.ammo || 0));
            if (state.weapon === msg.weapon) { state.weapon = "bat"; state.ammo = Infinity; }
            arsenal.render();
          }
          syncHUD();
          flashObjective(`Traded${msg.cash ? ` $${msg.cash}` : ""}${msg.weapon ? ` + a ${weaponName}` : ""} — deal done.`);
        } else {
          if (msg.cash > 0) state.cash += msg.cash;
          if (msg.weapon) arsenal.give(msg.weapon, msg.ammo || undefined);
          syncHUD();
          flashObjective(`Received${msg.cash ? ` $${msg.cash}` : ""}${msg.weapon ? ` a ${weaponName}` : ""} in a trade.`);
        }
      }
      
      // Offers and prompts both expire after 15 s of silence, so a player who
      // disconnects mid-trade can't wedge the T key or leave a prompt on screen.
      function tradeExpiry(isOffer, offerMsg) {
        clearTimeout(tradeExpiryTimer);
        const token = ++tradeWaitToken;
        tradeExpiryTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          if (!tradeOpen || tradeWaitToken !== token) return;
          tradeOpen = false;
          tradePanel.hidden = true;
          if (isOffer) flashObjective(offerMsg);
        }, 15000);
      }
      
      // Y / N answer the prompt (the pointer is locked during play, so the buttons
      // are there for the paused case and the keys for the driving case)
      addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (tradePanel.hidden) return;
        if (e.code === "KeyY") { e.preventDefault(); tradePanel.querySelector("#tradeYes")?.click(); }
        else if (e.code === "KeyN") { e.preventDefault(); tradePanel.querySelector("#tradeNo")?.click(); }
      });
      
      function openMultiplayer() {
        multiplayerMode = true; introPanel.hidden = true; characterSelect.hidden = true; multiplayerPanel.hidden = false;
        if (!multiplayer) multiplayer = createMultiplayer({ onConnection: (status, ping) => { mpConnection.textContent = `SERVER · ${status}${ping ? ` · ${Math.round(ping)}ms` : ""}`; }, onRooms: drawMultiplayerRooms, onDamage: (msg) => {
            if (msg.id === multiplayer?.playerId) {
               if (msg.health < state.hp) {
                 hurtFlash();
                 state.hp = msg.health;
                 syncHUD();
                 if (state.hp <= 0 && state.running && !state.over) wasted();
               }

        const ratio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, score / total));

      function safeStorage(storage) {
        return storage || {

      }
      
      export function createAdultContent({ document: doc = globalThis.document, window: win = globalThis.window, storage } = {}) {

          const details = element("p", "margin:0 0 22px;color:#c4c6d0;", "This is an R18+ game. It contains gore, graphic violence, drug use, sex and sexual themes, horror and strong language. By continuing you confirm that you are 18 or older.");

      function snapshotGame() {
        const mode = state.zombieMode ? "zombie" : state.freeRoam ? "free" : null;
        if (!mode || !state.running || state.cinematic) return null;
        const at = state.veh ? state.veh.obj.position : playerPos;
        return {
          mode, character: state.selectedCharacter, place: currentPlaceName(),
          x: at.x, z: at.z, hp: state.hp, sp: state.sp, cash: state.cash,
          weapon: state.weapon, ammo: Number.isFinite(state.ammo) ? state.ammo : null,
          reserve: mode === "zombie" ? { ...state.reserve } : null,     // free roam's ammo is endless: nothing to keep
          kills: { ...kills }, hours: worldTime.hours, day: worldTime.day,
          stats: mode === "zombie" && state.stats ? state.stats.toJSON() : null,
        };
      }
      function saveToSlot(slot) {
        const snap = snapshotGame();
        if (!snap) { flashObjective("Cannot save here: only Free Roam and Zombie Survival can be saved."); return false; }
        const ok = putSave(slot, snap);
        flashObjective(ok ? `Game saved to slot ${slot + 1}.` : "Could not save (browser storage is blocked).");
        return ok;
      }
      /** Put a save's contents into the running game (already in the right mode). */
      function applySave(d) {
        if (state.veh) { state.veh.speed = 0; state.veh = null; }
        teleportPlayer(d.x, d.z, 0);
        player.visible = true;
        state.hp = Math.max(1, d.hp || 100); state.sp = d.sp != null ? d.sp : 100; state.cash = d.cash || 0;
        state.heat = 0; state.wanted = 0; state.crimeCd = 0; state.bustCd = 0; state.vy = 0;
        police.clearPursuit();
        for (const k of Object.keys(kills)) kills[k] = (d.kills && d.kills[k]) || 0;
        worldTime.setTime(d.hours != null ? d.hours : 12, d.day);

**Medkits** — a health pack picked up at full health is banked (max 9) instead of wasted; **J** uses one for 35 HP anytime, and the count persists in savegames.

      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // franchiseClubs.js — walk-in Happy Hogs / Billy Jeans franchise interiors.
      // Fictional adults (25+); stage performers dance topless (2026-09-27, human
      // design call — the R18+ Crown Strip presentation TODO.md had marked "approved,
      // not implemented"). The bare chest is the same low-poly cylinder-and-spheres
      // bust every clothed NPC already has, just skinned in `skin` instead of cloth
      // (characters.js `topless`) — no new geometry, no anatomical detail beyond what
      // was already there under the top. Skirt and heels stay on. The club routines
      // and opt-in private-dance rhythm activity are suggestive, never explicit.
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      
      import * as THREE from "three";
      import { makeHog, makeDancer } from "./characters.js";
      
      const BRANCHES = Object.freeze({
        hogs: { name: "HAPPY HOGS", price: 80, palette: 0xff4fb3 },
        billy: { name: "BILLY JEANS", price: 80, palette: 0x9ad6ff },
      });
      const ROUTINE_SECONDS = 3.4;
      const ENCORE_SECONDS = 6.5;
      const ENCORE_TIP = 10;
      const STAGE_ROUTINES = Object.freeze({
        hogs: ["dance", "footwork", "spin", "twerk", "showboat", "lean"],
        billy: ["showboat", "moonwalk", "spin", "footwork", "twerk", "lean"],
      });
      const HOG_COSTUMES = Object.freeze([
        { top: 0xff4fb3, skirt: 0x17131d, heelColor: 0xffd23a },
        { top: 0xffd23a, skirt: 0x4a1747, heelColor: 0x17131d },
        { top: 0x9b27b0, skirt: 0x151923, heelColor: 0x9b27b0 },
      ]);
      const BILLY_COSTUMES = Object.freeze([
        { top: 0xff2e93, skirt: 0x17131d, heelColor: 0xd4af37 },
        { top: 0x2ee6d6, skirt: 0x202030, heelColor: 0x17131d },
        { top: 0xffd23a, skirt: 0x4a1747, heelColor: 0x9b27b0 },
      ]);
      
      const worldAt = (x, z, lx, lz, rot) => ({
        x: x + Math.cos(rot) * lx + Math.sin(rot) * lz,
        z: z - Math.sin(rot) * lx + Math.cos(rot) * lz,
      });
      
      export function createFranchiseClubs({
        scene, addBlocker = () => {}, state = null, adultContent = null,
        flashObjective = () => {}, syncHUD = () => {}, document: doc = globalThis.document,
        makeAdultHog = makeHog, makeAdultDancer = makeDancer,
      } = {}) {
        const clubs = [];
        let runtimeState = state, contentGate = adultContent, prompt = null, busy = false;
        let promptEl = null;
        if (doc?.body) {
          promptEl = doc.createElement("div");
          promptEl.id = "franchiseClubPrompt";
          promptEl.style.cssText = "position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:92px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:25;background:rgba(10,10,14,.86);color:#f4f1ea;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:8px;font:600 14px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;";
          promptEl.hidden = true;
          doc.body.appendChild(promptEl);
        }
        const mats = {
          wall: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x17131d, roughness: 0.84, name: "club interior wall" }),
          floor: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x302d36, roughness: 0.92, name: "club interior floor" }),
          trim: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xcac5d4, metalness: 0.35, roughness: 0.46, name: "club interior trim" }),
          stage: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x101015, roughness: 0.65, name: "club stage" }),
        };
        for (const m of Object.values(mats)) m.userData.gtbRealized = true;
      
        function box(parent, w, h, d, material, x, y, z) {
          const o = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d), material);
          o.position.set(x, y, z); o.castShadow = o.receiveShadow = true; parent.add(o); return o;
        }
        function register({ kind = "billy", x, z, rot = 0, exteriorRoof = null, exteriorFront = [] }) {
          const def = BRANCHES[kind];
          if (!def || !Number.isFinite(x) || !Number.isFinite(z)) return null;
          const root = new THREE.Group(); root.position.set(x, 0, z); root.rotation.y = rot;
          root.name = `${def.name} Branch Interior`;
          // Local +z faces the branch's exterior doorway; the room is entered from it.
          box(root, 19.2, 0.08, 10.0, mats.floor, 0, 0.02, -0.05);
          box(root, 20, 0.25, 0.35, mats.wall, 0, 0.13, -5.15);
          for (const sx of [-9.65, 9.65]) box(root, 0.35, 3.4, 10.0, mats.wall, sx, 1.7, -0.05);
          box(root, 0.35, 3.4, 10, mats.wall, 0, 1.7, -5.15);
          box(root, 20, 0.24, 0.35, mats.trim, 0, 3.15, -0.05);
          box(root, 18, 0.46, 3.1, mats.stage, 0, 0.45, -3.1);
          for (const px of [-6.5, 6.5]) {
            const pole = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.05, 0.08, 2.4, 8), mats.trim);
            pole.position.set(px, 1.65, -3); pole.castShadow = true; root.add(pole);
          }
          const screenMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: def.palette, emissive: def.palette, emissiveIntensity: 0.14, roughness: 0.55, name: "club dance screen" });
          screenMat.userData.gtbRealized = true;
          box(root, 3.5, 2.4, 0.14, screenMat, -6.8, 1.25, -3.6);
      
          // Collision encloses the sides/back, but no blocker is laid across the open
          // doorway. The townkit shell itself contains collision at the exterior face.
          for (const lx of [-8, -5, -2, 1, 4, 7, 9.3]) addBlocker(...Object.values(worldAt(x, z, lx, -5, rot)), 1.5);
          for (const lz of [-4, -1, 2, 4.7]) for (const side of [-1, 1]) addBlocker(...Object.values(worldAt(x, z, side * 9.5, lz, rot)), 1.5);
      
          const performers = [];
          const n = kind === "hogs" ? 3 : 2;
          const routine = STAGE_ROUTINES[kind];
          const costumes = kind === "hogs" ? HOG_COSTUMES : BILLY_COSTUMES;
          for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const costume = costumes[(clubs.length + i) % costumes.length];
            const wardrobe = {
              glam: true, topless: true, skirt: costume.skirt, denim: costume.skirt,
              shoe: "heels", heelColor: costume.heelColor,
              thighBoots: i === 2, bootColor: costume.heelColor,
            };
            const actor = kind === "hogs"
              ? makeAdultHog({ variant: "dancer", sex: "f", seed: 8830 + clubs.length * 11 + i, height: 1.78, age: 25 + i, top: costume.top, ...wardrobe })
              : makeAdultDancer({ sex: "f", seed: 9180 + clubs.length * 13 + i, height: 1.76, top: costume.top, ...wardrobe });
            actor.userData.adult = true;

        function update(dt, playerPos) {

            const lx = Math.cos(c.rot) * dx - Math.sin(c.rot) * dz;
            const lz = Math.sin(c.rot) * dx + Math.cos(c.rot) * dz;
            const inside = Math.abs(lx) < 9.2 && lz > -5.0 && lz < 4.8;
            c.root.visible = inside || Math.hypot(dx, dz) < 15;
            if (c.exteriorRoof) c.exteriorRoof.visible = !inside;
            for (const part of c.exteriorFront || []) part.visible = !inside;
            if (c.root.visible) {
              const wasEncore = c.encoreWasActive;
              c.encoreTimer = Math.max(0, c.encoreTimer - Math.max(0, dt));
              c.encoreWasActive = c.encoreTimer > 0;
              if (wasEncore && !c.encoreWasActive) {
                for (const p of c.performers) p.actor.play(p.routine[p.routineIndex], { force: true, loop: true });
              }
              for (const p of c.performers) {
                if (!c.encoreWasActive) {
                  p.routineElapsed += Math.max(0, dt);
                  if (p.routineElapsed >= ROUTINE_SECONDS) {
                    const steps = Math.floor(p.routineElapsed / ROUTINE_SECONDS);
                    p.routineElapsed %= ROUTINE_SECONDS;
                    p.routineIndex = (p.routineIndex + steps) % p.routine.length;
                    p.routineChanges += steps;
                    p.actor.play(p.routine[p.routineIndex], { force: true, loop: true });
                  }
                }
                p.actor.update(dt);
              }
            }
            if (inside && runtimeState?.running && !runtimeState.veh && !busy) {
              if (Math.hypot(lx, lz - 0.55) < 2.2) {
                prompt = { club: c, type: "encore", text: `E · Request a stage encore · tip $${ENCORE_TIP}` };
              } else if (Math.hypot(lx + 6.8, lz + 2.8) < 1.75) {
                prompt = { club: c, type: "privateDance", text: contentGate?.enabled?.() ? `E · Private dance with an adult performer · $${c.def.price}` : "Private dance disabled · adult opt-in required" };
              }
            }
          }
          if (promptEl) { promptEl.hidden = !prompt; promptEl.textContent = prompt ? prompt.text : ""; }
        }
      
        function interact() {
          if (busy) return true;
          if (!prompt) return false;
          const c = prompt.club;
          if (prompt.type === "encore") {
            if (!contentGate?.acknowledged?.()) { flashObjective("Confirm you are 18+ before entering the club."); return true; }
            if (!runtimeState || runtimeState.cash < ENCORE_TIP) { flashObjective(`You need $${ENCORE_TIP} to tip for an encore.`); return true; }
            runtimeState.cash -= ENCORE_TIP;
            c.encores++;
            c.encoreTimer = ENCORE_SECONDS;
            c.encoreWasActive = true;
            for (const p of c.performers) p.actor.play("twerk", { force: true, loop: true });

            return true;
          }
          if (!contentGate?.enabled?.()) { flashObjective("Private dances are off. Enable the optional activity in Options after confirming you are 18+."); return true; }
          busy = true;
          const opened = contentGate.openRhythmGame({
            venue: c.def.name,
            onBegin: () => {
              if (!runtimeState || runtimeState.cash < c.def.price) { flashObjective(`You need $${c.def.price}; no charge was made.`); return false; }
              runtimeState.cash -= c.def.price; c.plays++; syncHUD();
              flashObjective("Private dance started · match the arrows · Esc exits at any time.");
              return true;
            },
            onFinish: (result) => {

      import assert from "node:assert/strict";
      import * as THREE from "three";
      import { createFranchiseClubs } from "../../src/franchiseClubs.js";
      
      function makeFakeActor(opts, { hog = false } = {}) {
        const actor = new THREE.Group();
        actor.userData = { age: opts.age || 25, adult: false, fictional: false, hog, outfit: null };
        actor.anim = "idle";
        actor.play = (anim) => { actor.anim = anim; };
        actor.update = () => {};
        actor.outfitOptions = opts;
        return actor;
      }
      const actors = [];
      const makeActor = (opts, extra) => { const actor = makeFakeActor(opts, extra); actors.push(actor); return actor; };
      const scene = new THREE.Scene();
      const state = { running: true, veh: null, cash: 200 };
      const messages = [];
      const mockGate = {
        acknowledged: () => true,
        enabled: () => optedIn,
        openRhythmGame(options) { rhythmOptions = options; return true; },
      };
      let optedIn = false, rhythmOptions = null, hudSyncs = 0;
      const doc = { body: { appendChild() {} }, createElement() { return { style: {}, addEventListener() {} }; } };
      const clubs = createFranchiseClubs({
        scene, state, adultContent: mockGate, document: doc,
        flashObjective: (message) => messages.push(message),
        syncHUD: () => hudSyncs++,
        makeAdultHog: (opts) => makeActor(opts, { hog: true }),
        makeAdultDancer: (opts) => makeActor(opts),
      });
      const hogClub = clubs.register({ kind: "hogs", x: 100, z: 100, rot: 0 });
      const billyClub = clubs.register({ kind: "billy", x: 200, z: 200, rot: 0 });
      assert.ok(hogClub && billyClub, "both franchise types register");
      assert.equal(hogClub.performers.length, 3, "Happy Hogs has a stage trio");
      assert.equal(billyClub.performers.length, 2, "Billy Jeans has a stage pair");
      assert.ok(clubs.debug.every((club) => club.allAdults && club.allFictional && club.allTopless), "all performers are fictional adults dancing topless");
      assert.ok(actors.every((actor) => actor.outfitOptions.glam && actor.outfitOptions.topless && actor.outfitOptions.shoe === "heels"), "stage costume is the topless glam wardrobe (skirt + heels stay on)");
      assert.ok(actors.every((actor) => actor.outfitOptions.top != null && actor.outfitOptions.skirt != null), "performers still carry a costume palette (skirt colour) even topless");
      assert.equal(clubs.debug[0].hogDancers, 3, "Happy Hogs cast are anthropomorphic hog performers");
      
      // Inside the room, normal floor routines progress through the available dance clips.
      clubs.update(0, { x: 100, z: 100 });
      assert.equal(hogClub.root.visible, true);
      const initialRoutines = hogClub.performers.map((p) => p.actor.anim);
      clubs.update(3.5, { x: 100, z: 100 });
      assert.ok(hogClub.performers.every((p) => p.routineChanges > 0), "stage routines rotate over time");
      assert.ok(hogClub.performers.some((p, i) => p.actor.anim !== initialRoutines[i]), "the cast displays changing routine poses");
      
      // The player must ask for an encore. A voluntary tip pauses normal choreography briefly.
      clubs.update(0, { x: 100, z: 100.55 });
      assert.equal(clubs.interact(), true, "the nearby encore interaction is handled");
      assert.equal(state.cash, 190, "an encore deducts only its stated tip");
      assert.equal(hogClub.encores, 1);
      assert.equal(hogClub.encoreWasActive, true);
      assert.ok(hogClub.performers.every((p) => p.actor.anim === "twerk"), "the encore changes the stage routine");
      assert.ok(messages.some((m) => m.includes("encore requested")));
      assert.ok(hudSyncs > 0);
      
      // Private activity remains separately opt-in and is not charged until START.
      optedIn = false;
      clubs.update(0, { x: 100 - 6.8, z: 100 - 2.8 });
      assert.match(clubs.debug[0].name, /HAPPY HOGS/);
      clubs.interact();
      assert.equal(rhythmOptions, null, "private activity stays unavailable while opted out");
      optedIn = true;
      clubs.update(0, { x: 100 - 6.8, z: 100 - 2.8 });
      clubs.interact();
      assert.ok(rhythmOptions, "opted-in player can open the private rhythm activity");
      assert.equal(state.cash, 190, "opening the activity does not charge before its explicit START");
      assert.equal(rhythmOptions.onBegin(), true);
      assert.equal(state.cash, 110, "the stated private-dance price is charged at START, not on approach");
      assert.equal(hogClub.plays, 1);
      rhythmOptions.onFinish(null);
      
      console.log("Franchise club performer and interaction tests passed");

        // Hot-coffee-style scene (human request, 2026-09-28): after a good private
        // dance the performer invites the player to stay for coffee. It is a consensual,
        // fade-to-black beat in the same spirit as the rest of this module: nothing
        // explicit is rendered — the invitation, a dimmed screen and a tasteful
        // closer. Opt-in (18+ acknowledged AND the activity preference on), leaveable
        // at any moment, and it owns the simulation pause while open.
        function openCoffeeScene({ venue = "the club", result = null, onFinish = () => {} } = {}) {
          if (!enabled() || !doc?.body || game) return false;
          const overlay = element("div", overlayCss + "z-index:100001;");
          overlay.id = "gtbCoffeeScene";
          const card = element("section", cardCss + "text-align:center;");
          card.setAttribute("role", "dialog"); card.setAttribute("aria-modal", "true");
          const title = element("h2", titleCss, `AFTER THE DANCE · ${venue.toUpperCase()}`);
          const intro = element("p", "color:#d2d3dc;", "A fictional adult performer asks you to stay for coffee. Fade to black — nothing explicit is shown. You can leave at any time.");
          const prompt = element("p", "margin:22px 0;font:800 clamp(20px,4vw,28px)/1.3 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#fff;", result && result.rating ? `"Nice moves. Stay for coffee?" (${result.rating})` : "\"Stay for coffee?\"");
          const actions = element("div", "display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:12px;");
          const stay = element("button", buttonCss, "STAY FOR COFFEE"); stay.type = "button";
          const out = element("button", buttonCss + "background:#454957;color:#fff;", "HEAD OUT"); out.type = "button";
          actions.append(stay, out);
          card.append(title, intro, prompt, actions);
          overlay.appendChild(card); doc.body.appendChild(overlay);
      
          const active = { overlay, onFinish, result: null, timer: 0, onKey: null };
          const onKey = (e) => {
            if (!game) return;
            if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); closeGame(game.result); }
          };
          active.onKey = onKey;
          game = active;
          if (win) win.addEventListener("keydown", onKey, true);
          if (pauseHandler) pauseHandler(true);
          stay.addEventListener("click", () => {
            if (!game) return;
            game.result = { coffee: true };
            // The fade-to-black: the invitation gives way to a private closer. No
            // timers — the player closes it when they are done reading it.
            overlay.style.background = "#050505";
            intro.hidden = true; prompt.hidden = true; stay.hidden = true; out.hidden = true;
            const brew = element("p", "margin:18px 0;font:900 clamp(40px,10vw,72px)/1 system-ui,sans-serif;", "☕");
            const note = element("p", "color:#c4c6d0;", "The lights dim. What happens next stays off screen.");
            const closeBtn = element("button", buttonCss, "CLOSE"); closeBtn.type = "button";
            closeBtn.addEventListener("click", () => closeGame(game.result));
            card.append(brew, note, closeBtn);
          });
          out.addEventListener("click", () => closeGame(null));
          return true;
        }

        function openNightScene({ venue = "the club", price = 0, performerName = "a performer", perks = null, onFinish = () => {} } = {}) {
          if (!enabled() || !doc?.body || game) return false;
          const overlay = element("div", overlayCss + "z-index:100001;");
          overlay.id = "gtbNightScene";
          const card = element("section", cardCss + "text-align:center;");
          card.setAttribute("role", "dialog"); card.setAttribute("aria-modal", "true");
          const title = element("h2", titleCss, `THE BACK ROOMS · ${venue.toUpperCase()}`);
          const intro = element("p", "color:#d2d3dc;", `A night with ${performerName} is $${price}, paid up front. Both adults, entirely consensual, and the moment you say yes the screen fades — nothing explicit is shown. You can walk away any time.`);
          const perksLine = element("p", "margin:0 0 8px;color:#9ad6ff;font-size:13px;", perks && perks.text ? perks.text : "");
          const actions = element("div", "display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:12px;");
          const yes = element("button", buttonCss, `PAY $${price} · SPEND THE NIGHT`); yes.type = "button";
          const no = element("button", buttonCss + "background:#454957;color:#fff;", "WALK AWAY"); no.type = "button";
          actions.append(yes, no);
          card.append(title, intro, perksLine, actions);
          overlay.appendChild(card); doc.body.appendChild(overlay);
      
          const active = { overlay, onFinish, result: null, timer: 0, onKey: null };
          const onKey = (e) => {
            if (!game) return;
            if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); closeGame(game.result); }
          };
          active.onKey = onKey;
          game = active;
          if (win) win.addEventListener("keydown", onKey, true);
          if (pauseHandler) pauseHandler(true);
          yes.addEventListener("click", () => {
            if (!game) return;
            // Paid nights can't be walked back once paid: the payer's onBegin has
            // already charged and checked funds (it returning false would have kept
            // this overlay from ever opening its confirm step).
            game.result = { night: true, perk: perks && perks.grant ? perks.grant() : null };
            // The fade: black screen, the morning after.
            overlay.style.background = "#050505";
            intro.hidden = true; perksLine.hidden = true; yes.hidden = true; no.hidden = true;
            const moon = element("p", "margin:18px 0;font:900 clamp(40px,10vw,72px)/1 system-ui,sans-serif;", "🌙");
            const note = element("p", "color:#c4c6d0;", "The door closes. The night is yours and off screen.");
            const dawn = element("p", "margin:12px 0 0;color:#9ad6ff;", "☀ You wake in the morning, rested.");
            const closeBtn = element("button", buttonCss + "margin-top:16px;", "MORNING"); closeBtn.type = "button";
            closeBtn.addEventListener("click", () => closeGame(game.result));
            card.append(moon, note, dawn, closeBtn);
          });
          no.addEventListener("click", () => closeGame(null));
          return true;
        }

"""`/kink` — Lisa's kinks and secret desires, defined by you.

Stored in ``<config dir>/kinks.json`` as a list of ``{"text": ..., "secret": bool}``.
They are read on every request (cached by file mtime), so ``/kink add`` takes
effect on her very next message with no restart.

How she uses them (see ``prompt_note``):

* **kinks** - things she's into. She weaves them into banter now and then.
* **secret desires** - she hides these when calm, *hints* at one when she's
  warmed up (arousal level 2), and confesses them openly when she's very
  aroused (level 3+). So the arousal meter has a payoff.

Lisa is an adult fictional character: entries that involve minors are refused.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Tuple

from . import config

MAX_ITEMS = 24
MAX_LEN = 140

# Words that mean the entry involves a minor. Not a general content filter - just
# the one hard line: Lisa is an adult and nothing here may say otherwise.
_MINOR_RE = re.compile(

    r"shota|shotacon|schoolgirl|school ?girl|schoolboy|preteen|pre-teen|tween|"
    r"teen|teens|teenager|toddler|baby|infant|juvenile|"
    r"(?:[0-9]|1[0-7])\s*(?:yo|y/o|years? old|year-old))(?!\w)", re.I)

_cache: dict = {"mtime": None, "path": None, "items": []}


def path() -> Path:
    return config.config_dir() / "kinks.json"


def load() -> List[dict]:
    """Current list. Cached by mtime; missing / corrupt file -> []."""
    p = path()
    try:
        mtime = p.stat().st_mtime_ns
    except OSError:
        _cache.update(mtime=None, path=str(p), items=[])
        return []
    if _cache["mtime"] == mtime and _cache["path"] == str(p):
        return list(_cache["items"])
    try:
        data = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        items = [{"text": str(d["text"]).strip(), "secret": bool(d.get("secret", False))}
                 for d in data if isinstance(d, dict) and str(d.get("text", "")).strip()]
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
        items = []
    _cache.update(mtime=mtime, path=str(p), items=items)
    return list(items)


def _write(items: List[dict]) -> None:
    p = path()
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tmp = p.with_suffix(".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(items, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    os.replace(tmp, p)                                   # atomic
    _cache["mtime"] = None                               # force a re-read

"""`<angle bracket>` actions: things Master DOES, as opposed to things he SAYS.

    <begins to touch her body>          ->  *Master begins to touch her body*
    Come here <grabs her waist> baby    ->  "Come here" *Master grabs her waist* "baby"

Bracketed text becomes an *asterisk action* the model reads as a verb (never as
speech), and whatever is left around it is quoted as speech. Two modes:

* loose mode (`strict=False`): any `<...>` is an action - it's roleplay, that's the point.
* chat mode (`strict=True`): only things that read like a plain-English action
  (letters, spaces, a little punctuation, 2+ words). Code such as `List<int>`,
  `<div class="x">`, `a <b> c` (one word) or anything inside backticks / fenced
  blocks is left exactly as typed, so coding chats are never mangled.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re

_ACTION = re.compile(r"<([^<>\n]{2,200})>")
_CODE_SPLIT = re.compile(r"(```.*?```|`[^`\n]*`)", re.S)          # fenced blocks and `inline code`
_PLAIN = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z ,.'’\-!]*$")               # plain-English action text
_TAGS = {
    "a", "b", "i", "u", "p", "br", "hr", "div", "span", "img", "ul", "ol", "li", "table", "tr",
    "td", "th", "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6", "html", "head", "body", "script", "style",
    "link", "meta", "input", "button", "form", "label", "select", "option", "textarea", "code",
    "pre", "em", "strong", "nav", "main", "section", "article", "footer", "header", "svg",
    "followups", "think", "thinking",
}


def _looks_like_action(inner: str, strict: bool) -> bool:
    inner = inner.strip()
    if not inner or inner.startswith("/"):                  # </closing> tags are never actions
        return False
    first = inner.split(None, 1)[0].lower().rstrip("/")
    if first in _TAGS and (strict or len(inner.split()) == 1):
        return False
    if not strict:
        return not re.search(r"[=/{};()]", inner)          # code-ish symbols: not an action
    words = inner.split()
    return 2 <= len(words) <= 25 and bool(_PLAIN.match(inner))


def _as_action(inner: str) -> str:
    inner = " ".join(inner.split()).rstrip(".")
    if inner[:1].islower():                                 # "pulls her closer" -> "Master pulls..." (or your name)
        from . import names
        inner = names.current() + " " + inner
    return "*" + inner + "*"


def _convert_plain(segment: str, strict: bool) -> "tuple[str, int]":
    """Convert one non-code segment. Returns (text, number_of_actions_found)."""
    parts, last, n = [], 0, 0
    for m in _ACTION.finditer(segment):
        inner = m.group(1)
        # `List<int>` / `1 < 2`: a real action hugs its brackets (no space just inside) and
        # doesn't start glued to the previous word
        if inner != inner.strip() or (m.start() > 0 and segment[m.start() - 1].isalnum()):
            continue
        if not _looks_like_action(inner, strict):
            continue
        parts.append(("speech", segment[last:m.start()]))
        parts.append(("action", _as_action(m.group(1))))
        last, n = m.end(), n + 1
    parts.append(("speech", segment[last:]))
    if not n:
        return segment, 0
    out = []
    for kind, s in parts:
        if kind == "action":
            out.append(s)
            continue
        s = s.strip()
        if not s:
            continue
        if not (len(s) > 1 and s[0] in "\"“" and s[-1] in "\"”"):
            s = '"' + s + '"'                               # what's left is what he SAYS
        out.append(s)
    return " ".join(out), n


def convert_actions(text: str, strict: bool = False) -> str:
    """`text` with <bracketed actions> rewritten as *Master ...* actions and the rest
    quoted as speech (only when at least one action was found; otherwise unchanged)."""
    if not text or "<" not in text:
        return text
    pieces = _CODE_SPLIT.split(text)          # odd indexes are code, left alone
    if len(pieces) == 1:
        return _convert_plain(text, strict)[0]
    converted, total = [], 0
    for i, piece in enumerate(pieces):
        if i % 2 == 1 or not piece:
            converted.append(piece)
            continue
        new, n = _convert_plain(piece, strict)
        converted.append(new)
        total += n
    return "".join(converted) if total else text
